name: Cloud Orshaa

effects.name: Mystic Binding
effects.text: As you play Cloud Orshaa, discard up to four Arderial Spells from your hand. Add two energy to Cloud Orshaa for each Spell discarded.

flavor: An Orshaa can spell the difference between victory and defeat.

name: Cyclone Xyx

effects.name: Backlash
effects.text: Whenever Cyclone Xyx is attacked, before energy is removed, remove one energy from each of the attacking player's Creature.

powers.name: Storm Front
powers.text: Discard one energy from each opposing Arderial Creature.

flavor:
"They should have listened to me. They may not know it now, but they'll
wish they had."
— Jaela, Lady of the Sky

name: Flying Darbok

powers.name: Airlift
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures in play. Move all energy from Flying Darbok to the chosen Creature, and add two energy to the chosen Creature. The chosen Creature can attack Magi directly this turn. Use this Power only before the Attack step.

flavor:
"The bigger they are, the harder they drop."
— Jaela, Regis

name: Sandstorm Orshaa

effects.text: As you play Sandstorm Orshaa, reduce its cost by four. Sandstorm Orshaa is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

powers.name: Stinging Sands
powers.text: Choose a Spell in play. Discard the chosen Spell and three energy from that Spell's Magi.

flavor:
"What I really hate is that crunchy feeling they leave in your teeth."
— Ythra

name: Wind Hyren

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Increase your Arderial or d'Resh Magi's Energize by two. A Magi can only be affected by one Invigorate at a time.

flavor:
"Anyway, the wind blows..."
— Shivara, Mistress of the Winds

name: Wyle

effects.name: Tap Strength
effects.text: Whenever one or more opposing Magi gain energy outside of their Energize step, add two energy to Wyle.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose a Creature in play. Add X energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"I'm a real wyle child!"
— Kalius

name: Arderian Adept

effects.name: Undream
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Shimmer has no energy, you may choose a Creature in play. Place the chosen Creature's energy on its Magi and return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand. This effect cannot add energy to Shimmer beyond the starting energy of the chosen Creature.

flavor: "Time to wake up!"

name: Aula, Mindseeker

powers.name: Windsight
powers.text: Discard a Spell from your hand. Draw a number of cards equal to half of the Spell's energy cost, rounded down (X equals zero) and reveal them to your opponent. You cannot draw any more cards this turn.

flavor:
"When she came to us, her eyes sparkled with youth. Now her eyes spark
with grim determination."
— Mobis, Elder

name: Orathan Amulet

effects.name: Spray
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your Orathans in play.

powers.name: Pod
powers.text: Search your deck for an Orathan card. Place that card into your hand.

flavor:
"An ancient relic from a time long forgotten, legends say that it was
crafted by the flyers themselves and gifted to the Orothean Elder,
Hubdra."
— Mobis, Elder

name: Storm Wings

powers.name: All-Out
powers.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks this turn, it removes twice as much energy as it would normally. At the end of your Attack step, discard Storm Wings and each of your Creatures that attacked this turn.

flavor: A wing and a predator.

name: Jetstream
text: Play an Arderial Creature from your hand with a starting energy of three or less, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot gain energy this turn.
flavor:
"One ticket for the Beatdown Express, coming up!"
— Kalius

name: Shrink
text: Choose a Creature. Discard half of the chosen Creature's energy, rounded down.
flavor:
"I will call him 'Mini-you'!"
— Adis

name: Spirit of Arderial
text: You may play this card only when your Arderial Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws four cards. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Wind!"

name: Tradewinds
text: Discard one card from your hand to draw three cards.
flavor:
"I could ride these all day!"
— Shivara, Mistress of the Winds

name: Bleph

effects.name: Bleph Fu
effects.text: Whenever Bleph attacks a Creature, before energy is removed, add one energy to Bleph for each of the defending player's Creatures.

flavor:
"It may only be able to reach to your kneecaps, but believe me, that's
enough."
— Yricho

name: Looph

effects.name: Regroup
effects.text: If Looph attacks and is defeated, you may immediately play a Bograth Creature from your hand, paying all costs.

flavor:
"Eryss went loophie a long time ago."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Rous

effects.name: Myth
effects.text: Rous cannot be attacked. If all of your Creatures in play are Rous, discard Rous from play.

powers.name: Hit
powers.text: Choose one opposing Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Rous.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Rous.
flavor:
"What about the rous?"
— Zannah, to Wence

name: Swamp Moga

powers.name: Roar
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, each of your Creatures removes two additional energy when attacking.

flavor:
"Good, bad, I'm the guy with the moga."
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Practical Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Torpar

effects.name: Community
effects.text: Whenever one of your cards adds energy to all of your Creatures, add an additional energy to Torpar.

effects.name: Protection
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell or Power removes energy from any of your other Creatures, remove the energy from Torpar instead.

flavor:
"It's a mobile home, Korg. Not a luxury resort!"
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Umbu

effects.name: Mud Clod
effects.text: When Umbu is discarded from play, choose a Relic in play. Attach Umbu to the chosen Relic; as long as Umbu is attached, it cannot be discarded by having zero energy and is unaffected by cards that affect Creatures. None of the chosen Relic's Powers or Effects can be used. At the beginning of each of your turns, discard one energy from that Relic's Magi. When the Relic is discarded, discard Umbu.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Umbu loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"Dangit! It's all gunked up again!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Hygienic Emperor of Great
   and Mighty Bograth

name: Vard

effects.name: Surge
effects.text: As you play Vard, if your Magi is Bograth and any opponent has more Creatures in play than you (not counting this card), ignore Vard's cost.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Vard loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor: Ever hungry, vards are drawn to concentrations of dream energy.

name: Abger

effects.name: Barter
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opposing Magi plays a Relic, you may discard one energy from Abger to draw two cards.

effects.name: Shrewd
effects.text: Opposing Paradwyn Creatures cost one additional energy to play.

flavor: "Come get some! It's on sale!"

name: Drig

powers.name: Leech
powers.text: Discard one energy from each opposing Creature, and add one energy to each of your Bograth Creatures in play.

flavor: "Why ask for what you can take?"

name: Ninibom
text: If your defeated Magi are Baa, Wiep, and Grahnna, in that order, you can play Ninibom as a fourth Magi. You do not lose the game until Ninibom is defeated. If Ninibom is not your fourth Magi, increase Ninibom's energize to seven. Ninibom can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.
flavor: "A boot to the head is a greeting that everyone understands."

name: Korg's Sceptre

effects.name: No Moving Parts
effects.text: Korg can play Korg's Sceptre.

powers.name: Grand Majesty
powers.text: Discard one of your cards from play. Discard one energy from each opposing Creature.

flavor:
"You want some of this?"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Charitable Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Olabra's Staff

powers.name: Training Drills
powers.text: If you have five or more Bograth Creatures in play, add one energy to each of your Bograth Creatures. Skip your Attack step. You may only use this Power before your Attack step.

flavor:
"When around Korg, speak slowly and carry a big stick."
— Olabra, Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Lightning Sand
text: Until the beginning of your next turn, the first time one of your cards is chosen for an opposing Power or attack, the opposing Power does nothing, or your defending Creature loses no energy in the attack.
flavor:
"...And you brilliantly found the lightning sand!"
— Wence, to Zannah

name: Muck Rain
text: Choose an opposing Magi. If the number of Bograth Creatures you have in play is greater than the chosen Magi's Energize rate, choose one of that Magi's Creatures. Discard the chosen Creature.
flavor: Splat. Splittysplat. SplishsplatterspSPLAT!

name: Spirit of Bograth
text: You may play this card only when your Bograth Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, add energy to it equal to one opposing Magi's Energize rate. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: Tag-team mud wrasslin'!

name: Charg

effects.name: Scattershot
effects.text: Whenever Charg attacks a Creature, before energy is removed, discard one energy from each of the defending Magi's Creatures. Discard an additional energy from each of the defending Magi's Orothe Creatures.

flavor:
"Close counts for a lot with this thing."
— Gar, Healer

name: Coal Ergar

powers.name: Enflame
powers.text: Discard one energy from each opposing Creature with more energy than Coal Erger, then discard one energy from each Orothe Creature. Discard two energy from Coal Erger. Opposing cards cannot alter the amount of energy discarded by Enflame.

flavor:
"Make like a tree and go away!"
— Ven

name: Ember Hyren

effects.name: Heat Feed
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures attacks, add one energy to Ember Hyren.

powers.name: Singe
powers.text: Choose a Creature. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Our love is like a glowing ember burning bright."
"Oh, please!"
— Barak and Tryn

name: Flambit

powers.name: Immolate
powers.text: Discard Flambit from play. Choose a Magi and a Creature. Move up to three energy from the chosen Magi to the chosen Creature.

flavor: Magi flambé.

name: Rock Silth

effects.name: Hide
effects.text: If an opposing Spell or Power discards Rock Silth from play, move energy up to Rock Silth's starting energy from it to your Magi and draw a card.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Rock Silth loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"Fire? I didn't twist any fire in there?! Who..."
"Looking for me, old friend?"
— Whall and ...?

name: Spark Chogo

effects.name: Burnout
effects.text: Whenever Spark Chogo attacks, it removes two additional energy from the opposing Creature.

powers.name: Fade Away
powers.text: Discard Spark Chogo from play. Choose a Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature. Opposing cards do not alter the amount of energy discarded by Fade Away.

flavor:
"It's better to burn out than to fade away."
— Valkan, Pyromancer and Former Bridge-Builder

name: Magam, Flamesmith

effects.name: Flame Boost
effects.text: Add two energy to the first Creature played on your turn.

effects.name: Flame Strike
effects.text: Discard two energy from the first Creature played on each opposing turn.

flavor:
Fire burns / Fire lives,
Fire works / Fire gives.
— Ringsmith's Mantra

name: Traveling Healer

effects.name: Bolster
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your Creatures with less than its starting energy.

effects.name: Grudge
effects.text: When you reveal Traveling Healer, if an opposing Magi is Orothe or Weave, add five energy to Traveling Healer.

flavor:
"He doesn't know what he's got coming. Well, I'm coming, and I'll show
HIM!"

name: Everburning Wick

effects.name: Short Fuse
effects.text: As one of your cards is discarded from play by an opposing card, discard one energy from the opposing card's Magi.

effects.name: Really Short Fuse
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if you have no Creatures in play, you may discard Everburning Wick from play to choose a Creature. Discard five energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"It gets shorter and shorter and shorter, but it doesn't ever go away."
— Valkan

name: Flameplate Armor

effects.name: Best Defense
effects.text: Whenever your Magi loses energy from an opposing card, it loses one less energy.

effects.name: Good Offense
effects.text: As an opposing card discards energy from your Magi, you may discard Flameplate Armor from play and a card from your hand to discard the energy from any opposing Magi instead.

flavor: Good armor deflects blows. Better armor deflects blows somewhere useful.

name: Magam's Ring

effects.name: Rebirth
effects.text: As one of your Cald Creatures is discarded from play on an opponent's turn, you may discard Magam's Ring to restore the Creature to its starting energy instead.

flavor:
"Tis but a flesh wound!"
— Magam, Flamesmith

name: Bombard
text: Roll a die. Discard that much energy, divided any way you choose, from up to three opposing Creatures.
flavor:
"The scorch marks are too random, and the d'Reshi always walk in single
file to hide their numbers. This was done by Cald Magi."
— Groll, Watchkeeper

name: Flame Spurt
text: Attach Flame Spurt to your Magi. When one of your cards is attacked, before energy is removed, you may discard Flame Spurt from play to discard two energy from the attacking Creature. You can only use one Flame Spurt during an attack.
flavor:
"Do you hear a popping sound?"
"Hey, it wasn't me!"
— Tryn and Barak

name: Spirit of Cald
text: You may play this card only when your Cald Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. Until the beginning of your next turn, whenever that opponent plays a Creature, discard one energy from each of that opponent's other Creatures in play. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Fire!"

name: Dagok

effects.name: Dream Inversion
effects.text: Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that discard energy from Dagok instead add an equal amount of energy. Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that add energy to Dagok instead discard an equal amount of energy.

text: Naroom Magi can play Dagok. Naroom Shadow Magi can play Dagok for one less energy.
flavor:
"It hurts so good."
— Warrada, The Shadow Empress

name: Gumph

effects.name: Night's Shade
effects.text: Once per turn, when a Creature is discarded from play, choose a Creature. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

text: Naroom Magi can play Gumph.
flavor:
"Run through the forest, gumph!"
— Sperri, Fiend of Furoks

name: Rabid Wasperine

effects.name: Counterattack
effects.text: Immediately after one of your cards is attacked, you may play Rabid Wasperine, paying all costs. If your Magi is Naroom Shadow, add one energy to Rabid Wasperine when you play it. Rabid Wasperine immediately attacks the opposing Creature that just attacked.

text: Naroom Magi can play Rabid Wasperine.
flavor:
"Oh, brother darling, look. It's drooling on the carpet again...!"
— Warrade, to Hrada

name: Rous

effects.name: Myth
effects.text: Rous cannot be attacked. If all of your Creatures in play are Rous, discard Rous from play.

powers.name: Hit
powers.text: Choose one opposing Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Rous.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Rous.
flavor:
"I don't believe they exist."
— Wence, to Zannah

name: Severos

powers.name: Mind Dredge
powers.text: Choose a Creature in an opponent's discard pile. Play the chosen Creature, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties. Pay all costs from Severos instead of your Magi. Use this Power only after the Attack step. When that Creature leaves play, discard Severos from play.

text: Orothe Magi can play Severos
flavor:
"Welcome to the pah-ty!"
— Qwade

name: Shadow Hyren

effects.name: Taste
effects.text: When you play Shadow Hyren, choose a Creature. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. Whenever Shadow Hyren attacks a Creature of the same region as the chosen Creature, add two energy to Shadow Hyren before energy is removed.

effects.name: Feed
effects.text: If your Magi is a Shadow Magi, when Shadow Hyren defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"Everyone has a shadow. Does yours like you?"
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Fiend of Furoks

effects.name: Affinity
effects.text: Fiend of Furoks ignores regional penalties and restrictions when playing Furoks.

effects.name: Reconstruct
effects.text: Once per turn, you can play a Furok from your discard pile as if it were in your hand, paying all costs.

flavor: "It's ALIIIIVE! ... Again!"

name: Harror, Nightstalker

effects.name: Starfire
effects.text: Magi can retrieve, but not play, their starting cards. Your cards cannot force other players to discard cards from their hands.
If any opposing Magi are Core, decrease Harror, Nightstalker's energy by two.

flavor: "You may think you are safe now, but remember: night falls everywhere."

name: Ninibom
text: If your defeated Magi are Baa, Wiep, and Grahnna, in that order, you can play Ninibom as a fourth Magi. You do not lose the game until Ninibom is defeated. If Ninibom is not your fourth Magi, increase Ninibom's energize to seven. Ninibom can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.
flavor:
"Yes friends, act now! Destroy Paradwyn! Defeat the jungle! Eliminate even
the toughest stain!"

name: The Real Qwade

effects.name: Leech
effects.text: At the beginning of your Play Creatures step, you may discard two energy from The Real Qwade. If you do, until the end of your turn, whenever you play a Creature, choose another Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to the Creature you just played.

text: The Real Qwade can be in a Magi stack with "Qwade". When you reveal The Real Qwade, defeat him if your previous defeated Magi was not "Qwade".
flavor: I trust no one. Not even myself.

name: Ebony Mirror

effects.name: Grim Reflection
effects.text: At the beginning of each player's Draw step, if that player has more cards in his or her hand than any other player, that player draws one less card this turn. While Ebony Mirror is in play, all players draw at least one card during their Draw step.

flavor:
"I don't like looking in a mirror that stares back."
— Chur

name: Dark Portents
text: Choose a player. Reveal the top five cards of the chosen player's deck. Add one energy to your Magi for each Creature revealed. You may discard one of the revealed cards. Put the remaining cards back on the chosen player's deck in the same order.
flavor:
"I've got a bad feeling about this."
— Hrada, Dark Lord

name: Haunt
text: Choose an opposing Creature. Attach Haunt to the chosen Creature. When that Creature is discarded, play it instead, ignoring all costs and regional restrictions. The Creature becomes Core instead of its original region(s). The Creature cannot attack the turn you play it.
flavor:
"Weebolicious!"
— Hrada, Dark Lord

name: Shadow Ritual
text: Until the end of the turn, all Powers on your Core cards cost two less energy to use, to a minimum of zero. Only Shadow Magi can play Shadow Ritual.
flavor:
"You put your whole soul in, pull your whole soul out, you put your whole
soul in, and then you shake it all about..."
— Korremar

name: Spirit of the Core
text: You may play this card only when your Core Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, choose an opposing Creature. Gain control of the chosen Creature, and restore it to its starting energy. The chosen Creature becomes Core instead of its original region(s), and cannot attack that turn. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Outta my way, punk!"

name: Ababila

effects.name: Thief
effects.text: When you play Ababila, choose one opponent's deck. Reveal the top card of the chosen deck and place it under Ababila. When Ababila is discarded, discard all cards under it.

effects.name: Stop!
effects.text: Ababila loses two less energy in attacks against Creatures of the same region as the card under Ababila.

flavor:
"Give me forty of these, and I could rule the Moonlands!"
— Korremar

name: Beeb

effects.name: Underfoot
effects.text: Whenever Beeb is in an attack with a Creature with more than twice Beeb's current energy, Beeb removes three additional energy from the opposing Creature.

flavor:
"Sand? Scorching. Rocks? Sharp. Beebs? Pointy. Got it. Ow!"
— Chur

name: Bone Grag

effects.name: Reclaim
effects.text: Whenever one of your cards is discarded from play by an opposing card, add one energy to Bone Grag. If the discarded card was an Oracle, draw a card.

powers.name: Advance
powers.text: Choose another Oracle Creature. Add two energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"The lesson of the bone grag: remember not to forget. I'm not sure how
useful that lesson is."
— Drajan, Elder

name: Bulabantu

effects.name: Ambush
effects.text: When you play Bulabantu, choose a Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Not to self: do not pick berries that stick out of sand dunes."
— Wence

name: Cactus Dryte

effects.name: Thorn
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Magi draws a card outside of the Draw Step, discard one energy from that Magi.

effects.name: Deny
effects.text: Powers and Effects on Shadow Magi cannot be used while Cactus Dryte is in play.

flavor:
"Time for you to experience d'Reshi hospitality!"
— Korremar

name: Darbok

powers.name: Divebomb
powers.text: Choose one of your other Creatures and an opposing Creature. Return your chosen Creature to your hand, discarding its energy. Discard four energy from the opposing chosen Creature.

text: d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Darbok.
flavor: You can fly on the wings of a darbok... until it drops you.

name: Drahkar

effects.name: Dominate
effects.text: When Drahkar is discarded from play, choose one opposing Creature with three energy or less. Discard the chosen Creature.
As you play Drahkar, reduce its cost by five. Drahkar is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

text: d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Drahkar.
flavor:
"You tell it it's not real!"
— Chur

name: Habob

effects.name: Serve
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if your Magi is d'Resh, you may move up to five energy from Habob to your Magi. When you reveal a d'Resh Magi, if you have one or more Recurring cards in your discard pile, you may discard one energy from your Magi to choose one recurring card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

errata.previous_text: At the end of your turn, if your Magi is d'Resh, you may move all energy on Habob to your Magi.
errata.change: A maximum move limit of five energy from Habob has been added to Serve.

text: When you reveal a d'Resh Magi, if you have one or more recurring cards in your discard pile, you may discard one energy from your Magi to choose one recurring card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor:
"With a friend like him, you won't have many enemies."
— Drajan

name: Izmer

effects.name: Sandomancy
effects.text: Whenever you play a d'Resh Relic, choose a Creature. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

powers.name: Abrade
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Until there's nothing left but the sand."
— Gherish

name: Lesser Darbok

effects.name: Defend
effects.text: When you play Lesser Darbok, choose one of your other Creatures in play. While Lesser Darbok has energy, the chosen Creature cannot be attacked.

errata.previous_text: When you play Lesser Darbok, choose one of your other Creatures in play. The chosen Creature cannot be attacked while Lesser Darbok is in play.
errata.change: Defend has been clarified that it works as long as Lesser Darbok has energy. Tangle has been clarified to allow Lesser Darbok to act like other Creatures that attach themselves to other cards.

effects.name: Tangle
effects.text: If Lesser Darbok is defeated while defending, attach Lesser Darbok to the attacking Creature. While Lesser Darbok is attached, it cannot be involved in an attack, other cards cannot affect it and it cannot be discarded from play for having zero energy. The Creature it is attached to cannot attack. d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Lesser Darbok.

errata.previous_text: If Lesser Darbok is defeated while defending, attach Lesser Darbok to the attacking Creature. While Lesser Darbok is attached, that Creature cannot attack.
errata.change: Defend has been clarified that it works as long as Lesser Darbok has energy. Tangle has been clarified to allow Lesser Darbok to act like other Creatures that attach themselves to other cards.

text: d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Lesser Darbok.
flavor:
"It's not always easy to get the darboks, so we pick on the little ones."
— Korremar

name: Mowat

effects.name: Prickly
effects.text: As an opposing Creature removes energy from Mowat, remove one energy from that Creature.

errata.previous_text: Whenever an opposing Creature removes energy from Mowat, remove one energy from that Creature.
errata.change: Prickly has been reworded to the "As" trigger.

effects.name: Skewer
effects.text: When Mowat attacks a Creature with three energy or less, Mowat loses no energy in the attack.

flavor:
"It'll really stick it to you."
— d'Rasha

name: Nemsa

effects.name: Dreamdraft
effects.text: Whenever you play one of your d'Resh Magi's starting cards, you can immediately play one Nemsa from your hand, ignoring all costs. Nemsa cannot attack this turn.

flavor:
"That's worth a nemsa."
— d'Reshi expression meaning "valuable"

name: Obsis

powers.name: Sandaclysm
powers.text: Discard Obsis from play. Discard all Creatures from play. Cards do not prevent your Creatures from being discarded by Sandaclysm.

text: Obsis can only be played if there are no opposing Creatures in play.
flavor:
"If rain fell like sand, we'd have a verdant land."
— old d'Reshi saying

name: Olum

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: When you play Olum, add one energy to each other Olum in play.

powers.name: Aid
powers.text: Discard Olum. Add one energy to each Olum play.

flavor: Olum together now!

name: Olum Digger

powers.name: Tunnel
powers.text: Until the end of the turn, Olum Digger can attack Magi directly. Whenever Olum Digger attacks a Magi, choose any one of that Magi's Creatures. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Walk without rhythm and you won't attract the olum."
— Mohani

name: Olum Mystic

effects.name: Plague
effects.text: At the end of each player's turn, that player chooses a non-Olum Creature. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Give it some animite. They love animite"
— Nahara

name: Quanjuel

powers.name: Timewalk
powers.text: Discard Quanjuel from play. Until the end of the turn, you can play any recurring Creatures in your discard pile as if they were in your hand.

flavor:
"They drive me crazy. When they go somewhere, they get back before they
leave."
— Risha

name: Sand Hyren

effects.name: Light Side
effects.text: Each of your starting cards cost two less energy to play, to a minimum of one. Only one Light Side may be used for each starting card played.

errata.previous_text: Each of your starting cards costs two less energy to play.
errata.change: 'to a minimum of one' in Light Side was left off when Sand Hyren was reprinted in Voice of the Storms. Light Side has been clarified to correct that oversight. Light Side has been Errataed so that multiple Light Sides can't stack.

effects.name: Dark Side
effects.text: Your Magi may play Core cards as if they were d'Resh cards. d'Resh Shadow Magi may play Sand Hyren.

errata.previous_text: You can play Core cards as though they were d'Resh cards.
errata.change: 'to a minimum of one' in Light Side was left off when Sand Hyren was reprinted in Voice of the Storms. Light Side has been clarified to correct that oversight. Light Side has been Errataed so that multiple Light Sides can't stack.

text: d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Sand Hyren.
flavor:
"There are layers and layers to the sands."
— Korremar

name: Sandsifter

effects.text: As Sandsifter is being discarded from play by an opposing card, you may discard an Oracle from play. Sandsifter is not affected by the opposing card.

powers.name: Inevitable Truth
powers.text: Choose an opposing Magi. Discard one energy from the chosen Magi for each Oracle you have in play.

powers.name: Unearth
powers.text: Choose an Oracle in your discard pile. Put the chosen card into your hand.

flavor: d'Reshi-vu: the feeling that you've experienced inevitability before.

name: Sandsinger

powers.name: Ballad of the Truth
powers.text: Discard Sandsinger and one of your other cards from play to search your deck for any one d'Resh card and place that card into your hand.

flavor: The simple truth: d'Reshi have 47 different words for sand, without which their conversations would be very dull.

name: Sandstone Hyren

effects.name: Monolith
effects.text: If Sandstone Hyren is the largest Creature in play, opposing players must pay three energy from their Magi to choose it for Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Super Invulnerability
effects.text: Sandstone Hyren loses two less energy in attacks, and loses no energy from Effects during any player's Attack step.

flavor:
"Can't we just go around?"
"Ask it and find out."
— Harror and Korremar

name: Sandstorm Orshaa

effects.text: As you play Sandstorm Orshaa, reduce its cost by four. Sandstorm Orshaa is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

powers.name: Stinging Sands
powers.text: Choose a Spell in play. Discard the chosen Spell and three energy from that Spell's Magi.

flavor:
"Strange things are afoot in the d'Resh desert."
— Borse

name: Sandstorm Xyx

effects.name: Vortex
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opponent uses a Power, add two energy to Sandstorm Xyx.

powers.name: Dissipate
powers.text: Discard Sandstorm Xyx from play. Choose two Creatures in play. Reduce the chosen Creatures' energy to one.

flavor:
"All right; you want to play that way? Now it's personal!"
— Ora, Shieldmaiden

name: Sareb

effects.name: Incompetent
effects.text: Your Creatures lose one additional energy in attacks.

effects.name: Ally
effects.text: When you play Sareb, you may give control of it to another player.

flavor:
"An incompetent ally is far worse than a dangerous foe."
— d'Reshi maxim

name: Shimmering Orshaa

effects.text: As you play Shimmering Orshaa, reduce its cost by four. Shimmering Orshaa is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

powers.name: Illusion Twist
powers.text: Choose one of your other illusions in play. Discard the chosen illusion. Play a d'Resh Creature from your hand, ignoring all costs. The played Creature cannot attack this turn.

flavor: Koll and Whall would both pay handsomely for this creature's ring.

name: Skullek

effects.name: Inspire
effects.text: Each of your Creatures removes one additional energy in attacks.

effects.name: Persistence
effects.text: When one of your illusions is discarded from play, you may discard one energy from Skullek to place the card in your hand.

flavor:
"He may be small, but look what happened to the last creature to
underestimate him."
— Drajan

name: Spined Hyren

powers.name: Mental Assault
powers.text: Choose a player, and one of that player's Creatures. Look at the chosen player's hand. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature for each Spell in that player's hand.

flavor: It's not hard to rub it the wrong way.

name: Swirling Orshaa

effects.name: Morph
effects.text: As another Spell, Power, or Effect references a specific Creature type or region, if Swirling Orshaa is in play you may have it be considered that specific Creature type or region until the end of the turn.
As you play Swirling Orshaa, reduce its cost by three. Swirling Orshaa is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

flavor:
"Be careful, or I'll give you a swirlie."
— Nahara, Sandkeeper

name: Szhar

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When Szhar is discarded from play, draw two cards.

text: When you reveal a d'Resh Magi, if you have one or more recurring cards in your discard pile, you may discard one energy from your Magi to choose one recurring card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor:
"Our dreams keep returning, much the same way that the dunes keep marching
across the sands."
— Risha

name: Thrybe

effects.name: Infuse
effects.text: When you play a d'Resh Creature, you may discard Thrybe from play. If you do, place a d'Resh Spell from your hand under that Creature. Treat that Spell as if it were a Power printed on the Creature. The cost of the Power equals the cost of the Spell, and the name of the Power is the name of the Spell.

flavor:
"Have you ever actually seen one of these things around? No? Me,
neither..."
— Harresh

name: Uban

powers.name: Dream Slice
powers.text: Choose a Creature. Discard a card from your hand to discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

text: When you reveal a d'Resh Magi, if you have one or more recurring cards in your discard pile, you may discard one energy from your Magi to choose one recurring card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor:
"Sharp and swift — just like me!"
— Gherish

name: Venger

effects.name: Counter-Strike
effects.text: Whenever one of your d'Resh Creatures is attacked, before energy is removed, choose one of the attacking player's other Creatures. Remove two energy from the chosen Creature.

text: When you reveal a d'Resh Magi, if you have one or more recurring cards in your discard pile, you may discard one energy from your Magi to choose one recurring card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor:
"Violence ripples through the sands like currents in the ocean; like a
current, it always returns."
— Nahara, Sandkeeper

name: Warrior Olum

powers.name: Challenge
powers.text: Choose an opponent and any of that player's Creatures. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature unless the chosen player discards three energy from their Magi.

flavor:
"ecks ecks ECKS!"
— Warrior Olum Battle Cry

name: Wind Hyren

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Increase your Arderial or d'Resh Magi's Energize by two. A Magi can only be affected by one Invigorate at a time.

flavor:
"We have hyren sign, the likes of which no one has ever seen."
— Drajan, Elder

name: Xala

effects.name: Piercing Scream
effects.text: As an opposing Creature uses a Power, you may discard three energy from Xala to negate the Power. All costs for the Power must still be paid.
As you play Xala, reduce its cost by four. Xala is not considered to be in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated, and it cannot attack Magi directly.

flavor: Denial flows like a river.

name: Ahron

effects.name: Dust Cloud
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is attacked and defeated, you may discard two energy from Ahron. If you do, reduce the attacking Creature to one energy.

flavor: "Once you were as a dune. Now, you are but a grain."

name: Dakat

powers.name: Deja Vu
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand. The next time this turn one of your Spells or Powers removes energy from an opposing Creature, choose another Creature in play. Remove an equal amount of energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"He may not seem helpful at first, but he always comes through when you
need him."
— Ythra

name: Dey

effects.name: Balance
effects.text: If you have fewer Creatures in play than any opponent, each opposing Creature costs two additional energy to play.

flavor: "I only need one."

name: Drajan

effects.name: Fair
effects.text: Other players' cards do not use Effects during attacks.

effects.name: Fight
effects.text: Opposing Powers cost one additional energy to use.

flavor: First he levels the playing field, then he levels the opposition.

name: d'Rasha

powers.name: Foretelling
powers.text: Choose a player's deck. Look at the top three cards of the chosen deck. You may choose one of the cards and place it at the bottom of that deck. Place the remaining cards on the top of that deck in any order.

flavor: "The best way to improve your memory is to decide what you want to forget."

name: Gherish

effects.name: Abrade
effects.text: Whenever an opponent uses a Power, choose one of that player's Creatures. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Drift
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, move up to two energy from one of your Creatures to Gherish.

flavor: "Sand gets into everything..."

name: Harresh

powers.name: Time Shuffle
powers.text: Draw two cards. Place one card from your hand at the bottom of your deck.

flavor: "I'll be back before you even know I'm gone!"

name: Hasseth

effects.name: Master Illusionist
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play an illusion, draw a card.

powers.name: Banish
powers.text: Discard one of your illusions from play and discard a random card from your hand to choose a Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature.

flavor: "Despite the Avatar's words, I know better; deception is reality."

name: Mohani

effects.name: Imbue Spell
effects.text: When you play a d'Resh Creature, you may place a d'Resh Spell from your hand under that Creature. Treat that Spell as if it were a Power printed on the Creature. The cost of the Power equals the cost of the Spell, and the name of the Power is the name of the Spell.

flavor: "Oh, I have very vivid dreams. Very vivid indeed."

name: Nahara

powers.name: Remembrance
powers.text: Choose a Power on a Creature card in any discard pile that does not reference the name of the card it is printed on. Treat this Power as a copy of the chosen Power. X is the cost of the chosen Power. Shuffle the Creature whose Power was chosen into its owner's deck.

flavor:
"Now I know where all of my dreams end up."
— Sorreah

name: Nashiq

powers.name: Salvage
powers.text: Choose a card in your discard pile. Shuffle the chosen card into your deck. Until the end of the turn, the cost to play cards of the same name is reduced by three, to a minimum of one.

flavor: "The Avatar returns to us."

name: Risha

effects.name: Glorious Prophecy
effects.text: During your Energize step, if you have seven different Oracles in play, defeat an opposing Magi.

powers.name: Insight
powers.text: Reveal an Oracle in your hand. Add one energy to Risha.

flavor: "The oracles are keyed to the vast knowledge we have of the Eliwan. If only one could contain all the knowledge, that Magi would be invincible."

name: Ythra

effects.name: Clarity
effects.text: Once per turn, if you draw a d'Resh Spell, reveal the card to all opponents and draw a card.

effects.name: Prodigy
effects.text: Your d'Resh Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one. Energy discarded by your d'Resh Spells cannot be reduced.

flavor: "So what if they know it's coming? They still can't avoid it."

name: Amulet of Sand

effects.name: Native Wisdom
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play a d'Resh Spell, discard one energy from each opposing Creature.

effects.name: Native Soil
effects.text: Your non-d'Resh cards cost one additional energy to play.

flavor:
"You mean there's not enough of it just lying around? You have to carry
some of it with you?"
— Lanyx, to Korremar

name: Aubra's Canteen

effects.name: Refresh
effects.text: If you have no cards in your hand, discard Aubra's Canteen. Draw five cards.

effects.name: Refill
effects.text: If Aubra's Canteen is discarded from your hand by an opposing card, play it instead, ignoring all costs.

flavor:
"Use sand to refresh, and you won't miss water."
— Mohani

name: Aubra's Hourglass

effects.name: Slipping Sands
effects.text: All cards played in the first Powers/Relics/Spells step cost two additional energy to play.

text: When you play Aubra's Hourglass, discard all copies of Aubra's Timepiece from play. Cards cannot prevent Aubra's Timepiece from being discarded.
flavor:
"Let's do the time warp agaaaaaain!"
— Nahara, Sandkeeper

name: Avatar's Staff

effects.name: Subjective Reality
effects.text: Your Magi cannot be defeated while you have illusions in play.
When one of your illusions is defeated in an attack, discard a card from your hand.

flavor:
"Perception is reality."
— The Avatar

name: Bottled City

effects.name: Release
effects.text: You may play the Creature on Bottled City as if it were in your hand. Reduce the card's cost by three and ignore regional restrictions. Discard Bottled City after playing a Creature in this manner.

powers.name: Capture
powers.text: If there are no cards on Bottled City, choose a deck. Reveal cards from the top of the chosen deck until you reveal a Creature. Place that Creature on Bottled City. Shuffle the other revealed cards into their deck.

flavor:
"It's the oldest city in d'Resh."
"No wonder the streets are so narrow."
— Harresh and Shimmer

name: Dune Compass

effects.name: True Path
effects.text: During your Draw step, if you have three or more Oracles in play, draw an additional card.

flavor:
"Well, we're headed toward 'Nowhere'. 'Sand' is off to the left, and
'Lost' is over to the right."
— Ahron

name: Lens of Truth

powers.name: Future Sight
powers.text: Discard the top card of your deck. Until the beginning of your next turn, cards with an energy cost less than the cost of the discarded card (X equals zero) cost two less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"I can see the future, and it's a place about 30 miles east of here..."
— d'Rasha

name: Sand Cape

effects.name: Memory
effects.text: During your Play Creatures step, if you have fewer cards in your hand than any opponent, you may play one d'Resh Creature from your discard pile as if it were in your hand.

effects.name: Slips Through Your Fingers
effects.text: If Sand Cape is discarded from your hand by an opposing card, play it instead, ignoring all costs.

flavor: Overlooked like a mistake, forgettable as an old memory.

name: Sun Glasses

effects.name: Glare
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures removes energy from an opposing Magi in an attack, roll a die. Remove that much additional energy from the Magi.

flavor:
"The future's so dim, I gotta wear sun glasses!"
— Ythra

name: Ythra's Mantle

powers.name: Prepare
powers.text: Search your deck for one of your starting cards and place it into your hand.

flavor:
"Familiarity breeds contentedness."
— Ythra

name: Chill of Night
text: Choose a Creature with less energy than the number of cards in its Magi's hand. Discard the chosen Creature.
flavor:
"I thought you said the Sands were hot!"
— Lanyx

name: Crushing Sands
text: Choose an opposing Creature. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards that Creature from play, discard one energy from each of that player's Creatures. Only d'Resh Magi and d'Resh Shadow Magi can play Crushing Sands.
flavor:
"I keep looking for the grain that broke the quanjuel's back."
— Harresh

name: Crystal Vision
text: Attach Crystal Vision to your Magi. Play with your hand face up on the table. As long as there are only d'Resh cards in your hand, each of your cards costs one less energy to play, to a minimum of one. You cannot play a second Crystal Vision while this card remains attached to your Magi.
flavor:
"I have nothing to hide, Korremar. Do you?"
— Chur

name: Daydreams
text: Reverse the order of your deck. (Deal your deck, one card at a time, into a single face-down pile.) Draw a card.
flavor:
"Mmmmmm... more sand..."
— Dey

name: Deceptive Dreams
text: Choose an opponent and one of that player's Creatures. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand, discarding all of its energy. Look at the chosen player's hand. If there are any Creatures in that player's hand, play one of them on that player's side, ignoring all costs and restrictions.
flavor: "Oops!"

name: Desiccate
text: Choose one of your Creatures. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. If you do, choose a Creature in play. Discard all energy from the chosen Creature.
flavor:
"Looks like now you'made up of 98% nothing."
— d'Rasha

name: Forgotten Dreams
text: Choose four non-Spell cards in your discard pile. Shuffle the chosen cards into your deck. Draw a card.
flavor:
"No, I don't remember ever forgetting any dreams."
— Harresh

name: Forgotten Songs
text: Play Forgotten Songs when one of your Creatures is being discarded from play by another card. Put the Creature into your hand instead of the discard pile.
flavor:
"The oldest melodies are ingrained in our souls."
— Mohani

name: Forgotten Tales
text: Put the top four cards of your deck into your discard pile. Choose a non-Spell card in your discard pile and put it into your hand.
flavor:
"That's not how it was! Agram didn't have four arms!"
"But wouldn't it be cool if he did?"
— Risha and Nashiq

name: Heat of Day
text: Choose a number of Creatures up to the number of cards in your hand. Discard one energy from each chosen Creature.
flavor:
"You call this hot? I laugh on your lapel. Ha ha ha ha ha!"
— Lanyx, Crucible

name: Horizon's Mirage
text: Attach Horizon's Mirage to your Magi and place a d'Resh Creature from your hand under it. At the end of your next turn, play the Creature under Horizon's Mirage, ignoring all costs and discard Horizon's Mirage.
flavor:
"You wait, Lanyx. When it gets really hot, the horizon disappears."
— Korremar

name: Lightning Sand
text: Until the beginning of your next turn, the first time one of your cards is chosen for an opposing Power or attack, the opposing Power does nothing, or your defending Creature loses no energy in the attack.
flavor:
"Who are you?"
"No one of consequence."
"I must know..."
"Get used to disappointment."
— Togoth and Rayje

name: Oasis
text: Until the end of your next turn, Creatures and Magi do not lose energy from opposing Spells and Powers.
flavor:
"Can't stand 'em. Too wet."
— Aubra

name: Redream
text: Search your discard pile, then your deck for one copy of each of your Magi's starting cards. Add those cards to your hand. You can only play Redream once per turn. If your Magi is not d'Resh, discard a card from your hand for each card you added to your hand with redream.
flavor:
"Not beebs agaaaain..."
— Qwade

name: Sandshape
text: Discard a d'Resh Relic from play to play a d'Resh card in your hand, reducing the cost of the card by half (rounded down). Creatures played this way cannot attack this turn.
flavor:
"Dust to Relic to Dust to Creature to Dust."
— d'Reshi maxim

name: Sunburn
text: Choose a Creature. Attach Sunburn to the chosen Creature. Whenever that Creature loses energy, it loses two additional energy. If that Creature is discarded and your Magi is d'Resh, you may discard an energy from your Magi to return Sunburn to your hand at the end of the turn.
flavor:
"I feel like a fried egg."
"That's funny, 'cause you look like a—"
"Shush."
— Chur and Harror

name: Unmake
text: Choose a Creature with X energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Discard one energy from each Creature in play of the same type as the discarded Creature.
flavor:
"You know, it's at times like this that I really wish I'd listened to what
my mother told me."
"Why? What did she tell you?"
"I don't know. I didn't listen."
— Kazm and Ulk

name: Grizzled Moga

effects.name: Rampage
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, discard one energy from the defending Magi.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Grizzled Moga loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"It's more than a little disgruntled. It's a big disgruntled."
— T'lok

name: Pebble Hinko

powers.name: Skitter
powers.text: Discard a Creature from your hand to add three energy to your Magi.

flavor: Skittish doesn't begin to describe the hinko's relationship with its own shadow.

name: Rock Arboll

powers.name: Infuse
powers.text: Discard Rock Arboll from play. Add energy to your Magi equal to the energy on the smallest opposing Creature.

flavor:
T'lok came over the block
And there he saw a rock.
But it wasn't a rock...
It was a rock arboll!

name: Rock Silth

effects.name: Hide
effects.text: If an opposing Spell or Power discards Rock Silth from play, move energy up to Rock Silth's starting energy from it to your Magi and draw a card.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Rock Silth loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"You! What are you doing here?"
" Time to settle an old score... Or have you forgotten?"
— Whall and ...?

name: Rokarum

powers.name: White Wind
powers.text: Add two energy to each of your other Kybar's Teeth Creatures with less than their starting energy.

flavor: Half-Hyren, half dream, the rokarum is everyone's best friend.

name: Sandstone Hyren

effects.name: Monolith
effects.text: If Sandstone Hyren is the largest Creature in play, opposing players must pay three energy from their Magi to choose it for Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Super Invulnerability
effects.text: Sandstone Hyren loses two less energy in attacks, and loses no energy from Effects during any player's Attack step.

flavor:
"Daa, Daaa, DAAA - DaDAAAA! BOM-bom BOM-bom BOM-bom BOM-bom BOM!"
— Jagt, Prankster

name: Thoughtful Baldar

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Thoughtful Baldar loses one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Ponder
powers.text: Reveal one random card from your hand to all players. Reduce the cost of all copies of that card by two, to a minimum of one, until the end of your turn.

flavor:
"QUIET! Can't you see that he's thinking?"
— Ullig

name: Vopok

effects.text: Vopok cannot attack. During your Energize Step, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, Vopok can attack this turn.

effects.name: Great Wall
effects.text: When you play Vopok, if your Magi is Kybar's Teeth, add six energy to Vopok.

flavor:
"Stay. Good boy."
— Chur, Traitor

name: Celebrated Hero

powers.name: Pump You Up
powers.text: Choose a Burrowed Creature or a Creature with the Effect "Invulnerability". Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy. Skip your Draw step this turn.

flavor:
"I'm the king of spades! The Shovel'n man! The Spademaster! Mr.
Diggalicious! The Boss or Burrow!"

name: Traveling Healer

effects.name: Bolster
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your Creatures with less than its starting energy.

effects.name: Grudge
effects.text: When you reveal Traveling Healer, if an opposing Magi is Orothe or Weave, add five energy to Traveling Healer.

flavor:
"We're safe on a cliff on the side of Mt. Kybar."
"Ah. This is obviously some strange usage of the word 'safe' that I hadn't
previously been aware of."
— Targ'n and Gar

name: M'ck

effects.name: Rock Out
effects.text: Each of your cards with the word 'rock' or 'rocks' in its name costs two less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Flint
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play a card with the word 'stone' or 'stones' in its name, draw a card.

flavor: "You're right, Whall. I do make this look easy!"

name: Emec's Forge

effects.name: Recycle
effects.text: Once per turn, as one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures is being defeated, or being discarded from play by an opposing card while it has energy, you may discard one of your Relics from play. If you do, leave your Creature in play with its current energy or restore it to the energy it had before the attack instead of discarding it.

flavor:
"We can rebuild it. We have the technology. We can make it better than it
was before. Better, stronger, faster."
— Emec, Ringsmith

name: Gogor's Spade

effects.name: Paydirt
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, draw a card.

flavor:
"Talk to the spade..."
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero

name: Spirit of the Teeth
text: You may play this card only when your Kybar's Teeth Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, it gains "Effect — Tough Stuff: Whenever this Magi loses energy from an opposing card, it loses two less energy." You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "By your powers combined..."

name: Stand and Take It
text: Choose one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures. Attach Stand and Take It to the chosen Creature. The next time the chosen Creature is attacked, discard Stand and Take It. The chosen Creature loses no energy in the attack.
flavor:
"Ow. Quit it."
— Targ'n

name: Aegris

effects.name: Bypass
effects.text: If Aegris is frozen, it can attack Magi directly.

effects.name: Shatter
effects.text: Whenever Aegris attacks a Magi, choose one of that Magi's Creatures. You may discard Aegris from play before energy is removed to discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor: It's jealous of other dream creatures, and willing to do something about it.

name: Blizzard Hyren

powers.name: Storm
powers.text: Discard one energy from each opposing frozen Creature. Discard on energy from each opposing frozen Magi for each of that Magi's frozen Creatures.

powers.name: Fury
powers.text: Blizzard Hyren can attack twice this turn.

flavor: They'll knock the wind into you.

name: Djarmander

effects.text: While Djarmander is in play, all Relics in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.

effects.name: Dreamdrain
effects.text: When an opposing Relic is discarded from play, add two energy to Djarmander.

flavor: As deadly as they are unpronounceable.

name: Dryte

effects.name: Snowball
effects.text: The first time each turn that Dryte attacks a frozen Creature, add three energy to Dryte after energy is removed and it can immediately attack a second Creature.

flavor:
"Two drytes don't make it wrong."
— Helgrem

name: Frost Hyren

effects.text: While Frost Hyren is in play, all Creatures in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.

effects.name: Frostbite
effects.text: Whenever any player plays a Relic, discard one energy from each of that player's Creatures.

flavor: Around these beasts, water of life turns crunchy.

name: Frost Raxis

powers.name: Thermal Stress
powers.text: Choose a Relic in play. That Relic's player must discard one of their Relics from play. If the discarded Relic is not the one you chose, add two energy to Frost Raxis.

flavor:
"Eenie, meenie, mynie —" SMASH "D'oh!"
— Emaya

name: Furok Protector

effects.name: Thick Coat
effects.text: When you play Furok Protector, choose an opposing Magi. Set Furok Protector's energy equal to the chosen Magi's energize.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Furok Protector is not affected by Core Spells and Powers.

flavor: A Magi's best friend.

name: Garlak

effects.name: Cold Burn
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a Creature. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. Discard two additional energy is that Creature is frozen.

flavor:
"Beware the Garlak's breath!"
"Why? Is it that cold?"
"No, it stinks!"
— Fray and Emaya

name: Glacier Hyren

effects.name: Magic Resistance
effects.text: Players must pay two additional energy from their Magi to choose Glacier Hyren for a Spell.

powers.name: Frostbite
powers.text: Move one energy from each frozen Creature to Glacier Hyren.

flavor: It moves less than a mile a month, but two or three years from now, be scared.

name: Gransaber

effects.name: Chill
effects.text: Whenever Gransaber attacks, it removes two additional energy.

powers.name: Ferocity
powers.text: Discard one of your other Nar Creatures from play to restore Grandsaber to its starting energy.

flavor: I'm tired; pop me a cold one!

name: Great White Narth

effects.name: Overwhelm
effects.text: Whenever Great White Narth attacks, after energy is removed, add one energy to Great White Narth for each of the defending player's frozen Creatures.

powers.name: Sustain
powers.text: Discard Great White Narth from play. If Great White Narth defeated an opposing Creature in an attack this turn, add five energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"It's a real beauty, eh?"
— Bronn

name: Grendile

effects.name: Snow Plow
effects.text: Whenever Grendile attacks a Creature, after energy is removed, discard energy from that Creature's Magi equal to the energy on Grendile.

flavor:
"Ice, with attitude."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Hunter Furok

effects.name: Retrieve
effects.text: Whenever Hunter Furok attacks a Magi, add energy to your Magi equal to the number of the defending player's Relics in play.

effects.name: Chill
effects.text: When Hunter Furok attacks, it removes two additional energy.

flavor: With one of these looming over your shoulder, you can't get anything done.

name: Ice Arboll

powers.name: Ice Pack
powers.text: If Ice Arboll is frozen, discard it to add two energy to each of your Creatures.

flavor:
"Although our song is way too long,
We find there's something worse;
We've just been told of arbolls cold
We need another verse!"
— The Arbolit, verse after the last verse

name: Iceberg Hyren

effects.name: The Rest Is Unseen
effects.text: The first time Iceberg Hyren is attacked, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If yu do, add nine energy to Iceberg Hyren before energy is removed. This Effect cannot be copied.

flavor: It likes to fight foes of huge size, and has taken down some that are truly titanic.

name: Icefield Ashryte

powers.name: Thermal Stress
powers.text: Choose a card in play of a different region than its Magi. Discard the chosen card.

flavor: Frost sears the skins as readily as flame.

name: Ice Furok

effects.name: Smash
effects.text: When Ice Furok attacks a frozen Creature, it loses no energy in the attack.

flavor:
"I hear they're real Furokious — OW! Ow ow ow ow ow!"
— Marella

name: Ice Hyren

effects.name: Shared Strength
effects.text: If your Magi's Energize is greater than each opposing Magi's, Ice Hyren gains ENERGIZE: 1.

effects.name: Ravage
effects.text: When Ice Hyren attacks and defeats a Creature, choose an opposing Relic. Discard the chosen Relic.

flavor:
"Well, it was nice while it lasted."
— Eryss, the Insane

name: Ickle

effects.name: Spike
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Relic, choose one of that players Creatures. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor: They say that no two ickles are alike, but who has seen all the ickles?

name: Kintor

effects.name: Snowblind
effects.text: Whenever Kintor attacks, it does not remove energy from the defending Creature as normal. Instead, roll a die. Remove that much energy from the defending Creature.

flavor:
"Whenever it fights, someone ends up hurting. There's just no telling
who."
— Fray

name: Korul

effects.name: Icy Touch
effects.text: Whenever Korul attacks, before energy is removed, discard energy from the defending Creature equal to the number of the defending player's Relics in play.

flavor: He who has the most toys, still pays.

name: Krenkrajak

effects.text: While Krenkrajak is in play, all Magi in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use. Spells cost frozen Magi one additional energy to play.

effects.name: Thick Skinned
effects.text: Krenkrajak is not affected by opposing Powers.

flavor:
"Did you say brisk? I'll show you BRISK, baby!"
- Balachron

name: Kyroll

effects.name: Drift Back
effects.text: If Kyroll is defeated in an attack while frozen, return it to its owner's hand.

powers.name: Smash
powers.text: Choose a frozen Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor: "What dat, hammer? You not like puny Core Magi? Me either..."

name: Mombak

powers.name: Cold Pack
powers.text: Choose another Creature. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. Add two additional energy if that Creature is frozen.

flavor:
"This is a greeting?"
— Eidon, neck-deep in snow

name: Rask

effects.name: Chill
effects.text: When Rask attacks, it removes two additional energy.

powers.name: Satiate
powers.text: Discard Rask from play. If your Magi is Nar, Creature with more than their starting energy cannot attack until the beginning of your next turn.

flavor: Light creatures can walk across the snow. Big creatures have to walk through it.

name: Saitorr

effects.name: Snuggles
effects.text: As the beginning of your turn, if your Magi is Nar, you may discard Saitorr from play. If you do, draw a card for each energy on your Magi above his or her starting energy, to a maximum of five.

flavor: "They're bouncy flouncy trouncy pouncy fun fun fun fun fun!"

name: Sarf

powers.name: Snatch
powers.text: Choose an opposing Relic. Discard the chosen Relic. Sarf cannot attack this turn. Use this Power only before your Attack step.

powers.name: Freezerburn
powers.text: If Sarf is frozen, choose a Magi. Discard energy from the chosen Magi equal to that Magi's energize. Discard Sarf.

flavor: Gimmie!

name: Snow Barl Pup

effects.name: Dream Draft
effects.text: When an opponent draws a card outside their Draw step, you may play Snow Barl Pup, paying all costs. If your Magi is Nar, ignore all costs when you use this Effect. You can only play one Snow Barl Pup this way per turn.

flavor:
"Alas, poor pup, for I knew him well."
"Oh, quit being so dramatic."
— Blu and Borse

name: Snow Hyren

effects.name: Cold and Colder
effects.text: Whenever a frozen Creature is attacked, add one energy to Snow Hyren before energy is removed.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose a Creature in play. Add X energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: Watch where the Hyren go... Don't get eaten by the snow!

name: Sunglare Celphet

effects.name: Reflect
effects.text: As an opposing Spell or Power removes energy from one of your Creatures, you may discad Sunglare Celphet from play to choose a Creature or Magi. Discard an equal amount of energy from the chosen card.

flavor: Colder than Warrada's kiss.

name: Tithragar

effects.name: Painful Bark
effects.text: When you play Tithragar, remove two energy from each Core Creature and Core Magi in play.

effects.name: Painful Bite
effects.text: Whenever Tithragar attacks, if that Creature's Magi is a Naroom Shadow Magi, discard the defending Creature from play before energy is removed.

flavor:
"A tithragar once bit my sister."
— Hrada

name: Vrak

effects.name: Really Really Big
effects.text: When you play Vrak, add six energy to it.
If Vrak is your only Nar Creature in play, discard it.

flavor:
"He's right on top of us! Do you suppose her is using the same wind we
are?"
— Stradus

name: Wasperine Stalker

effects.name: Blur
effects.text: If your Magi is Nar or Naroom, you may play Wasperine Stalker at the beginning of your Attack step. If you do, Wasperine Stalker can and must attack Magi directly this turn. When you play Wasperne Stalker, add two energy to it if your Magi is Woot!.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Wasperine Stalker.
flavor: They always put a little run in their stalkings.

name: Worgle

powers.name: Share
powers.text: Discard Worgle from play. Choose a number of Creatures equal to the number of your frozen Creatures in play. Discard two energy from each of the chosen Creatures.

flavor: A snow-ball fighter.

name: Yaromant

effects.text: While Yaromant is in play, all Creatures in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.

effects.name: Scavenge
effects.text: When a frozen card is discarded, add one energy to Yaromant.

flavor: The timely arrival of the Magi from Nar greatly helped the Naroom resistance.

name: Yaw

powers.name: Ice Pack
powers.text: Return Yaw to your hand. Choose a frozen Creature. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

flavor: The bigger the better.

name: Zyavu

effects.text: While Zyavu is in play, all Creatures in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.

effects.name: Lingering Chill
effects.text: When Zyavu is discarded from play, all Creatures remain frozen until the end of the turn.

flavor: "I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice dreams."

name: Balachron

effects.name: Numbing Wit
effects.text: While Balachron has less than four energy, all Creatures and Relics in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.

flavor: "Tact is for those not intelligent enough to use sarcasm."

name: Bronn

effects.text: Each of your non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

powers.name: Snowball
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures. Double the chosen Creature's energy. That Creature cannot add energy to other cards and its energy cannot be moved to other cards. Discard that Creature at the end of the turn.

flavor: "You young'uns these day! I walked uphill, barefoot, through five feet of snow, both ways, and I never complained!"

name: Emaya

effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose an opponent. Increase your energize by one for each Relic the chosen opponent has in play.
Each of your Non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

powers.name: Improvise
powers.text: Discard a Relic from your hand to choose a Creature. Discard two energy from or add two energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: "Oh boy! Water of life! Just what I was hoping you'd get!"

name: Erisa

effects.name: Nomad
effects.text: Erisa's frozen Creatures do not count as being in play when checking to see if she is defeated.

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When Erisa is defeated, leave her frozen Creatures and frozen Relics in play. When you reveal your next Magi, discard all of your Relics from play if that Magi is not Nar.

flavor: "Honey, the leftovers are in the freezer!"

name: Fray

effects.name: Big Chill
effects.text: Whenever one of your frozen Creatures is in an attack, remove one energy from the opposing Magi before energy is removed.

flavor: "I'm just like everybody else; just a little luckier."

name: Halsted

effects.name: Crack
effects.text: Opposing Relics cost two additional energy to play.
Each of your non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

flavor: "I once dueled a Magi from Orothe. She was very frustrated with me for some reason."

name: Helgrem

effects.name: One for All
effects.text: Players cannot play a Creature if a copy of that Creature is in play.

powers.name: All for One
powers.text: Discard a Creature from your hand. Choose a copy of the discarded Creature in play. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

flavor: "I'd like to greet this Eidon guy I keep hearing about."

name: Koza

effects.name: Borrow
effects.text: Koza can use Powers on opposing Relics.

effects.name: Steal
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play a Relic from your hand, choose a Magi. Discard two energy from the chosen Magi.

flavor: "The time of prophecy has arrived. It's time for Nar to move."

name: Laranel

effects.name: Cold Shoulder
effects.text: Opponents must discard one energy from their Magi to choose Laranel or one of her Creatures for a Spell or Power.
Each of your non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

flavor: In a world of power, hers is the voice of order.

name: Odavast

effects.name: Ice Wall
effects.text: Your frozen Creatures lose two less energy in attacks.
Each of your non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

flavor:
"He's built like a brick icehouse."
— Zannah

name: Thast

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Increase Thast's Energize by one for each of your frozen Nar Creatures.

powers.name: Ice Grinder
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard energy from the chosen Creature equal to Thast's Energize.

flavor: "You don't know the meaning of the word 'cold', bub."

name: Ust

effects.name: Gambit
effects.text: The first time each turn that Ust is attacked, you may discard two cards from your hand to discard the attacking Creature before energy is removed.
Each of your non-Nar, non-Universal cards costs one additional energy to play.

flavor: "Two can play that game."

name: Velouria

powers.name: Adore
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures. The chosen Creature can attack Magi directly this turn. When that Creature does, add energy to Velouria equal to the amount removed from the opposing Magi in the attack.

flavor: "Nar's eleven months of winter, and one month of thin ice."

name: Blizzard Core

effects.name: Coriolis
effects.text: At the beginning of your Energize step, before you energize, choose a Magi. If that Magi has no Creatures in play and your Magi has more energy than the chosen Magi's starting energy, discard Blizzard Core and defeat the chosen Magi.

errata.previous_text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a Magi. If that Magi has no Creatures in play and your Magi has more energy than the chosen Magi's starting energy, discard Blizzard Core and defeat the chosen Magi.
errata.change: Coriolis' triggering is now at the Energize Step, before you energize, instead of the beginning of the turn so that Blizzard Core can't be abused with Gargagnor's Perpetual Motion Effect.

flavor: Even the untalented can still draw upon the blizzard's core.

name: Bronn's Battle Staff

effects.name: Slapstick
effects.text: When an opposing Spell or Power chooses your Magi, you may discard one of your frozen cards from play. If you do, the Spell or Power does nothing.

flavor:
"A little humor never hurt anyone? Let's see if we can fix that."
— Bronn

name: Cauldron of Ice

effects.name: Stir In
effects.text: Immediately after you play a Nar Spell, you may discard one energy from your Magi to place the Spell under Cauldron of Ice.

powers.name: Dish Out
powers.text: Place any card under Cauldron of Ice into your hand. Discard a card from your hand.

flavor:
"So what's so tough about teaching someone how it works?"
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Dreamdrain Charm

effects.name: Dreamdrain
effects.text: Reduce each Magi's Energize by the number of that Magi's Spells and Relics in play. At the beginning of their turn, any player may discard all of their Relics and Spells from play to discard Dreamdrain Charm from play.

flavor: It siphons away thoughts and dreams, trapping them before they even begin.

name: Essence of Frost

effects.text: While Essence of Frost is in play, all cards in play are frozen; Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use. Spells cost frozen Magi one additional energy to play.

flavor:
"Oooooh... pretty.."
"Brrrr... pretty cold..."
— Bria and Orlon

name: Hailstorm Pendant

powers.name: All Hail You
powers.text: If you have no Creatures in play, choose a Creature in play. Remove energy from the chosen Creature equal to your Magi's energize.

flavor:
"Now that's what I call a hard rain."
— Taisa

name: Icefang Battlesled

powers.name: Zoom
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. That Creature can and must attack a Magi directly this turn. Use this power only before the Attack step.

flavor:
"Now I know what it's like to be an eebit running from a charging
carillion."
— Orwin, Vacationer

name: Ice Lens

effects.name: Magnify
effects.text: During your Draw step, if you have a frozen card in play, draw an additional card.

flavor:
"Hmmm, looks like snow."
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Meteorological Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Icy Heart
text: Each of your cards with an energy cost (X equals zero) greater than or equal to your Magi's Energize costs one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.
flavor:
"It almost seems too small. Three sizes too small."
— Orwin, Vacationer

name: Icy Prison

effects.name: Cold Comfort
effects.text: Reduce each Magi's Energize by the number of frozen Creatures that Magi has in play.
If any player has no Creatures in play, discard Icy Prison from play.

flavor: The more you grow, the tighter it seems.

name: Instant Fortress

powers.name: Bastion
powers.text: Choose an opponent. If you did not attack the chosen opponent or any of that opponent's cards this turn, that player cannot choose your Magi or Creatures for Powers or Spells until your next turn or until Instant Fortress leaves play. Use this Power only after your Attack step.

flavor:
"How are those snowballs coming?"
— Laranel, Ice Queen

name: Void Stone

effects.name: Demand
effects.text: Each opposing non-Nar Relic costs one additional energy to play.

powers.name: Supply
powers.text: Discard one of your Relics from play. Draw a card.

flavor: The void annoyed.

name: Blizzard
text: Choose one of your Creatures in play and one opposing Creature. Discard both chosen Creatures. Play Blizzard only after the Attack step.
flavor: "I've been waiting a long time for this."

name: Brittlebreak
text: All Creatures lose energy equal to the number of their Magi's Relics.
flavor:
"They'd be so much more fun to play with if they weren't so... fragile."
— Laranel

name: Crushing Ice
text: Choose an opposing Creature. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards that Creature from play, discard three energy from the chosen Creature's Magi. Only Nar and Nar Shadow Magi can play Crushing Ice.
flavor:
"For something that floats, ice is awfully heavy."
— Bronn

name: Crystallize
text: Choose a Creature. Attach Crystallize to the chosen Creature. While Crystallize is attached, the chosen Creature cannot attack. When Crystallize is discarded, draw a card.
flavor: "Halt!... No, no, uh... Don't move!... uh, no, that's not it... uh... Freeze! Ah, there we go." — Halsted

name: Exposure
text: Each non-Nar Magi loses energy equal to their Energize. Each Core Magi loses two additional energy.
flavor:
"We need to get Korg a royal cloak. He's already exposed plenty enough for
me."
— Olabra, the Greatest Elder Ever

name: Ice Rupture
text: Choose one of your frozen Nar Creatures. Discard your Creature to choose an opposing Magi and one of that Magi's Creatures. Discard as much energy as your frozen Creature had from each chosen card.
flavor: A frozen explosion.

name: Refract
text: Attach this card to your Magi. When an opponent chooses exactly one of your Nar Creatures for a Spell or Power, you may discard Refract from play. If you do, the Spell or Power affects one of your Nar Creatures of your choice instead.
flavor:
"Like a poor marksman, you keep missing the target!"
— Bronn

name: Shattering Wind
text: Until the end of the turn, whenever one of your Creatures attacks, discard one energy from the defending Magi before energy is removed. If the opposing Magi is frozen, discard one additional energy.
flavor: In Nar, the wind breaks you.

name: Shattershards
text: Choose a Magi in play. Discard one of the Magi's Relics. Remove energy from one of that Magi's Creatures equal to the Relic's cost, plus two.
flavor: 'Room temperature' is a matter of perspective.

name: Snowball
text: Play when an opposing card discards one of your Relics or Spells from play, or discards one of your Creatures that has energy. Choose an opposing cards of the same type (Creature, Relic, or Spell). Discard the chosen card.
flavor: A rolling snowball gathers many enemies.

name: Spirit of Nar
text: You may play this card only when your Nar Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. The current player cannot play any cards from their hand until the end of your next turn. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: We're not as cold-hearted as we seem.

name: Thin Ice
text: Add one energy to each of your frozen Creatures. Remove one energy from each opposing frozen Creature.
flavor: Also known as "summer".

name: Whiteout
text: Until the end of your next turn, all Creatures in play are frozen. Powers on frozen cards cost one additional energy to use.
flavor:
"Sure, you can't see anything, but you're not missing anything, either."
— Halstad

name: Ember Hyren

effects.name: Heat Feed
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures attacks, add one energy to Ember Hyren.

powers.name: Singe
powers.text: Choose a Creature. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Are all men from Cald loud-mouthed braggarts?"
"Yeah, but I'm the best."
— Tryn and Barak

name: Fird

effects.name: Perch
effects.text: Whenever you play a Furok, you can play one copy of Fird from your hand or discard pile, paying all costs. Fird cannot attack this turn.

flavor:
"F-F-F-Fird, fird, fird, fird is the word."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Forest Wudge

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Creature, add one energy to Forest Wudge. If the Creature played is Naroom, add an additional energy to Forest Wudge.

effects.name: Home Turf
effects.text: When you play Forest Wudge, if any opposing Magi is Naroom or Naroom Shadow, draw a card.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Forest Wudge, ignoring regional penalties.
flavor:
"Anklebiter."
— Eidon, Elder

name: Grendile

effects.name: Snow Plow
effects.text: Whenever Grendile attacks a Creature, after energy is removed, discard energy from that Creature's Magi equal to the energy on Grendile.

flavor:
"Dude, that is so cool!"
— Yaki, Core Stalker

name: Leaf Chogo

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Leaf Chogo is not affected by opposing Core Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Leaf Storm
effects.text: After Leaf Chogo attacks, you may discard it from play. If you do, add one energy to each of your Creatures. Discard one energy from each opposing Core Creature.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Leaf Chogo.
flavor:
"Hey you, get offa my moon!"
— Yaki, to Warrada

name: Twunk

effects.name: Timber
effects.text: Whenever one of your Naroom Creatures with less energy than Twunk is attacked, remove two energy from the attacking Creature before energy is removed.

flavor:
Roasted Twunk - 5 animite
— From the menu at Gar's Fried Eebit Shack

name: Wasperine Stalker

effects.name: Blur
effects.text: If your Magi is Nar or Naroom, you may play Wasperine Stalker at the beginning of your Attack step. If you do, Wasperine Stalker can and must attack Magi directly this turn. When you play Wasperne Stalker, add two energy to it if your Magi is Woot!.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Wasperine Stalker.
flavor:
"Surrender!"
"You wish to surrender to me? Very well, I accept."
— Togoth and Yaki

name: Poad, Innkeeper

effects.name: Hearty
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Creaturs is attacked, you may move any amount of energy from Poad to that Creature. Add an additional energy to the Creature if it is Nar or Naroom.

powers.name: Party
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures. Add energy to the chosen Creature equal to the number of Creatures you have in play. The chosen Creature cannot use Powers this turn. Discard the Creature at the end of the turn.

flavor: "Have you had breakfast today?"

name: Wence the Wanderer

powers.name: Wence is Here
powers.text: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is a Naroom Spell or a Creature with the Effect "Weave", reveal it to all players and place it into your hand. Otherwise, discard it or return it to the top of your deck.

flavor: "Minani. Why'd it have to be Minani?"

name: Wence's Travelog

effects.name: Wence Was Here
