effects.text: During your Energize step, if you have a Naroom Creature and a different Weave Creature in play, add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"There I was, knee-deep in bungaloos..."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Overgrowth
text: Choose a Creature. Attach this Spell to the chosen Creature. While Overgrowth is in play, that Creature gains "ENERGIZE: 3".
flavor:
"I don't like cleaning... so I just don't come back."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Yaki, Core Stalker

effects.name: Absorb Darkness
effects.text: All of your Spells and Powers that affect Core cards you control may instead affect your Naroom cards.

effects.name: Overwhelm
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, you may add two energy to it before energy is removed, or four energy if it is attacking a Core card. If you do, discard your Creature at the end of your Attack step.

text: Yaki can only play Core, Naroom, and Universal cards, but ignores regional penalties and restrictions. Yaki cannot be in a Magi stack with Core Magi.
flavor: "Yes, I use the powers of the Core. It's not like they gave me a choice."

name: Poad's Secret Sauce

effects.name: Flavor
effects.text: Whenever one of your Spells or Powers adds energy to exactly one of your Creatures, add an additional energy to that Creature.

flavor:
Tastes great!
More filling!

name: Spirit of Naroom
text: You may play this card only when your Naroom Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, it permanently gains "Effect — Eternal Vigor: Whenever one of your Naroom Creatures is discarded from play by an opposing card, add one energy to your Magi." You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Heart!"

name: Cawh

effects.name: Fearsome
effects.text: Cawh looses three less energy in attacks. Other cards cannot prevent Cawh from loosing energy.

errata.previous_text: Cawh loses three less energy in attacks. Other cards cannot prevent Cawh from losing energy.
errata.change: The first nameless Effect has been clarified to allow your cards to change Cawh's controller.

effects.text: Cawh can only be played during the Play Creatures step. You cannot play Creatures while Cawh is in play, and you cannot play Cawh if you have other Creatures in play.

errata.previous_text: If Cawh is discarded or returned to your hand by an opposing card while it has energy, discard six energy from Cawh instead. Opposing cards cannot make Cawh change controllers.
errata.change: The first nameless Effect has been clarified to allow your cards to change Cawh's controller.

effects.text: Cawh can only be played during the Play Creatures step. You cannot play Creatures while Cawh is in play, and you cannot play Cawh if you have other Creatures in play.

flavor: On a scale of one to ten, there is no number large enough.

name: Iceberg Hyren

effects.name: The Rest Is Unseen
effects.text: The first time Iceberg Hyren is attacked, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If yu do, add nine energy to Iceberg Hyren before energy is removed. This Effect cannot be copied.

flavor:
"Who knew water could be harder than rock?"
— T'lok

name: Sarazen Keeper

powers.name: Forged Alliance
powers.text: If you have a Hyren in play, add one energy to each of your Sarazen in play.

powers.name: Strength
powers.text: If you have at least two Sarazens in play, draw a card.

flavor:
"I am not my hyren's keeper... He is!"
— Voda

name: Surf Diel

effects.name: Comb the Beach
effects.text: Whenever one of your Relics is discarded from play by an opposing card, add two energy to Surf Diel.

powers.name: Reckon
powers.text: Discard Surf Diel from play. Choose a Cald Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature. Use this Power only before the Attack Step.

flavor:
"We can't let them into the Vault! Oh, Blu, What'll we do?"
"You got us inna this mess, lass. Time you get us out!"
— Bria and Blu

name: Sylorum

effects.name: Relic Affinity
effects.text: When you use a Power on one of your Relics, you may have Sylorum pay the energy cost instead of your Magi. If you do, reduce the cost of the Power by one, to a minimum of zero.

flavor:
"Wouldn't be so bad if it'd just stop making that 'DWEEEEEE' noise."
— Ebylon

name: Tidal Karak

powers.name: Sunken Treasure
powers.text: Play a non-Universal Relic from any opponent's discard pile, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties. When Tidal Karak leaves play, discard all Relics played by this Power.

text: Orothe Shadow Magi can play Tidal Karak.
flavor:
"I wish I knew what they were doing down there."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Aula, Mindseeker

powers.name: Windsight
powers.text: Discard a Spell from your hand. Draw a number of cards equal to half of the Spell's energy cost, rounded down (X equals zero) and reveal them to your opponent. You cannot draw any more cards this turn.

flavor:
"All's fair in war. Nothing's fair in love."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Brothers of Vengeance

effects.name: And We're Not Happy
effects.text: During your Draw step, if you play a Relic this turn, draw an additional card.

powers.name: We're Back
powers.text: If you have more Relics in play than any other player, discard a Relic you own from play to add two energy to each of your Creatures.

text: Brothers of Vengeance count as two Magi.
flavor: "Arrr, we aren't half the men we used to be."

name: Karse

effects.name: Vengeance
effects.text: If any opposing Magi is Cald, increase Karse's energize by two.

effects.name: Fury
effects.text: Each of your Orothe and Universal cards that costs seven or more energy costs three less energy to play.

flavor: "I'm givin' them all I got!"

name: Hubdra's Chest

effects.name: Lock Box
effects.text: When an opponent chooses one of your Relics for a Spell, Power or Effect, discard one energy from that player's Magi.

effects.name: Safe Deposit
effects.text: When your Magi is defeated, all of your other Orothe Relics stay in play.

flavor:
"I hear it's quite large."
— O'Qua, Summoner

name: Karak Ink

effects.name: Cloud
effects.text: When you play Karak Ink, choose an opponent. Whenever that opponent draws a card outside of their Draw step, they must reveal it to all players. If the revealed card is a Creature, add one energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"YECCH!"
— Evil Evu

name: Orathan Amulet

effects.name: Spray
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your Orathans in play.

powers.name: Pod
powers.text: Search your deck for an Orathan card. Place that card into your hand.

flavor:
"Professor of archeology, expert on the Eliwan, and... how does one say
it? Obtainer of rare antiquities."
— Sive

name: Ripple
text: All Creatures with less energy than their starting energy gain one energy. All Creatures with more energy than their starting energy lose one energy.
flavor:
"One single ripple in the ocean can cause a devastating storm in the Kybar
highlands."
— Mobis, Elder

name: Spirit of Orothe
text: You may play this card only when your Orothe Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, replace his or her starting cards line with "STARTING: Orothean Goggles, Hubdra's Cube, One Orothe Creature". You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Water!"

name: Bulabantu

effects.name: Ambush
effects.text: When you play Bulabantu, choose a Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Spotted a Bulabantu."
— Paradwyn maxim meaning "too late"

name: Gwomba

effects.name: Maximum Warp
effects.text: Once per turn as you are playing another Paradwyn Creature, you may change its starting energy to any other number until the end of the turn. You cannot change it to less than one or to more than Gwomba's current energy.

effects.name: Maximum Fury
effects.text: All Bograth Creatures lose one additional energy in attacks.

flavor:
"When it's well fed, we're all well fed!"
— Boria, Elder

name: Janx

effects.name: Bicker
effects.text: Whenever Janx attacks, discard two energy from each of the defending Magi's stalked Creatures after energy is removed.

flavor:
"Good tracker, decent navigator. Lousy conversationalist."
— Liriel

name: Kwup

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Choose any one stalked Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Yeah, I really kwupped up on his hide."
— Bazha, Lifekeeper

name: Terkoz

effects.name: Spotlight
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Terkoz was the only Creature you played this turn, add one energy to each of your Creatures.

flavor:
"When it calls, we all answer."
— Arawan

name: Torpar

effects.name: Community
effects.text: Whenever one of your cards adds energy to all of your Creatures, add an additional energy to Torpar.

effects.name: Protection
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell or Power removes energy from any of your other Creatures, remove the energy from Torpar instead.

flavor:
"Hey, I'm a reasonable guy. But I've just experienced some very
unreasonable things."
— Pok

name: Tropical Plith

effects.name: Confer
effects.text: During your Draw step, if you played a Creature with the Effect "Dreamwarp" this turn, draw an additional card.

flavor:
"Wow! There's a whole plith-ora of 'em! Ow! What was that for?"
— a slightly bruised Marella

name: Tropical Jumbor

effects.name: Scout
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Tropical Jumbor did not attack this turn, add two energy to it.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Tropical Jumbor is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Tropical Jumbor and any one of your other Paradwyn or Weave Creatures.

flavor: It pounces as gracefully as a slab of granite.

name: Archid

effects.name: Stunning
effects.text: Opposing Creatures cannot attack and use Powers on the same turn.

flavor: "Not my looks, my fists!"

name: Kiersta

effects.name: Swoon
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, you may add five energy to Kiersta. If you do, skip your Attack step this turn. You cannot use Swoon on your next turn.

flavor:
"Falling asleep at random is one thing, but falling asleep on a vine
swing?"
— Bazha, to Emlob

name: Pok

effects.name: Brilliantly Absent-Minded
effects.text: During your Draw step, draw two additional cards, then discard a card at random from your hand.

effects.name: Peer Pressure
effects.text: When you reveal Pok, if your previous two Magi were Blygt and Brog, in either order, Pok becomes Bograth instead of Paradwyn until the end of the game.

flavor:
"He can calculate the air-speed velocity of an unladen fird, but he can't
quite remember which side of the war he's on."
— Bazha, to Emlob

name: Liriel's Cape

effects.name: Dazzle
effects.text: Each of your Creatures in play with the Effect "Dreamwarp" has an additional three starting energy.

powers.name: Mass Heal
powers.text: Discard Liriel's Cape from play. If there is at least one opposing Creature, restore all Creatures with less than their starting energy to their starting energy.

flavor:
"I'm full of surprises."
— Liriel

name: Three-Leaf Clover

effects.name: Little Lucky
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose one of your Creatures. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Lotta Lucky
effects.text: When an opposing Spell or Power affects your Magi, you may discard Three Leaf Clover from play. If you do, your cards are unaffected by the Spell or Power, and you draw a card.

flavor:
"I can only ever find the boring old four-leaf kind."
— Kiersta

name: Snare
text: Play Snare at the beginning of an opponent's Attack step. Choose one of that player's Creatures. The chosen Creature cannot attack this turn. If your Magi is not Paradwyn, discard a card from your hand.
flavor:
Swoosh! "Hey! What're you doin' hanging up there?!"
— All High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Deductive Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Spirit of Paradwyn
text: You may play this card only when your Paradwyn Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. On your next turn, you may play Paradwyn Creatures during your first Powers/Relics/Spells step. The cost of each Paradwyn Creature you play this way is increased by two and cannot be reduced. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor:
"My turn to step up and take a swing!"
— Yricho

name: Crystal Lascinth

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Crystal Lascinth is not affected by Core Spells or Powers.

effects.name: Spines
effects.text: Whenever one of your Underneath Creatures is attacked, remove one energy from the attacking Creature before energy is removed. Remove an additional energy if the attacking Creature is Core.

flavor:
"We have nothing to fear... but them! Run!"
— Togoth

name: Freep

effects.name: Refresh
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your Magi is Underneath, you may discard Freep from play to add five energy to your Magi.

flavor: Freeps only emergy from their caves when they are most needed, and that makes them popular.

name: Ormalet

powers.name: Tantrum
powers.text: Discard two energy from each non-Underneath Creature in play.

flavor:
"You couldn't hit the broad side of an ormalet!"
— Radget, to Togoth

name: Rabid Bisiwog

effects.name: Feisty
effects.text: Whenever Rabid Bisiwog attacks, you may choose two Creatures. Rabid Bisiwog attacks both Creatures and removes its energy from both defending Creatures at the same time.
If Rabid Bisiwog is burrowed, discard it from play.

text: Korremar and Underneath Shadow Magi can play Rabid Bisiwog.
flavor: "RWAGHERYARGHERERWAGHERYARGH!"

name: Sarazen Keeper

powers.name: Forged Alliance
powers.text: If you have a Hyren in play, add one energy to each of your Sarazen in play.

powers.name: Strength
powers.text: If you have at least two Sarazens in play, draw a card.

flavor:
"Everybody relax, I'm here. Where exactly is here, again?"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero

name: Trogovo

effects.name: Inspire
effects.text: Draw two additional cards during your Draw step. Reduce your Magi's Energize by two.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, any Core Magi may discard three energy to discard Trogovo.

flavor:
"Great minds think a ... think a ... errrr..."
— Myka

name: Celebrated Hero

powers.name: Pump You Up
powers.text: Choose a Burrowed Creature or a Creature with the Effect "Invulnerability". Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy. Skip your Draw step this turn.

flavor:
"Why do you keep asking me that? Of course I can dig it!"
— Gogor, to Yaki

name: Myka

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Myka loses no more than two energy from each opposing Spell, Power or attack.

flavor: "You shovel real good, Gogor. But that doesn't make you a superhero."

name: Gogor's Spade

effects.name: Paydirt
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, draw a card.

flavor:
"I ♥ my ♠."
— motto carved on Gogor's wall.

name: Trygar's Will

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When your Magi is defeated, choose an opponent and two of that player's non-Magi cards in play. The chosen player chooses and discards one of the chosen cards.

text: Korremar can play Trygar's Will.
flavor: "And I leave all of my animite to the people of Vash Naroom, so they can afford to move somewhere decent!"

name: Mudslide
text: If you have both a Creature and a Relic in play, each player chooses one of their Creatures in play and one of their Relics in play. Discard each of the chosen cards.
flavor:
Slide, slide, slippity-side, it's never too late to go for a ride.
— Underling Creche Rhyme

name: Spirit of Ombor
text: You may play this card only when your Underneath Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand. When you reveal your next Magi, it gains "Effect — Resilience: At the beginning of your turn, if you have fewer Creatures in play than any opponent, add two energy to your Magi." You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "Earth!"

name: Tunnel
text: Choose one of your burrowed Creatures. Until the end of the turn, the chosen Creature can attack Magi directly. When the chosen Creature attacks a Magi this turn, add half of the energy removed from the defending Magi (rounded down) to your Magi.
flavor:
"When you least expect it, expect it!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Ever-Vigilant Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Unmake
text: Choose a Creature with X energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Discard one energy from each Creature in play of the same type as the discarded Creature.
flavor:
"Underneath. Loathe it or level it."
— Morag, Executioner

name: Baby Hyren

effects.name: Fledgling
effects.text: If Baby Hyren is attacked, you may choose one of your other Hyren in play. The chosen Creature replaces Baby Hyren in the attack. Baby Hyren cannot attack.

powers.name: Growth Spurt
powers.text: Discard Baby Hyren to play a Hyren from your hand, ignoring restrictions and reducing its cost by the energy on Baby Hyren. That Hyren cannot attack this turn. Use Growth Spurt only before your Attack step.

flavor:
"It's sooo cute! What was it we were here to do again?"
— Korg, to Olabra

name: Reality Anchor

effects.text: Players cannot use Powers, Spells or Effects to search their decks or discard piles for cards. Players may not draw more than four cards each turn.
When an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect chooses your Magi, you may discard Reality Anchor from play. If you do, the opposing card does not affect your Magi.

flavor: Reality is the stuff of dreams.

name: Healing Light
text: If your Magi has less energy than any other and you have fewer Creatures in play than any other player, draw two cards and add three energy to your Magi. You can only play one Healing Light per turn.
flavor:
"Like a backrub in a hot springs while you watch the sun set... Ahhh..."
— Bazha, Lifekeeper

name: Pure of Heart
text: Attach Pure of Heart to your Magi. While all of your other cards in play are from the same region as your Magi, your Magi is unaffected by Core Spells and Powers. If you play a Core card, defeat your Magi. Cards cannot affect Pure of Heart as it is being played.
flavor:
"My honor, that's all I need. Just my honor. And this colossus..."
— Tuku

name: Spirit of Rayje
text: You may play this card as an opposing card discards all of the energy from your Magi. Add three energy to your Magi. This card can prevent your Magi from being defeated. You can only play Spirit of Rayje three times per game.
flavor:
"I will never leave, but neither will you, Agram, and that is good enough
for me."
— Une

name: Pajick Pet

effects.name: Guard
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is attacked, add one energy to your Magi.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Pajick Pet is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Pajick Pet and one of your other Weave Creatures.

flavor:
"Even their pets have pets in the Weave."
— Wence's Travelog

name: Paradar

effects.name: Wait
effects.text: At the end of your Attack step, if Paradar did not attack, draw a card.

text: Weave Shadow Magi can play Paradar.
flavor: Biting its time.

name: Sagaweave

effects.name: Reweave
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, you may move one energy from one of your Weave or Core Creatures to another.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Sagaweave is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Sagaweave and one of your other Core or Weave Creatures.

text: Weave Shadow Magi can play Sagaweave.
flavor: They are the eyes and ears of the ancient seer.

name: Stumbling Junjertrug

effects.name: Carouse
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Stumbling Junjertrug has an even amount of energy, add two energy to it. Otherwise, discard three energy from it.

effects.name: Suntan
effects.text: Your Creatures lose one less energy from Cald Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"ChaaarrrOOOMF!"
— Iyori

name: Thresh

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Thresh is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Thresh and one of your other Weave Creatures.

effects.name: Rethresh
effects.text: Whenever a Weave Card is discarded from play on an opponent's turn, add one energy to Thresh.

errata.previous_text: Whenever a Weave card is discarded from play on an opponent's turn, add one energy to Thresh.
errata.change: Rethresh is supposed to be an Effect, not a Power. Thresh was misprinted.

flavor: They swarm to trouble-points within the Weave.

name: Tropical Jumbor

effects.name: Scout
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Tropical Jumbor did not attack this turn, add two energy to it.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Tropical Jumbor is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Tropical Jumbor and any one of your other Paradwyn or Weave Creatures.

flavor:
"Jumbor speed is directly proportionate to the time before its next meal."
— Iyori

name: Rehlya

effects.name: Counterweave
effects.text: Whenever one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, move one energy from the attacking Creature to the defending Creature before energy is removed.

flavor: "'Buncha pacifists,' they said. 'Can't fight a real war', they said. I'll say this: Cald! BRING IT!"

name: Wence the Wanderer

powers.name: Wence is Here
powers.text: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is a Naroom Spell or a Creature with the Effect "Weave", reveal it to all players and place it into your hand. Otherwise, discard it or return it to the top of your deck.

flavor:
"If you're a Weave Magi, then I'm Nagsis."
— Gia, to Wence

name: Bo'Ahsa's Shield

effects.name: Weave Tactics
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, choose one of your Weave Creatures in play. Replace the defending Creature with the chosen Creature.

flavor: Bo'Ahsa's terms are clearly inscribed on the inside of the shield.

name: Everburning Wick

effects.name: Short Fuse
effects.text: As one of your cards is discarded from play by an opposing card, discard one energy from the opposing card's Magi.

effects.name: Really Short Fuse
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if you have no Creatures in play, you may discard Everburning Wick from play to choose a Creature. Discard five energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"It's best to give it a wide margin."
— Zaya, Elder

name: Three-Leaf Clover

effects.name: Little Lucky
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose one of your Creatures. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Lotta Lucky
effects.text: When an opposing Spell or Power affects your Magi, you may discard Three Leaf Clover from play. If you do, your cards are unaffected by the Spell or Power, and you draw a card.

flavor:
"Don't eat the clover; it's only garnish."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Wence's Travelog

effects.name: Wence Was Here
effects.text: During your Energize step, if you have a Naroom Creature and a different Weave Creature in play, add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"I'm not even supposed to be here today!"
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Spirit of the Weave
text: You may play this card only when your Weave Magi is defeated on an opponent's turn. Discard a card from your hand to prevent the current player's Creatures from attacking that player's next turn. You can only play one Spirit Spell per Magi defeated.
flavor: "I am Captain Moon!"

name: Sprout
text: Choose an opposing Magi. Add one energy to your Magi for each of the chosen Magi's Creatures in play.
flavor:
"It's always harvest time in the Weave, but they never seem to know just
what they are picking."
— Wence's Travelog

name: Weave Seed
text: Play Weave Seed only before your Attack step. Choose a Weave Creature. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature. That Creature can attack an additional time this turn and must attack if able.
flavor:
"That's-a one-a spicy weave-a seed!"
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Niffer

effects.name: Allies
effects.text: When you reveal Niffer, choose any one region. Niffer is from the chosen region as well as Arderial. Niffer cannot play cards that are not Arderial, Universal, or of her chosen region.

effects.name: Overwrite
effects.text: When you play a Spell, you may discard two energy from Niffer to change any one region named in the Spell to any other region.

flavor: "Well, somebody has to teach you folks how it's done!"

name: Shivara

effects.name: Loyalty
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is discarded from play by an opposing Spell, instead return that Creature to its owner's hand.

effects.name: Eternal Service
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is discarded from play while attacking, add half of that Creature's starting energy, rounded down, to Shivara.

text: Shivara can only play Arderial and Universal cards.
flavor:
"What blows around, comes around."
— Shivara, Mistress of the Winds

name: Ember Vard

effects.name: Scorch
effects.text: When any player plays a Spell, you may discard Ember Vard from play. If you do, choose one of that player's Creatures. Discard five energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor: Fire Flyers.

name: Comet Hyren

effects.name: Bright Tail
effects.text: Whenever Comet Hyren attacks, it removes twice as much energy as it has from the defending Creature.

flavor: The star that burns twice as bright burns half as long.

name: Tempest Hyren

effects.name: Lightning Storm
effects.text: When Tempest Hyren attacks, you may play one Arderial Spell from your hand. All energy costs for the chosen Spell are paid for by Tempest Hyren instead of your Magi. Reduce the energy cost of the Spell by two, to a minimum of one.

flavor: Taming the tempest hyren is the final test for young Shield-Magi.

name: Kalius' Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Arderial, discard all of your non-Arderial cards from play and choose any one non-Arderial Creature in play with three or less energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"When all is said and done, it's how you got there that matters."
— Kalius

name: Abwyn's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose any one Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Return any one of your Creatures in play to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy.
flavor:
"It's all about a little give and take. You give, and I take!"
— Abwyn

name: Shockwave
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.
flavor:
"Dang! It was right here a second ago..."
— Hrada

name: Furlosk

effects.name: Swamp Lore
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play another Bograth Creature, draw a card.

effects.name: Forest Power
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play another Naroom Creature, add two energy to your Magi.

effects.name: Companionship
effects.text: If you do not have another Bograth or Naroom Creature in play, discard Furlosk from play.

errata.previous_text: If you do not have at least one other Bograth and one other Naroom Creature in play, discard Furlosk from play.
errata.change: Companionship now requires either a Bograth or Naroom Creature to be in play instead of both.

flavor:
"We all need somebody to lean on."
— Wiep, the Sniveler

name: Inferno Xyx

powers.name: Blast
powers.text: Discard Inferno Xyx from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Discard fifteen energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor: It's a pyro maniac.

name: Volcano Hyren

powers.name: Conflagration
powers.text: The next Cald Spell you play this turn that removes energy from a single Creature removes an additional energy from that Creature and one energy from each of that player's other Creatures in play.

flavor:
"The battle was over, and I told it to 'cool down', but it just looked at
me funny."
— Grega

name: Pyte

effects.name: Luck
effects.text: Add one to every die you roll, to a maximum of six.

effects.name: Respite
effects.text: When you defeat an opposing Magi, draw two cards.

flavor: "Now I know why I get up in the morning!"

name: Barak's Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Cald, discard all of your non-Cald cards from play and discard one energy from each opposing Creature in play.

flavor:
"The strength of a weapon lies in the arm that wields it."
— Barak, to Tryn

name: Gorgle's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose any one Creature in play. Discard seven energy from the chosen Creature. Return any one of your Creatures in play to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy.
flavor:
"There is no need to fear fire — let our enemies do that for us."
— Gorgle

name: Drush

effects.name: Vengeance
effects.text: If Drush is attacked and defeated, choose any one of the attacking player's Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

text: Weave Magi may play Drush.
flavor: Thought to be one of the rarest of dream creatures, a cache of them was recently discovered.

name: Gia Pet

effects.name: Impede
effects.text: All players draw one less card during their Draw Step. Only one copy of this Effect may prevent players from drawing cards.

errata.previous_text: All players draw one less card during their Draw Step.
errata.change: A limit as to how many copies of Implede can affect all players.

powers.name: Power Siphon
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Spell in play. Gia Pet gains energy equal to the energy cost of the chosen Spell.

text: Weave Magi can play Gia Pet. Non-Core, non-Weave Magi cannot play Gia Pet.
flavor: Gia thought it a fair trade for safe passage through the Weave.

name: Gragling

effects.name: Melancholy
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures loses energy from an opposing Spell or Power, add one energy to Gragling.

effects.name: Lonely
effects.text: If you have another Creature in play, Gragling gains 'ENERGIZE: 1'.

flavor:
"Little grag lost, in a world all alone. Poor thing; all this happiness is
bringing him down."
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Nightmare Hyren

powers.name: Horrible Dreams
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. The chosen Creature gains 'Effect — Toss and Turn: At the beginning of your turn, discard one energy from your Magi and each of your Creatures in play. This Creature removes two less energy from Core Creatures in attacks.'

flavor:
"Why'd you have to dream up that one? It... it scares me."
— Qwade, to Harror

name: The Dark Twins
text: The Dark Twins count as two Magi for deck construction.  The Dark Twins may go first every game and, if they go first, they may draw up to seven starting cards. If The Dark Twins are defeated and your next Magi is Naroom, that Magi becomes a Naroom Shadow Magi. All rules for Shadow Magi apply to the new Magi.
flavor:
"One day our child shall set me free, Une, and the world shall
awaken to its worst nightmare."
— Agram

name: Empress Gia

effects.name: Act Like Gia
effects.text: If Empress Gia has no Core cards in play, draw an additional card at the end of each of your turns and your Weave Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.

errata.previous_text: If you have no Core cards in play, draw an additional card at the end of each of your turns and your Weave Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.
errata.change: Act like Gia and Fight like Nagsis have been clarified to indicate that Empress Gia is not to be included when checking to see if either Effect triggers.

effects.name: Fight Like Nagsis
effects.text: If Empress Gia has any Core cards in play, all of your Creatures may attack, even those that cannot normally attack.

errata.previous_text: If you have Core cards in play, all of your Creatures may attack, even those that cannot normally attack.
errata.change: Act like Gia and Fight like Nagsis have been clarified to indicate that Empress Gia is not to be included when checking to see if either Effect triggers.

text: Empress Gia can only play Core, Weave, and Universal cards.
flavor: "My voice is raw from speaking in falsetto all the time."

name: Jalex

powers.name: Designer Intent
powers.text: Choose a region. Until the end of your turn, Jalex can play Creatures and Spells of the chosen region, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties.

flavor: "You think you can beat me with fruit on sticks? Ha! Ow! Ow-ow!"

name: Korg

effects.name: Dis...ray
effects.text: Korg may not play Universal cards. All Creatures played by Korg lose one energy when they come into play.

flavor:
"Shaddup, Zet! I'm in charge, and I say we go in and cause di... dis...
dis...ray!"

name: Zet

effects.name: Good Riddance
effects.text: If Korg is in any player's defeated Magi pile, add three energy to Zet's starting energy.

powers.name: Treachery
powers.text: Zet gains control of any one Creature in play. X is the amount of energy on that Creature. If the Creature is a non-Core Creature, it loses one energy. The Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor: "Korg, this is the perfect chance for us to get in there and cause some disarray."

name: Nagsis' Sigil

effects.name: Corruption
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Core, discard each of your non-Core cards from play and choose any Magi. Move up to two energy from the chosen Magi to your Magi.

flavor:
So marked, your freedom ends.
— Sigil's inscription

name: Morag's 'Gift'
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose an opposing Magi. Attach Morag's 'Gift' to the chosen Magi. Return any one of your Creatures to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy. While Morag's 'Gift' is in play, whenever the chosen Magi plays a Creature, add two energy to your Magi. A Magi can only be affected by one copy of Morag's 'Gift' at a time.
flavor: This present: Darkness.

name: Chogus Little

effects.name: Panic
effects.text: Whenever you play a card, discard two energy from Chogus Little. Whenever an opponent plays a card, add two energy to Chogus Little.

flavor:
"Is the sky falling?"
— Hok

name: Oranragan

effects.name: Crush
effects.text: When you play Oranragan, choose and discard an opposing Relic from play.

effects.name: Vengeance
effects.text: When an opposing card discards one of your cards from play or reduces one of your other Creatures to zero energy, add two energy to Oranragan.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Oranragan loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"What the heck would you do with a banana that big anyway?"
— Jagt, Prankster

name: The Prankster

effects.name: Surprise!
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if you have no Creatures in play, reveal the top card of your deck. If the revealed card is a Kybar's Teeth Creature, you may play it, reducing its cost by four, to a minimum of zero. The Creature cannot attack this turn. Otherwise, discard the revealed card.

flavor:
"TREMBLE in my presence, weakling!"
"You brought presents? For me?"
— Hrada and Jagt

name: Ullig's Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Kybar's Teeth, discard each of your non-Kybar's Teeth cards from play and choose an opposing Magi. Until the beginning of your next turn, each of that Magi's Creatures cost one additional energy to play.

flavor:
Stand atop the Fang, and thus above your enemies.
— Ring's inscription

name: Kybar's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose an opposing Magi. Return one of your Creatures to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy. Reveal your hand to all players. Discard energy equal to the number of Kybar's Teeth Creatures in your hand from both the chosen Magi and one of that Magi's Creatures.
flavor:
"Kybar's greatest gift: gravity."
— Kazm

name: Forest Hyren

effects.name: Underbrush
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to Forest Hyren, add an additional energy to Forest Hyren.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose any one other Creature in play. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Forest Hyren.
flavor: The most beautiful foliage in the forest can be found in the hyren's footsteps.

name: Glade Hyren

effects.name: Serenity
effects.text: As you play Glade Hyren, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, reduce Glade Hyren's cost by one for each of your other Naroom Creatures in play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"I don't even dream them up; they simply appear in times of need."
— Eidon, Elder

name: Rabbage
flavor:
"My garden! It's been rabbaged!"
— Gruk

name: Chayla

effects.name: Companionship
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play an Eebit from your hand, draw a card.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.text: All of your Eebits in play gain 'ENERGIZE: 1'.

flavor:
"The more the merrier. And the furrier... and the noisier... and the..."
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Eidon

effects.name: Familiarity
effects.text: Whenever Eidon plays a Creature, add two energy to Eidon if another Creature with the same name is already in play.

flavor: "I travel all over the Moonlands... that is, when I can get away from Gia."

name: Orwin's Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Naroom, discard all of your non-Naroom cards from play and add one energy to each of your Creatures in play.

flavor:
"It builds, like his temper."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Bythan's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose any one Creature in play. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature. Return any one of your Creatures in play to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy.
flavor:
"The life energy of the forest courses through our veins."
— Bythan

name: Coral Pyder

effects.name: Playful
effects.text: Whenever Coral Pyder attacks a Magi, it removes no energy in the attack. Instead, energize your Magi.

flavor:
"It couldn't make enemies from a kit."
— Quilla

name: Monsoon Hyren

effects.name: Ebb
effects.text: When you play Monsoon Hyren, move one energy from each of your other Creatures in play to Monsoon Hyren.

powers.name: Ravaging Storm
powers.text: Discard Monsoon Hyren from play. Discard all opposing Creatures with less than five energy.

flavor:
"I've tried dreaming up more peaceful Monsoon Hyren, but I don't think
it's in their nature."
— Quilla

name: Kayliel

effects.name: Relic Subversion
effects.text: When you reveal Kayliel, gain control of all opposing Relics.

flavor: Cute but crabby.

name: Orlon's Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Orothe, discard all of your non-Orothe cards from play and add one energy to your Magi for each Orothe Relic you have in play.

flavor:
"The ring is worthless! I found it in a box of jellybeans. The power is in
YOU, Orlon!"
— Mobis, Elder

name: Owinda's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, draw four cards. Return any one of your Creatures in play to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy.
flavor:
"The tides are our greatest source of knowledge."
— Owinda

name: Grakanden

effects.name: Grounding
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing player plays a Spell, you may discard three energy from Grakanden to cancel all effects of that Spell. Return the Spell to that player's hand at the end of the turn.

flavor:
I've never met a mushroom that could talk, but I'd swear that thing just
said 'NO!'"
— Kesia, Weaverunner

name: Ormagon

powers.name: Devastate
powers.text: Discard all non-Underneath Creatures from play.

flavor: Big ba-da-boom.

name: Phosphor Hyren

effects.name: Light Barrier
effects.text: Opposing Creatures with less energy than Phosphor Hyren cannot attack your non-Hyren Underneath Creatures. Phosphor Hyren cannot be burrowed.

flavor:
"The light makes the creche-lings feel safe, and he's great at parties!"
— Ulk, Underwarden

name: Emaal

effects.name: Sabotage
effects.text: When Emaal is defeated, discard all energy from all opposing Magi and draw a card.

flavor: "You're not as big as you thought you were."

name: Strag's Ring

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Underneath, discard all of your non-Underneath cards from play and choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen Creature is considered burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"Go! I'll cover you!"
— Strag

name: Atekkia's Gift
text: If you have a Creature in play, choose any one Creature in play. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand, discard all of that Creature's energy. Return any one of your Creatures in play to your hand, discarding all of that Creature's energy.
flavor:
"To mater he art of nonbeing is to achieve true victory."
— Atekkia

name: Thunderquake
text: Choose any number of Creatures in play. Discard a total of X energy in any combination from the chosen Creatures. X cannot be more than 10.
flavor:
"Are you rrrrready to rrrrrumble?"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero of the Underneath

name: Monarch Hyren

powers.name: Command
powers.text: (1) Add one energy to each of your hyren in play.

errata.previous_text: Add one energy to each of your hyren in play.
errata.change: The word "other" has been removed from Command.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Monarch Hyren.

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: (1) Search your deck for any one Hyren, show it to your opponent, and add the chosen card to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

errata.previous_text: Search your deck for any one hyren, show it to your opponent, and add the chosen card to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
errata.change: The word "other" has been removed from Command.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Monarch Hyren.

flavor:
"It's my fiercest dream creature, the centerpiece of my collection, and my
best friend."
— Yerthe

name: Rayje's Construct

effects.name: Ancestral Favor
effects.text: All your Spells cost one less Energy to play, to a minimum of one.

errata.previous_text: All of your Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Increase your Magi's energize rate by one.

errata.previous_text: Your Magi's energize rate is increased by one.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

effects.name: Tinker
effects.text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. You cannot choose any creature more than once per turn with Tinker. STARTING: Rayje

errata.previous_text: Whenever you play a Relic, add one energy to any one Creature in play.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

powers.name: Auraflection
powers.text: (2) Copy any one Power on your Magi, paying all costs.

errata.previous_text: Copy any one Power on your Magi, paying all costs.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

powers.name: Channeling
powers.text: Discard two cards from your hand to add two energy to your Magi.

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: (2) Draw one card.

errata.previous_text: Draw one card.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

powers.name: Pound Pound Pound
powers.text: (2) Discard one Relic in play.

errata.previous_text: Discard any one Relic from play.
errata.change: Each Creature can only be affected by Tinker once a turn.

flavor:
"It comes in three different sizes, large, extra large and O MY GOSH, IT'S
COMING THIS WAY!"
— Pruitt, starting to run

name: League Elder

effects.name: Adapt
effects.text: When you reveal League Elder, choose any one region. League Elder is from that region.

effects.name: Prepare
effects.text: During your draw step, instead of drawing two cards, draw until you have five cards in your hand.

flavor:
"With all the troubles, we need some fun to bring us together."
— League Charter

name: Tony At A Con

powers.name: Caffeine!
powers.text: Take an additional turn after this one. All Magi in your Magi stack gain "Effect - Sleep Dep: At the end of your turn, if you just took two turns in a row, defeat your Magi. Sleep Dep cannot be prevented or canceled."

flavor: "Can't sleep... must play... gotta shower..."

name: Tony Jones

effects.name: Animite Affinity
effects.text: Non-Universal Creatures Tony plays cost one less energy, to a minimum of one.

powers.name: Favors
powers.text: (2) Play any one Relic from your hand, regardless of region.

errata.previous_text: Put any one Relic from your hand into play.
errata.change: Any Relic, regardless of Region, can be played with Favors.
errata.source: 2i Design Team, Rules Compendium/Playing Cards Guide - MN Digest Links

flavor:
"I've never seen anything like this... you're not from around here, are
you?"
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Tuku

powers.name: Restrain
powers.text: (2) Until the end of your next turn, no Magi can play any non-Universal Relics or Spells. You cannot use Restrain on your next turn.

errata.previous_text: Until the end of your next turn, Magi cannot play any non-Universal Relics or Spells.
errata.change: Restrain can not be used two of your turns in a row.

flavor: "I am no giant."

name: Gauntlets of Colossal Power

powers.name: Whole Lotta Glove
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Gauntlets of Colossal Power from play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks, it removes twelve energy instead of its current energy.

flavor:
"One size hits all!"
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Rayje's Belt

powers.name: Lockdown
powers.text: Name any one Power or Effect on a card in play. Until the end of your next turn, no player may use named Power or Effect while Rayje's Belt is in play.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Power or Effect on a card in play. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen Power or Effect cannot be used while Rayje's Belt is in play.
errata.change: Lockdown can only work on a named Power or Effect in play and if Rayje's Belt is discarded, the affected Power or Effect is useable again. This errata supersedes the Rayje's Belt Promotional card.

flavor:
"Great! You fixed it. I was afraid it was broken for good."
— Rayje, to Emec

name: Rayje's Shield

effects.name: Leadership
effects.text: Each time you draw a card, choose one of your Creatures in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. You cannot choose a Creature more than once per turn with Leadership.

flavor:
To serve and protect.
— inscription

name: Warrior's Boots

powers.name: Warpath
powers.text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from you hand. You must still pay all costs for the Creature.

errata.previous_text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from your hand. You must still pay all costs for the Creature.
errata.change: Better clarification on paying all costs associated with the Creature played through Warpath.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Warrior's Boots.

flavor:
"These boots were made for stompin'."
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Elemental Shield
text: Choose any one other Magi in play. Until the end of your next turn, your cards in play are not affected by that Magi's Spells, Powers, and Effects.
flavor:
"Not in my house!"
— Jaela, Regis

name: Nightmare's Dawn
text: All Magi who only have cards of their region in play gain five energy.
flavor:
"We can count on none but ourselves."
— Warrada, The Shadow

name: Power of the Creators
text: Choose a player. If that player's name is printed in the most recent printing of the Magi-Nation Duel rulebook, choose any one Magi in play. Discard that Magi and all of his or her cards from play. You cannot choose a player who has signed this card.
flavor: You're gonna kick whose what?

name: Rejuvenate
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Add five energy to the chosen Creature. This cannot raise a Creature above its starting energy.
flavor:
"As good as new, but no better."
- Gar

name: Voice of the Storms
text: Add two energy to each Creature in play with more than one region.
flavor:
"How do you plan to weather the storm of wars?"
— Orthea, to Jaela

name: Gia

powers.name: Unearth
powers.text: Discard any one of your Relics from play to search your deck for any one Relic and put it directly into play. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

flavor: "Eidon, don't you have some work to do?"

name: Barreling Vemment

powers.name: One-Two
powers.text: Choose a Creature. Remove one energy from that Creature for each Vemment you control.

flavor:
A flight of vemments charged Togoth, pummeling his nightmare creatures
into animite dust.

name: Lightning Braggle

powers.name: Shock
powers.text: Choose up to three opposing Creatures. Remove one energy from each of them.

flavor:
Lightning rained from the skies onto the heads of the
Shadow Magi. Wherever it touched the ground, the
electricity took the form of a braggle.

name: Rainbow Hyren

effects.name: Shining Light
effects.text: Powers on your Hyren cost one less energy to use, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Gift
effects.text: If your Magi is Arderial, your Universal Hyren cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"Our kind have long been friends to your people,
wherever they may call home, and it is clear to us now
that we are needed by our friends."
— The Monarch Hyren

name: Renegade Epik

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Arderial Creature. Remove one energy from it and draw two cards.

text:
Renegade Epik's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi can play Renegade Epik.
flavor: Not every dream creature is happy to serve its master.

name: Amara

effects.name: Soothing Song
effects.text: After a Spell is played, choose a Creature and add one energy to it.

text: Amara may play Kybar's Teeth Spells, ignoring regional penalties.
flavor:
"A true friend is the one who knows the song in your
heart and sings you the song when you're torn apart."

name: Klynn

powers.name: Seer
powers.text: Roll a die. Reveal a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the die roll. If you reveal any Spells, choose one and add it to your hand. Discard the remaining cards.

flavor:
"She shows exceptional ability for one so young."
— Nimbulo, Elder

name: Lasada, Emissary

effects.name: Diplomacy
effects.text: After Lasada, Emissary is defeated, choose up to one Relic, one Spell and one Creature in your discard pile and add them to your hand. Discard a card for each non-Arderial card you added to your hand in this way.

flavor:
"Lasada's negiotations always leave you with more than you started with."
— Delia, Keeper

name: Dreamthread Bracelet

effects.name: Loan Strength
effects.text: Once per turn, as one of your Arderial Creatures uses a Power, you may pay the energy cost from your Magi instead.

flavor:
"Here, let me give you a hand."
— Amara, Shield Maiden

name: Shock Ring

effects.name: Storm Seeker
effects.text: After one of your Arderial Spells or Powers removes energy from one or more opposing Creatures, choose a Creature you control. Add one energy to it.

flavor:
"Alright, Jalex, it's go time. Show me what you've got."
— Ora, Defender of the Sky

name: Starlight's Genesis
text: Discard a card from your hand a draw a card. If you played a copy of Sunbeam's End this turn, you may remove three energy from your Magi to draw two extra cards.
flavor: Summoning the strength of starlight requires a knowledge of its origin.

name: Sunbeam's End
text: Choose a Creature and add one energy to it. If you played a copy of Starlight's Genesis this turn, you may remove two energy from your Magi to add two extra energy to that Creature.
flavor: As the last rays of the sun fell upon the Rayalon, it rose from the ground, growing in stature. The Chaos Jile took a step back in fear.

name: Volt Shield
text: Choose a Creature in play and attach Volt Shield to it. If that Creature would be affected by an opposing non-Arderial Spell, you may discard Volt Shield from play. If you do, the Creature is unaffected by that Spell.
flavor:
"Don't hurt my precious..."
— Jaela, Regis

name: Black Stuff

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your Magi is Bograth, you may play one copy of Black Stuff from your discard pile, paying all costs.

flavor:
"Man, this black stuff never comes off..."
— Wence the Wanderer

name: Creeping Ainjer

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Bograth Creature. Remove one energy from it and add three energy to your Magi.

text:
Creeping Ainjer's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi can play Creeping Ainjer.
flavor:
"Who could have dreamed up a creature that hates its own kind so much?"
— Sinder, Apprentice

name: Moss Trulb

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Multiply
powers.text: If you control another Trulb, move one energy from each opposing Magi to Moss Trulb.

flavor: Trulbs seem to multipy after a heavy rain.

name: Rot Arboll

effects.name: Blight
effects.text: After an opponent plays a Creature with more energy than Rot Arboll, move one energy from that Creature to Rot Arboll.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"These aren't the healing kind. They prefer the misery
of those stronger than themselves."
— Queen Olabra

name: Wither Twee

effects.name: Sweet Rot
effects.text: If Wither Twee is defeated in an attack, add one energy to each Bograth Creature and draw a card.

flavor: Wither Twees surround the borders of Bograth. Each foes that passes only strengthens the denizens of that foul region.

name: Brog, Swamp Thug

powers.name: Intimidation
powers.text: Discard one of your Creatures from play. Choose an opposing Creature and move half of its energy, rounded up, to Brog, Swamp Thug.

flavor: "Olabra's in charge now! You answer to her or you find yourself in exile. Got it?"

name: Bulomp

effects.name: Shiftier
effects.text: Your Creatures lose no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"Can't touch these."
— Bulomp's motto

name: Whilp

powers.name: Plague
powers.text: Choose a Creature type. All Creatures of the chosen type lose two energy.

flavor: "Hmm... I wonder what this would do to a Bagala?"

name: Muck Shovel

powers.name: Depression
powers.text: Choose two Bograth Creatures. Move up to five energy from one Creature to the other Creature.

flavor:
"Hah! Your Pyder is mine now!" Arosa boasted.
"Not for long", Blygt said, a sneer on his face.

name: Trulb Bracelet

powers.name: Sweet Sorrow
powers.text: Discard one of your Trulbs from play. Draw a number of cards equal to the Trulb's printed starting energy, plus one.

flavor:
"...and it's pretty too."
—Grahnna, Revered Important Person

name: Mud Bubble
text: Choose a Bograth Creature in your discard pile. Place that Creature in your hand. If you play one or more copies of that Creature this turn, draw a card at the end of your turn.
flavor:
"Ah, it's just mud. What harm is mud?"
— Targ'n, Elder

name: Trulbble!
text: Discard up to four Trulbs you control from play. Draw two cards for each Trulb you discarded.
flavor: In the swamps of Bograth, even the most meaningless creature serves a greater purpose.

name: Caldera Aq

effects.name: Heartwarming
effects.text: After a Cald Power removes energy from one or more Creatures, you may discard Caldera Aq to draw a card.

flavor: The Cald Magi charged up the slopes of Kybar's Teeth, hurling fire as they went. Before them loomed the forces of the Dark Twins.

name: Cinder Hyren

powers.name: Dream Pyre
powers.text: Shuffle up to five Cald Creatures from your discard pile into your deck and choose a Creature. Remove emergy from that Creature equal to the number of Creatures you shuffled into your deck.

flavor:
"Anyone for leftovers?"
— Magam, Ringsmith

name: Flame Jakla

powers.name: Heat Syphon
powers.text: Choose a Magi and remove three energy from it. If this Power removes all the energy from the chosen Magi, add two energy to Flame Jakla.

flavor: T'Lok stood over Vorga, ready to drop a massive boulder on the prone Magi. Just then, Xandia's Jakla appeared and blasted T'Lok off the edge of the cliff.

name: Jakla Prowler

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Cald Creature. Remove one energy from it and remove one energy from its controller's Magi for each Spell in your discard pile.

text:
Jakla Prowler's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Jakla Prowler.
flavor: Skulking in the lava pools of Cald, these creatures enjoy picking on passing Arbolits.

name: Jory

effects.name: Heatwave
effects.text: Once per turn, after a Cald Spell discards an opposing Creature from play, remove two energy from that Creature's Magi.

flavor: His smoldering good looks make him popular among the ladies no matter where he goes.

name: Sinder, Apprentice

effects.name: Backlash
effects.text: Once per turn, when Sinder, Apprentice is attacked, remove energy in the attack as through he were a Creature.

text: Universal Spells cost Sinder, Apprentice one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.
flavor:
"Sinder, go help the others. Warrada is mine."
— Rayje

name: Xandia

powers.name: Burning Desire
powers.text: Discard a Cald Creature from your hand. Choose an opposing Creature and remove energy from it equal to the starting energy of the Creature you discarded. This energy loss may not be modified.

flavor:
"I'm very protective of my little sister. Mess with her and
you mess with me."

name: Disc of Inferno

powers.name: Hotfoot
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. Remove one energy from it for each other opposing Creature in play.

flavor:
"Burn, baby, burn!"
— Inscription on Disc of Inferno

name: Molten Gauntlets

effects.name: Heatstroke
effects.text: Creatures gain one less energy from effects.

flavor: "No one hurts my little sister! Especially not some two-bit Shadow Magi!" Xandia looked over the cliff to see what had become of T'Lok, but he was gone.

name: Lava Blast
text: Each of your opponents choose a Creature he or she controls, if any. Remove three energy from each chosen Creature. This energy loss may not be modified by Powers, Spells or Effects.
flavor:
"Life is full of tough choices. It's time you make one."
— Grega, Keeper

name: Singed Pride
text: Choose an opposing Magi and attach Singed Pride to it. After that Magi's owner draws a card outside of his or her Draw step, you may discard Singed Pride from play to remove three energy from that Magi. You may not discard more than one Singed Pride per card drawn.
flavor: Sometimes the price of knowledge is too high.

name: Spark
text: Choose an opposing Creature and remove three energy from it. That Creature's controller may choose a Creature or Magi controlled by any player and remove one energy from it.
flavor:
"Flame isn't the easiest element to control. If you're not
careful, it'll turn on you."
— Barak, Warlord

name: Dark Vellup

powers.name: Purge
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand and draw a card. If a copy of the card you discarded is in play, draw an extra card.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Vellup.
flavor: Harror ambushed Dey in the vast expanses of d'Resh. "Time to pay, fool", she hissed, between clenched teeth.

name: Gorath Cub

powers.name: Chain Whip
powers.text: Choose a Creature or Magi with more than its printed starting energy. Remove three energy from it.

flavor: Chains wrapped tightly around Xandia, forcing a scream of rage from her lips. T'lok stepped from behind a boulder. "You didn't think I'd be that easy to get rid of, did you?"

name: Shadow Dryte

effects.name: Descendance
effects.text: After Shadow Dryte defeats a Creature while attacking, add four energy to Shadow Dryte.

flavor: It feeds on the pain of others. This makes it the perfect weapon for Agram's minions.

name: Shadow Fird

effects.name: Feed
effects.text: After a Furok is discarded from play, you may play one copy of Shadow Fird from your discard pile, ignoring all costs.

flavor: Flocks of these foul beasts now follow Sperri wherever she roams.

name: Slinking Greal

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Core Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature's controller chooses a Creature he or she controls and removes two energy from it.

text:
Slinking Greal's text cannot be altered.
Non-Core Magi may play Slinking Greal.
flavor:
"Who cares where these things came from? All that
matters is that they seem to want to help."
— Yaki, Core Stalker
shadow_play: Arderial, Bograth, Cald, Kybar's Teeth, Nar, Naroom, Orothe, Paradwyn, Underneath, Universal, Weave, d'Resh

name: Lanyx, Reaper

powers.name: Hatred
powers.text: Remove two energy from each opposing Creature. Remove one extra energy from each d'Resh Creature.

flavor: "It's time to repay some people for their treacheries. Korremar, Barak, Harror..."

name: T'lok, Traitor

effects.name: Betrayed Secrets
effects.text: Effects may not reduce the amount of energy removed from opposing Creatures in attacks.

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Your Core Creatures remove one extra energy when attacking.

flavor: "Of course I'll show you how to use Kybar's Fang."

name: Yayek

effects.name: Seeds of Deceit
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a Spell or Relic in an opposing discard pile and shuffle it into its owner's deck. Increase Yayek's energize by that card's energy cost until the end of your turn (X equals zero).

flavor: With Nagsis missing, Yayek has made his way to Hrada's side.

name: Shroud of the Master

powers.name: Absolute Authority
powers.text: Discard a Core card from your hand. Add one energy to your Magi and one energy to each of your Core Creatures. If your Magi is Agram, add one extra energy to each of your Core Creatures.

flavor:
"You're not worthy to bear such a noble burden, Hrada.
Take it off at once!"
— Morag

name: Haunting Visions
text: Choose an opposing Creature and attach Haunting Visions to it. The Creature may not be chosen by its controller's Spells and Powers.
flavor:
"You think that's scary? Picture this..."
— Morag, Corrupter

name: Twisted Dreams
text: Choose a Power on an opposing Creature. Remove energy from that Creature equal to the cost of the chosen Power (X equals zero).
flavor: Togoth snapped his fingers. The approaching ormagon let out a bellow of pain, then vanished in a flash of light.

name: Circling Darbok

powers.name: Passing Shadow
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. If the chosen Creature is discarded from play this turn, draw a card.

flavor: As the collected forces of the Moonlands converged on the slopes of Kybar's Teeth, darboks began to circle, looking for weak creatures to take advantage of.

name: Craw

powers.name: Sift
powers.text: Discard Craw from play. Search your discard pile for a d'Resh Relic and add it to your hand.

flavor:
"Whadda ya mean 'There's no such thing as sandy craws'?"
— Korg, Exiled Emperor of Bograth

name: Olum Fiend

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing d'Resh Creature and discard one energy from it. That Creature is an Illusion until the end of your next turn. Illusions are not considered in play when checking to see if your Magi is defeated and cannot attack Magi directly.

text:
Olum Fiend's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Olum Fiend.
flavor:
"These Olum do not work well with their brethren. In fact, I'd say they
hate them."
— Dey

name: Sand Sark

effects.name: Hunt
effects.text: As Sand Sark attacks a Creature with five or more energy, remove two energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"Knock, knock."
"Who is it?"
"Sandygram!"
— Old d'Reshi Joke

name: Korremar, Avatar

effects.name: Dark Shield
effects.text: Core Creatures cost all players one extra energy to play.

effects.name: Wisdom
effects.text: Korremar, Avatar's Illusions may attack one extra time each turn.

flavor: Korremar met Rayje and Sinder on their way out of Paradwyn. It was easy to convince the legend and his apprentice that their goals were the same.

name: Nymat

effects.name: Sandstorm
effects.text: After an opponent plays a Creature with six or more energy, remove two energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"Nymat is our most resourceful Magi. He can make anything out of a few
random scraps."
— Korremar, the Avatar

name: Salara

effects.name: Spellcraft
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opponent plays a Spell, choose an Illusion and add four energy to it.

flavor: With a swish of her wrist, Salara's orshaa grew in size. Warrada's ball of purple energy bounced harmlessly off it.

name: Aubra's Timepiece

effects.name: Time Slip
effects.text: All cards played during the second Powers/Spells/Relics step cost two extra energy to play.

text: After you play Aubra's Timepiece, discard all copies of Aubra's Hourglass from play. Cards cannot prevent Aubra's Hourglass from being discarded.
flavor:
"Time is on your side."
— Inscription on Aubra's Timepiece

name: Dreamcatcher

effects.name: Absorb
effects.text: Once per turn, after an opponent plays a Creature, you may move up to two energy from that Creature to a Creature you control.

flavor:
"Your dreams become my reality."
— Salara

name: Aubra's Wisdom
text: If you have four or more cards in your hand, shuffle your hand into your deck. Until the end of your next turn, draw three extra cards during your Draw step.
flavor:
"Sometimes you have to give a little to get a lot."
— Risha, Seventh Oracle

name: Mirage
text: Remove one energy from each opposing non-Illusion Creature. Add one energy to each Illusion. Only d'Resh and d'Resh Shadow Magi may play Mirage.
flavor: The sand can play tricks on your eyes.

name: Sandtrap
text: Choose a Creature without any Spells attached and attach Sandtrap to it. While Sandtrap is attached, that Creature loses one energy at the beginning of each player's turn.
flavor:
"I spend almost as much time in the sand as I do in the woods."
— Wence the Wanderer

name: Bone Cragnoc

effects.name: Frenzy
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if Bone Cragnoc is the largest Creature, add two energy to it.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: This Creature loses one less energy in attacks.

text: Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Bone Cragnoc.
flavor:
"The creatures in the Teeth are beginning to take a
slightly more malevolent look. Perhaps we should
investigate."
— Groll, Keeper

name: Crouching Xamf

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Kybar's Teeth Creature. Remove one energy from it and add four energy to your largest Creature.

text:
Crouching Xamf's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Crouching Xamf.
flavor:
"At first, we thought that they were just honing their
hunting instincts but their ferocity was too intense."
— Hok

name: Rolling Baldar

effects.name: Collision
effects.text: After Rolling Baldar defeats a Creature while attacking, remove three energy from the smallest opposing Creature. If there is a tie, an opponent of your choice chooses the Creature to be affected.

flavor: A rolling Baldar gathers no Moss Trulbs.

name: Stubborn Chogus

effects.name: Determination
effects.text: As Stubborn Chogus attacks the largest opposing Creature, add two energy to Stubborn Chogus.

flavor: The ferocity with which the Chogus covered Groll's escape amazed him. "I must report T'lok's betrayal to Targ'n before it's too late", thought the battered Keeper.

name: Groll the Fallen

effects.name: Betrayal
effects.text: Your Creatures lose one extra energy in attacks with Core Creatures.

powers.name: Desperate
powers.text: Choose a Creature. Until the beginning of your next turn, after that Creature removes energy from an opposing Creature in an attack, add energy to Groll the Fallen equal to the energy removed from the opposing Creature.

flavor: "T'lok! What have you done?"

name: N'ssah

effects.name: Fearless
effects.text: As one of your Creatures attacks a larger Creature, add two energy to your Creature.

flavor: "Don't listen to that guy, he's trying to lead you down the path of the Core. I'm gonna lead you down the path of rocks."

name: Tal'ik

powers.name: Standing Tall
powers.text: Choose one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Creature may not be discarded from play or returned to your hand while it has energy. Opposing players may not gain control of that Creature.

flavor: "Don't bother, T'lok, I'm prepared for your tricks."

name: Baldar Amulet

effects.name: Affinity
effects.text: Baldars cost you one less to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Hammer
effects.text: Once per turn, after one of your Baldars is discarded from play by an opposing Creature or Relic, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard the opposing card from play.

flavor:
"Hey, I thought you said it was a gate!"
— Wessig

name: Flint Staff

powers.name: Tremor
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. If it is larger than your largest Creature, move two energy from the chosen Creature to your largest Creature.

flavor:
"Nobody's bigger than my Rock Hyren. Nobody."
— Targ'n, Elder

name: Grapple Tooth

effects.name: Climb
effects.text: Your Magi loses no energy in attacks while you control at least one Creature.

powers.name: Grapple
powers.text: If your largest Creature is larger than each opposing Creature, draw a card.

flavor: Hrada's spell barely missed Hok as he rolled off the cliff. His trusty hook saved him from a long, painful fall.

name: Moga Boots

effects.name: Kickback
effects.text: The first time your Magi is attacked each turn, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard the attacking Creature from play, before energy is removed.

flavor:
"Like the boots? Lemme give you a closer look!"
— Koll

name: Gravity
text: Choose a Creature with more than its starting energy. Reduce that Creature to its printed starting energy.
flavor:
"Gravity is one force you just can't fight", said Koll.
"Unless you're an Arderian", replied Sorreah.

name: Topple
text: Choose one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures and any number of opposing Creatures. Remove energy equal to your Creature's energy, in any combination, from the chosen opposing Creatures. Discard your Creature from play.
flavor: The cragnoc began to collapse under the barrage of Core creatures. Hrada's laugh of triumph turned to a groan of despair as he realized that all of his Dream Creatures were in the shadow of the falling beast.

name: Ice Vinoc

effects.name: Icy Vines
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Frozen Creature attacks, move one energy from that Creature to Ice Vinoc.

flavor: Their chilling grip drains the energy from even the stoutest Dream Creatures.

name: Polar Eebit

effects.name: Bury
effects.text: If Polar Eebit is Frozen, it only loses one energy when attacked.

flavor: Laranel and her people arrived too late to help Yaki free Naroom but they were among the first to head for Kybar's Teeth to fight the Twins.

name: Polar Rudwot

effects.name: Snowbank
effects.text: If Polar Rudwot attacks while it is Frozen, add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"Its friendship has helped me weather countless storms."
— Hajnyn

name: Rask Deserter

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Nar Creature. Remove one energy from it and discard a Relic controlled by that Creature's Magi.

text:
Rask Deserter's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Rask Deserter.
flavor:
"It's like nothing I've ever seen before and nothing I
ever want to see again."
— Thast

name: Aurorea

effects.name: Mistress of Frost
effects.text: If Aurorea is frozen, increase her energize by two.

text: Aurorea can only play Nar cards.
flavor: "Brrrr, it's cold in here. Feels good, doesn't it?"

name: Hajnyn

powers.name: Iceberg
powers.text: Choose a Frozen Creature you control and an opposing Creature with less energy. Discard both Creatures from play.

flavor:
"When Hajnyn decides to vanish, he's as hard to find as 
a shadow in a storm."
— Ust

name: Locke

powers.name: Treasure Hunt
powers.text: Reveal the top three cards of your deck and select an opponent. That player chooses one of the cards. Place that card in your hand. If Locke is Frozen, choose one of the remaining cards and place it in your hand. Discard the other cards.

text: Locke may only play Nar and Universal cards.
flavor: "Bandit is such a dirty word. I prefer 'Treasure Hunter.'"

name: Chill Cane

effects.name: Waste Not
effects.text: At the end of each turn, each player shuffles his or her discard pile into his or her deck.

effects.name: Want Not
effects.text: At the beginning of your Draw step, if you have no cards in your hand, draw two extra cards.

flavor:
"When I walk with this thing, it makes me look extra cool."
— Odavast, Elder

name: Icecap

effects.name: Chilling Thought
effects.text: Your cards cost one extra energy to play.

text: When Icecap comes into play choose an opposing Magi. That Magi gaines control of Icecap. At the end of your turn, you may discard all of your Relics from play.
flavor: It gives the term "brain freeze" a whole new meaning.

name: Kintor Furs

effects.name: Acclimate
effects.text: If your Magi is Frozen, your Spells and Powers on your Magi cost one less energy. If your Relics are Frozen, Powers on your Relics cost one less energy.

flavor: On a long trek through the lands of Nar, Kintor furs can make a world of difference.

name: Flashfreeze
text: Choose a Creature. Remove one energy from the Creature for each Frozen card you control.
flavor: Velouria's creatures surrounded the twisted furok. A blue flash of energy flowed from creature to creature, sucking the energy from it.

name: Icepack
text: Choose a Creature and attach Icepack to it. If the Creature is Frozen, its Powers cost two less energy, to a minimum of one.
flavor: The hot sun seemed to have no effect on the legions of Nar creatures. A haze of ice seemed to surround each one.

name: Carillion Titan

effects.name: Rampant Growth
effects.text: After another Creature you control defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, add three energy to Carillion Titan.

flavor: As Yaki's creatures charged the foul minions of the Core, the carillion titan continued to grow, moving slowly but surely toward the Great Library.

name: Snag Arboll

powers.name: Trip
powers.text: Choose an opponent. Remove one energy from that opponent's Magi for each Creature he or she controls.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Snag Arboll.
flavor: The new tricks that Yaki had learned in his solitude took Hrada by surprise. Dream creatures appeared from the surrounding underbrush, leeching the energy from Hrada's dark furoks.

name: Sneaky Weebo

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Naroom Creature. Remove one energy from it and add four energy to another Creature you control.

text:
Sneaky Weebo's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Sneaky Weebo.
flavor:
"Yes, brother, they do seem to be taking a liking to you."
— Warrada

name: Stagadan Charger

powers.name: Siphon
powers.text: Choose an opposing Magi and one of your other Creatures. Move X energy from the chosen Magi to the chosen Creature. Use this Power only before your Attack step.

flavor:
"CHAAAAAAARGE!!!"
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Wandering Balamant

effects.name: Fetch
effects.text: As Wandering Balamant attacks, choose one of your other Creatures. Add two energy to that Creature.

effects.name: Wander
effects.text: Non-Naroom Magi may play Wandering Balamant without regional penalty.

flavor: A Wandering Balamant makes friends no matter where it goes but it always remembers where it came from.

name: Pruitt, Ringsmith

effects.name: Nurture
effects.text: Balamants you control lose one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Refresh
powers.text: Add two energy to each Balamant you control.

flavor: "Yaki, why won't you look at me? What have they done to you?"

name: Sive

effects.name: Research
effects.text: Relics cost you one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Knowledge
effects.text: As you use a Power on a Naroom Relic, choose a Creature you control and add one energy to it.

flavor: "The more I learn, the more I need to know."

name: T'Dek

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose a Creature with less than its starting energy and restore it to its printed starting energy.

text: T'Dek may only play Naroom and Universal cards.
flavor:
"He's a little abrasive but once you get to know him,
he's a pretty nice guy."
— Ohk, Explorer

name: Blooming Bracelet
text: Once per opposing turn, as energy is removed from one of your Creatures, add an equal amount of energy to your Magi.
flavor:
"That flower looks just like a blooming unjin."
— Marella, Savant

name: Remember Ring

powers.name: Good Ol' Days
powers.text: Discard Remember Ring from play. Put a Naroom Creature from your discard pile into play with one energy. That Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor:
"I remember when things were simpler. The Dark Twins
hadn't trashed Vash Naroom, Yaki smiled all the time
and Evu told us stories. Now look at things..."
— Pruitt, Ringsmith

name: Harvest Feast
text: Choose up to three Naroom Creatures. Add two energy to each of them.
flavor: "They may take our land, but they'll never take MY KITCHEN!" yelled Poad. With that, the coalition forces ate what might be their last meal before the assault on the Dark Twins.

name: Verdant Shield
text: Attach Verdant Shield to your Magi. While Verdant Shield is attached, Naroom Creatures lose one less energy in attacks. Discard Verdant Shield from play at the beginning of your turn.
flavor:
"If you don't think that leaves make good shields,
you've never dueled a Naroomi."
— Tuku

name: Grotto Phrup

powers.name: Dreamsynch
powers.text: Discard Grotto Phrup from play. Powers and Effects on opposing Relics currently in play may not be used until the beginning of your next turn. All ongoing Effects on opposing Relics in play are cancelled.

text: Orothe Shadow Magi may play Grotto Phrup.
flavor: Bria's phrup nullified the magic of the relics guarding Evu's study. A brief search of the premises revealed exactly what she had been looking for.

name: Malevolent Corf

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Orothe Creature and remove one energy from it. Place that Creature's remaining energy on its Magi and return it to its owner's hand.

text:
Malevolent Corf's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Malevolent Corf.
flavor:
"I don't usually find myself partial to Corfs but I really seem to like
these."
— The Real Qwade

name: Pearl Hyren

effects.name: Hoard
effects.text: After an opponent chooses a Relic you control with a Spell or Power, remove one energy from that opponent's Magi.

powers.name: Jealousy
powers.text: If you have at least one Relic in play, choose an opponent. If that player controls more Relics than you, add one energy to each Creature you control.

flavor: Pearl hyren are known for being protective when it comes to their owner's relics.

name: Porphin

effects.name: Bolster
effects.text: As Porphin attacks, add energy to it equal to the number of Relics you control. At the end of your Attack Step, discard Porphin from play.

flavor:
"The porphin is ugly, the porphin is small, but with
Relics in play, your foes will fall."
— Orothean Nursery Rhyme

name: Bria, Relic Hunter

effects.name: Desire
effects.text: After an opponent plays a Relic, add three energy to Bria, Relic Hunter.

effects.name: Loss
