effects.text: After a Relic you control is discarded from play, remove one energy from Bria, Relic Hunter.

text: Bria, Relic Hunter may play Core Relics.
flavor: "Qwade, it's perfect! How do I use it?"

name: Sellia

powers.name: Whirlpool
powers.text: Choose a non-Magi card of more than one Region. Discard it from play.

flavor: "You're entering the whirl of hurt."

name: Horn of Renewal

powers.name: Salvage
powers.text: Each player chooses up to four non-Universal Relics in his or her discard pile. Shuffle those Relics into their owner's deck. Discard Horn of Renewal from play.

flavor:
The Call of the Horn rings through the deep,
All Relics once lost are now yours to keep.
— Ancient Insciption

name: Parathin Shell

effects.name: Hide
effects.text: Once per turn, as a Creature you control is being attacked, you may move that Creature's energy to your Magi and shuffle the Creature into its owner's deck. You may not add more than the Creature's printed starting energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"Isn't it frustrating to find that your foes has simply vanished?"
— Arosa, Keeper

name: Sphor Charm

powers.name: Resourceful
powers.text: Choose a Creature and discard an Orothe Relic from your hand. Remove energy from the Creature equal to the cost of the Relic.

flavor:
"They're always after my lucky Sphor Charm!"
— Quilla

name: Possession's Glee
text: Add three energy to a Creature you control but do not own. Orothe Shadow Magi may play Possession's Glee.
flavor:
"The pull of the tide is irresistible."
— Arosa, Keeper

name: Ripcurl
text: Choose two opposing Creatures. Move up to four energy from the first Creature to the second Creature.
flavor:
Togoth laughed. "You old fool! You may have defeated
my drush but you've made my dryte stronger!"
"Don't worry, I've got plans for your dryte." Mobis said.

name: Jungle Eebit

effects.name: Defender
effects.text: If Jungle Eebit would be defeated in an attack, move up to two energy from your Magi to Jungle Eebit, after energy is removed, instead of discarding it from play.

flavor:
"They're tough little buggers... I'll give 'em that!"
— Yricho

name: Lurking Minani

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Paradwyn Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature removes no energy in attacks until the beginning of your next turn.

text:
Lurking Minani's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Lurking Minani.
flavor: Lurking low behind the jungle leaves, this Minani practices its ambushing skills on the inhabitants of Paradwyn.

name: Scarletsong Lahalou

powers.name: Screech
powers.text: Discard Scarletsong Lahalou from play. Add one energy to your Magi for each Scarletsong card you control.

flavor: A simple "chirp" from the scarletsong lahalou can alert large areas of the jungle to incoming foes.

name: Vine Bhatar

powers.name: Whiplash
powers.text: Choose a Stalked Creature. Move one energy from the Creature to Vine Bhatar.

flavor: With a powerful lash, the vine bhatar ripped energy from the gorath, leaving it dazed and breathless.

name: Iain, Commando

powers.name: Impair
powers.text: Each opposing Creature with more than its starting energy is reduced to its printed starting energy.

flavor: "Remember when I said I'd save you for last? I lied."

name: Mijji

effects.name: Guardian
effects.text: If an opposing Spell or Power would discard one of your Creatures from play, you may discard one energy from Mijji. If you do, remove all but one energy from your Creature instead.

text: Mijji ignores regional penalties on Naroom cards.
flavor: "This is my jungle, I have to defend it!"

name: Sqwik

effects.name: Sing the Scarletsong
effects.text: Your Paradwyn Creatures remove one extra energy in attacks.

effects.name: Perfect Pitch
effects.text: Your Scarletsong cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"It's fun to watch her pounce."
— Mijji

name: Scarletsong Banner

effects.name: Morale Boost
effects.text: Increase your energize by one. Draw an extra card during your Draw step.

text: After an opposing card removes energy from your Magi, discard Scarletsong Banner from play.
flavor:
The Scarletsong Banner brings joy for the taking.
— Ancient Inscription

name: Tripvine

effects.name: Stumble
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Creature attacks your Magi, move half of the Creature's energy, rounded up, to its Magi and return the Creature to its owner's hand.

flavor:
"Ooops! Did I cause that?"
— Laranel

name: Drum Solo
text: Choose two Paradwyn Creatures. Restore each Creature to its printed starting energy.
flavor:
"Let the beats commence!"
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Jungle Riddle
text: Discard a card from your hand and choose an opponent. That opponent removes up to five energy from his or her Magi. Add energy to your Magi equal to five minus the energy your opponent removed from his or her Magi.
flavor:
"Ninx's riddles leave people in such a confused state
that they can't tell whether he's a man or a woman."
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: Scarletsong Lilt
text: Choose an opposing Creature and attach Scarletsong Lilt to it. As the chosen Creature loses energy in an attack, remove two energy from the Creature's Magi. Discard Scarletsong Lilt from play at the beginning of your turn.
flavor: What is a lovely sound to native ears, can prove to be a dangerous distraction to foreigners.

name: Crystal Hyren

effects.name: Ricochet
effects.text: Once per turn, as Crystal Hyren is attacked, remove one energy from each opposing Creature.

powers.name: Illuminate
powers.text: Choose a Spell in play and discard it.

flavor:
"Look out for shrapnel!"
— Ulk, Prodigy

name: Crystal Saris

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Saris was not attacked, add two energy to it.

flavor: The Shadow Magi were far too busy fending off Gogor's assault to notice that the saris had doubled in size.

name: Crystal Twinklet

effects.name: Dream Charge
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Twinklet was not attacked, draw a card.

effects.name: Deflect
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses Crystal Twinklet, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead.

flavor:
"Ooh-pretty! Can I touch it?"
— Gruk

name: Pillar Hyren

effects.name: Stabilize
effects.text: As one of your Creatures is attacked, add one energy to it.

text: If your Magi is Underneath, Pillar Hyren may not be discarded from play by opposing Spells, Powers or Effects while it still has energy. Your Powers, Spells and Effects cannot reduce the amount of energy removed from Pillar Hyren in attacks.
flavor: Literally a pillar of strength, the Pillar Hyren lends the endurance of age-old stone to its comrades.

name: Venomous Korrit

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Underneath Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature gains "Effect - Weaken: As this Creature is attacked, remove two energy from it." until the end of your next turn.

text:
Venomous Korrit's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Venomous Korrit.
flavor:
"The only thing worse than its bite is its breath!"
— Strag, Adventurer

name: Gulg

powers.name: Fortify
powers.text: Add two energy to each Creature you control that defeated a Creature in an attack this turn.

flavor: "I wonder how long it'll take Strag to miss these spiffy claws?"

name: Ulk, Prodigy

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Korrits you control may not be chosen by opposing Powers.

effects.name: Fungal Bloom
effects.text: After you play a Korrit, add one energy to it.

flavor: "CUTE!? Is that ALL you think of me?! Watch this!"

name: Ulmi

effects.name: Crystal Affinity
effects.text: Crystal cards cost you one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Resist
effects.text: Your Crystal Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.

flavor: "Crystal is so sparkly, I just can't get enough of it!"

name: Crystal Goblet

effects.name: Renew
effects.text: After a Crystal Creature is discarded from play on an opposing turn, draw a card.

flavor:
"All you could wish for in fine crystal..."
— Ulmi

name: Kiesel's Hammer

powers.name: Daze
powers.text: Choose a Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature may not gain energy until the beginning of your next turn.

flavor:
"Finally! A tool worthy of the mighty Gogor!"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero

name: Rumble Stones

powers.name: Mini-Quake
powers.text: Remove one energy from each non-Underneath Creature and Magi.

flavor:
"At first, we thought it was a thunderquake. When we
looked around, all we saw was an Underling holding a
small stone in her hand."
— Valkan

name: Crystal Shield
text: Choose one of your Creatures and attach Crystal Shield to it. While Crystal Shield is attached, the Creature gains "Effect - Deflect: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses this Creature, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead. Discard Crystal Shield from play."
flavor:
"Oh no you don't!"
— Motash, Elder

name: Entrench
text: Choose a Creature and attach Entrench to it. While Entrench is attached, the Creature gains "Effect - Entrenched: As this Creature is attacked, add two energy to it. This Creature may not attack." A Creature may not have more than one Entrench attached.
flavor:
"Sometimes it's best to just hunker down and gather your strength!"
— Strag, Adventurer

name: Collosit

effects.name: Spare Parts
effects.text: Your Collosus and Construct cards cost one less to play, to a minimum of one.

text: Collosit may not be chosen by an Effect, Power or Spell that could cause it to change controllers.
flavor:
"A collosit is more than just a handy mechanic, it does windows too!"
— Tuku

name: Hapu

effects.name: True Friend
effects.text: As an opposing Spell or Power removes energy from your Magi, remove two less energy. If your Magi is Universal or Naroom, remove three less energy instead.

text: Hapu may not be chosen by an Effect, Power or Spell that could cause it to change controllers.
flavor:
"He's been with me longer than I care to remember. I
don't know what I'd do without my hapu."
— Tuku

name: Nightmare Construct

effects.name: Absorb
effects.text: After a Magi energizes, add one energy to Nightmare Construct. If that Magi is Core, add one extra energy to Nightmare Construct.

text: Nightmare Construct's starting energy is equal to your Magi's printed energize.
flavor:
"I've got something for that meddling Rayje, and his
little apprentice too."
— Warrada

name: Ancient's Puzzlebox

powers.name: Mind Games
powers.text: Discard Ancient's Puzzlebox from play. Reveal any number of cards in your hand and choose a Creature. Add one energy to it for each Ancient's Puzzlebox you reveal. Draw a card. You may not play another Ancient's Puzzlebox this turn.

text: Your deck may contain up to six copies of Ancient Puzzlebox.
flavor:
"I figured it out once before! Why can't I do it again?!"
— Zajan

name: Une's Scale

effects.name: Balance
effects.text: At the end of your turn, each player shuffles all but ten cards from their hand into their deck. If a player has ten cards or less, that player shuffles no cards into his or her deck.

flavor:
Greed is unbecoming a Magi.
— Ancient Proverb

name: Crushing Will
text: Choose a Creature and remove four energy from it. If this discards the Creature from play, choose up to two non-Universal Relics and discard them from play.  Only Universal and Universal Shadow Magi can play Crushing Will.
flavor:
"It takes a willful man to stand alone in the Moonlands 
with no allegiances but himself."
— Orwin, Elder

name: Scurrying Weggit

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Weave Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature must attack one of your Creatures immediately, regardless of Spells, Powers or Effects. You choose which Creature is attacked.

text:
Scurrying Weggit's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Scurrying Weggit.
flavor: The scurrying weggit is unparalleled in irritating other Dream Creatures; especially those of its own kind!

name: Speag Sprouts

effects.name: Weave Strength
effects.text: After energy is moved to Speag Sprouts on an opponent's turn, add one energy to Speag Sprouts.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

flavor: At a gesture from Iyori, the speag sprouts swarmed as the core hyren dove in for an attack. Weaving energy between themselves, the sprouts began to grow in size.

name: Toasted Yajo

effects.name: Brittle
effects.text: As Toasted Yajo is attacked, you may shuffle it into its owner's deck and draw a card.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

text: Cald Spells and Powers cannot choose Toasted Yajo.
flavor:
"Do you smell something burning?"
— Quirle

name: Weave Arboll

effects.name: Weave's Gift
effects.text: After Weave Arboll is defeated in an attack, add one energy to each of your Creatures with the effect "Weave".

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

flavor:
"Ooh-it's all wrinkly! Yuck!"
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Keru

powers.name: Weed
powers.text: Search your deck for up to three cards and discard them. Shuffle your deck and draw a card.

flavor: "The tuk berries taste like tuk berries!"

name: Marella, Savant

effects.name: Ignorance
effects.text: Your non-Junjertrug cards cost one extra energy to play.

effects.name: Bliss
effects.text: Each of your Junjertrug cards costs two less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor: "Oh, right. The relic. The relic for Gia, the relic chosen specially to help Gia. Gia's relic. Uhh... that relic?"

name: Ushi

effects.name: Blunt
effects.text: Creatures may not use the Effect "Weave".

powers.name: Motivate
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, each of your Creatures with the Effect "Weave" gains two energy as it attacks.

flavor:
"Ushi's method of motivation usually involves a rather large hammer."
— Kolte

name: Weave Maul

powers.name: Crush
powers.text: Remove one energy from each Creature without the Effect "Weave".

flavor:
"There is no power, no magic, no force in the whole of
the Moonlands that can defeat me while I carry my hammer."
— Ushi

name: Weave-woven Anklet

effects.name: Tied to the Weave
effects.text: If each Creature you control has the Effect "Weave", increase your Magi's energize by one.

effects.name: Memento
effects.text: If Weave-woven Anklet is discarded from play by an opposing Spell or Power, choose one Weave Spell in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

flavor:
"It's SO pretty! But... I think it gave me this weird rash!"
— Marella, Savant

name: Countless Blades
text: Move one energy from each opposing Creature to your Magi. Your Powers, Spells and Effects cannot increase the energy moved by Countless Blades.
flavor:
"In the Weave, each and every blade of grass is a 
potential enemy or ally. It all depends on your perspective."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Quallon's Quest
text: Discard a Weave Creature from your hand. Reveal a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the Creature's starting energy. Choose up to two Creatures from the revealed cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your deck.
flavor:
"The power of freedom, the freedom of choice,
When Quallon does find, the Weave's one true Voice."
— excerpt from Ancient Epic Poem

name: Brannix

effects.name: Charge
effects.text: Whenever Brannix attacks a non-Arderial Creature, add one energy to Brannix before energy is removed.

effects.name: Absorption
effects.text: Whenever Brannix attacks an Arderial Creature, add three energy to Brannix before energy is removed.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Brannix.
flavor: Storms feed on storms.

name: Flutter Yup

effects.name: Dodge
effects.text: Whenever Flutter Yup attacks or is attacked by a Creature with more than three energy, Flutter Yup loses no energy in the attack.

flavor:
"Long, long ago, children didn't know how to cry for their mommies. Then
the Ancients made flutter yups."
— Ora, Shieldmaiden

name: J'lith

effects.name: Collector
effects.text: Whenever any player plays a Relic, once per turn, add two energy to J'lith.

errata.previous_text: Whenever any player plays a Relic, add two energy to J'lith.
errata.change: Collector triggers once a turn.
errata.source: The 2001 Arderial Demo Pack version is the MRP of J'lith.

effects.name: Coveting
effects.text: If you ever have no Relics in play, discard J'lith from play.

flavor:
"I've got more magical trinkets than I can count, and I'm still little old
me!"
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Night Hyren

effects.name: Stealth
effects.text: If an opposing Magi does not have any Creatures with more than five energy in play, Night Hyren may attack that Magi directly.

effects.name: Charge
effects.text: If Night Hyren attacks a Magi, add two energy to Night Hyren before energy is removed.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Night Hyren.
flavor:
The darkness brings the sound of wings.
The Hyren swoops and turns.
A watchful eyes blots out the sky,
And like a beacon burns.

name: Vemment

powers.name: Evaporate
powers.text: Choose any one non-Arderial Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. If the chosen Creature is Orothe, discard two additional energy.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Vemment.
flavor:
"The wind is thirsty. Watch yourselves, boys."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Warlum

powers.name: Materialize
powers.text: Choose any one player. Discard Warlum from play. Search the chosen player's deck for any one Relic that you can normally play and play it without paying any costs. Shuffle the deck. Arderial and Orothe Shadow Magi may play Warlum.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one player. Discard Warlum from play. Search the chosen player's deck for any one Relic and put it into play under your Magi's control. Shuffle the chosen player's deck.
errata.change: You can only play Relics of your Magi's Region or that are Universal with Materialize.
errata.source: The 2001 Arderial Demo pack version is the MRP of Warlum.

text: Arderial and Orothe Shadow Magi may play Warlum.
flavor:
Lasada gaped. "Where did THAT come from?"
"Don't ask," whispered the Warlum, and with a swish it vanished.

name: Yarothis

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Yarothis.

powers.name: Scouring Gale
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor: A wind to blow foulness away.

name: Aula

powers.name: Windsight
powers.text: Discard your hand. Draw five cards. You may not use Windsight with less than two cards in your hand.

flavor: The answer drifted by on a cloud, and she reached out and grabbed it.

name: Kalius

powers.name: Wind Spawn
powers.text: Play any one Arderial Creature from your hand. Place two energy on it instead of its normal starting energy. Discard that Creature from play at the end of this turn.

flavor: "Come unto me, all ye of the wind, for I will give you breath."

name: Sorreah

effects.name: Suppress
effects.text: Effects and Powers on other Magi may not be used.

flavor:
"This is your last chance. Free us or... wait... Hey! NO!"
— O'Qua, Summoner

name: Abwyn's Quill

effects.name: Overwrite
effects.text: Once per turn, as a player plays a Spell or uses a Power that specifies one or more regions, before any choices are made, you may discard two energy from your Magi. If you do, change one of the specified regions to a region of your choice. Overwrite only affects this use of the Spell or Power.

errata.previous_text: Whenever any player plays a Spell or uses a Power that specifies one or more regions, before any choices are made, you may discard two energy from your Magi. If you do, change one of the specified regions to a region of your choice.  You may only use Overwrite once per Spell or Power, with Overwrite lasting until the end of the current turn.
errata.change: Overwrite can only be used once a turn. Clarified duration.

flavor:
"He picked up the altered scroll and said 'Burn, you fool!' — then
shot a string of flowers at me. I was laughing so hard, I could hardly
hold on to the quill."
— Abwyn's Journal

name: Alaban Gloves

powers.name: Undream
powers.text: (3) Choose a Creature in play. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand. Place that Creature's energy on its current Magi. If this is your Magi, you cannot add energy to your Magi beyond the Creature's printed starting energy.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Creature in play. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand. Place that Creature's energy on its current Magi.
errata.change: Undream's text has been adjusted to proper text templating rules.

flavor:
"Imagine empty" — Inscription on left-hand glove
"space here." — Inscription of right-hand glove

name: Arderian-Guard Wings

effects.name: Feathered Protection
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, discard up to two less energy from each Creature.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Arderian-Guard Wings.
flavor:
"Kid, when Kalius says he's taking you under his wing,
he really means it."
— Aula, Arderial Diviner

name: Cry of Thunder
text: Play Cry of Thunder only before your Attack Step. Add two energy to each of your Arderial Creatures in play. Also, add one energy to each of your Xyx in play. At the end of your turn, discard from play each of your Creatures that did not attack this turn.
flavor: We have no trampling feet with which to make thunder, but we have thunder with which to make trampling feet.

name: Solar Flare
text: Add four energy to each of your Arderial Creatures that attacked and defeated an opposing Creature this turn.
flavor:
"Solar flares are heralds proclaiming our victory!"
"Really? I thought they were stellar plasma prominences, triggered by
fusion reactions."

name: Tranquility
text: Until the beginning of your next turn, all Spells, Powers, and Effects that would discard energy may not be played. Draw one additional card during your Draw Step this turn.
flavor:
"We know the calm as well as the storm."
— Jaela, Arderial Regis

name: Ash Hyren

powers.name: Devitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with more than its starting energy. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

text: Cald Shadow Magi may play Ash Hyren.
flavor:
"Everything goes from ashes to ashes... but in between there is life."
— Magam, Cald Ringsmith

name: Braggle

effects.name: Mirror Shield
effects.text: Braggle loses no energy in attacks involving opposing Creatures of the same region as Braggle.

powers.name: Morph
powers.text: Choose any one region. Until the start of your next turn, Braggle is a Creature of the chosen region, instead of Cald.

flavor:
"You know, if you look at it from this angle it kind of looks like water."
— Calderan citizen

name: Ergar

effects.name: Ignite
effects.text: While Ergar is in play, each of your Cald Creatures in play gains the following text: "Power — Spark: (1) Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature or Magi."

flavor:
"Who would you like to get blasted by today?"
— Barak, Cald Warlord

name: Ithapher

powers.name: Combustion
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, each Spell of Power that discards energy from a single Creature discards one additional energy.

flavor:
"Anyone who uses the word 'fireproof' has never run into an ithapher."
— Valkan, Cald Pyromancer

name: Magma Jile

effects.name: Hunger
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Creature with a starting energy of two or less, you may add two energy to Magma Jile.

text: Cald Shadow Magi may play Magma Jile.
flavor:
"It turned my twee into a scratching post."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Primat

powers.name: Kindle
powers.text: Discard Primat from play. Discard from play each Creature with one energy. Discard from play each Naroom Creature with two energy.

text: Cald Shadow Magi may play Primat.
flavor: They frequently cause scrub fires.

name: Yollum

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Yollum.

powers.name: Incinerate
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature or Magi in play. Discard six energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.

flavor: A blaze to consume what is tainted.

name: Nara

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: All Ergars and Jiles in play that you control are unaffected by non-Cald Spells.

effects.name: Rare Spirit
effects.text: Whenever a Cald Spell adds energy to one or more of your Creatures in play, instead add twice as much energy to each Creature.

flavor: "Step on no pets!"

name: Raega

powers.name: Cremate
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with X energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor: "They all look the same when I'm through with them."

name: Ven

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy. This Power may add or discard energy.

flavor: "More power to you!"

name: Blast Gloves

effects.name: Flame Boost
effects.text: Whenever any player plays a Spell that discards energy from a single Creature, you may discard Blast Gloves from play. If you do, that Spell discards twice as much energy.

flavor: Where does he gets those wonderful toys?

name: Gorgle's Glasses

effects.name: Pyrovision
effects.text: Whenever you discard all of an opposing Creature's energy with a Spell or Power, draw one card.

flavor: "You looking at me...?"

name: Sinder's Mantle

effects.name: Omen of Fire
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, add two energy to that Creature before energy is removed.

effects.name: Burnout
effects.text: Discard Sinder's Mantle from play if any of your Creatures is discarded from play.

text: Cald Shadow Magi may play Sinder's Mantle.
flavor:
Burst like magma from the peak,
Raise the strong and crush the weak.

name: Firefly Swarm
text: Choose any one non-Cald Creature in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature. That Creature may not attack on its controller's next turn.
flavor:
"Oh give me a home, where the Leaf Hyren roam,
Where the Pliths and Carillions play,
Where always is heard, the Furok's horn bird,
And the bugs don't keep burning all day!"
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Sulfurous Spirit
text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. Cald Shadow Magi may play Sulfurous Spirit.
flavor: "This is the end of you, and you."

name: Wildfire
text: Choose any one non-Cald region. Discard two energy from each Creature in play of the chosen region.
flavor:
"For such an erratic spell, it's awfully picky."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Arboll Stalker

powers.name: Detonate
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Arboll Stalker from play. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Hypnosis? That's the least of your worries."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Black Agovo

powers.name: Disrupt
powers.text: Choose any one player. Discard Black Agovo from play. The chosen player discards three cards from his or her hand.

text: Underneath Magi may play Black Agovo.
flavor:
"Their victimsss would mind if they ssstill had mindsss."
— Ogar

name: Borgor

powers.name: Sever
powers.text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Discard half of the energy from each of the chosen Creatures, rounded up.

flavor: No quarter. Just halves.

name: Chaos Jile

effects.name: Weakness
effects.text: If Chaos Jile is attacked, discard three energy from it after energy is removed.

effects.name: Rebound
effects.text: If Chaos Jile attacks a Creature, add four energy to it after energy is removed.

text: Naroom Magi may play Chaos Jile.
flavor:
"More kittiesss to play with the child."
— Ogar

name: Core Grag

powers.name: Firestorm
powers.text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard Core Grag from play. Discard two energy from each of the chosen Magi's Creature in play. Discard three energy from the chosen Magi.

text: Cald Magi may play Core Grag.
flavor: Rain that chooses who it falls on.

name: Core Hyren

effects.name: Dissect
effects.text: Each turn, during your Draw Step, draw one additional card for each Creature Core Hyren attacked and defeated that turn.

flavor:
"Your knowledge will not die with you."
— Morag, the Executor

name: Dark Ayebaw

powers.name: Implode
powers.text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard Dark Ayebaw from play, and discard X Core and/or Arderial cards from your hand. Discard X+2 energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Ayebaw.
flavor: O'Qua was surprised to find the Core using a weapon from her own arsenal.

name: Darkbreed Hyren

powers.name: Subvert
powers.text: Choose any one hyren in play. Gain control of the chosen hyren. That hyren may not attack this turn.

flavor: One hyren to bring them all, and in the darkness bind them.

name: Dryte Fiend

effects.name: Condemn
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your opponent's turns, you may choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of that opponent's turn, each time the chosen Creature loses energy as a result of Powers, Spells, or attacks, discard three energy from that Creature. Cald Magi may play Dryte Fiend.

errata.previous_text: At the beginning of each of your opponent's turns, you may choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of that opponent's turn, each time the chosen Creature loses energy from Powers, Spells, or attacks, it loses three additional energy.
errata.change: Clarification that energy costs to use Powers does not trigger Condemn.

text: Cald Magi may play Dryte Fiend.
flavor:
"He has been marked. Let him come, if he dares."
— Morag, the Executor

name: Gorath

powers.name: Enslave
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than X energy. Gain control of the chosen Creature. The chosen Creature may not attack this turn. If Gorath leaves play, return all Creatures Enslaved by Gorath to their owners' control.

flavor: "I will own all of you."

name: Grax

powers.name: Tendril
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard half of the chosen Creature's energy, rounded up.

flavor:
"My Super Big Grax Team will handle this! Go Grax!"
— Korg, Core Warrior

name: Grubble

powers.name: Dreamform
powers.text: Choose any one other Grubble in play. Discard both this Grubble and the chosen Grubble from play. Search your deck for any one Creature and play that Creature with its starting energy.

flavor: "The merging is complete!"

name: Koil

effects.name: Nightmare
effects.text: When you play Koil, choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Re-Koil
effects.text: If Koil is defeated in an attack, after it is discarded from play, choose any one player's discard pile. Shuffle the chosen discard pile into its owner's deck.

flavor:
"Those who survive the nightmares it brings do not survive the nightmares
it brings back."
— Togoth, the Guardian

name: Orok

effects.name: Undermine
effects.text: Whenever Orok loses energy in an attack, choose any one Magi in play. Discard half as much energy as Orok just loses from the chosen Magi, rounded down.

text: Naroom Magi may play Orok.
flavor:
"So what's the bird on its horn called?"
— Sperri, Friend of Furoks

name: Shadow Vinoc

effects.name: Dark Strength
effects.text: When you play Shadow Vinoc, add one energy to it for each opposing Relic in play.

errata.previous_text: When you play Shadow Vinoc, add one energy to it for each Relic in play.
errata.change: Dark Strength only works with opposing Relics.

flavor:
"It's an improvement over its forest cousin. Soil is such an unreliable
thing to draw strength from."
— Togoth

name: Shryque

effects.name: Mindless Abandon
effects.text: If you have no cards in your hand at the beginning of your Draw Step, add two energy to Shryque.

effects.name: Dream Vengeance
effects.text: If you have no cards in your hand at the beginning of your turn, add five energy to Shryque.

text: Arderial Magi may play Shryque.
flavor:
"Birds like wide empty spaces.
Dream birds like wide empty minds."
— Harror

name: Szalak

powers.name: Supercharge
powers.text:
Roll a die:
1, 2 = Add five energy to Szalak.
3, 4 = Discard Szalak from play.
5, 6 = Add three energy to Szalak and three energy to your Magi.

flavor: "zzzzzMMMMMzzzzzzzzzzzMMMzMMMzzzzzzzzMMMzzzzzBOOM!"

name: Tragan

effects.name: Weakness
effects.text: If Tragan is attacked, discard two energy from Tragan before energy is removed.

effects.name: Boost
effects.text: When Tragan is played, add three energy to it.

text: Orothe Magi may play Tragan.
flavor: The darkness is intimidating until someone holds out a light.

name: Trask

effects.name: Lifetap
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to one or more Creatures in play, add one energy to Trask.

text: Orothe Magi may play Trask.
flavor:
It's like an alligator
with scales and teeth and claws,
It's like a Coral Hyren,
but not afraid of Cawhs.

name: Ugger

effects.name: Borrow
effects.text: Whenever Ugger attacks, you may move any amount of energy from one of your other Creatures to Ugger before energy is removed.

text: Underneath Magi may play Ugger.
flavor: It sees its enemies as dirt and its friends as shovels.

name: Vrill

effects.name: Succor
effects.text: At the end of your Energize Steps, move two energy from your Magi to Vrill.

powers.name: Nightfall
powers.text: All of your Core Creatures in play gain energy equal to their starting energy.

flavor:
We all must unite when the night falls
That we might survive till the day.

name: Wudge

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever any other Creature is played, add one energy to Wudge.

flavor: Its strength is in its enemies' numbers.

name: Agram

effects.name: Focus
effects.text: Before Agram energizes during your Energize Step, permanently add one to his energize rate.

effects.name: Opportunist
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if Agram's energize rate is 10 or more, and if you have another Magi in your Magi pile, place Agram at the bottom of your Magi pile face down. Discard all of your cards from play, and play your next Magi face up. If Agram energizes for 11 or more, and he is your last Magi, you lose the game.

powers.name: Possess
powers.text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play and any one opposing Creature in play with less energy than your chosen Creature. Discard your chosen Creature. Gain control of the chosen opposing Creature. That Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor: His eyes were taken for seeing the secrets of darkness.

name: Korg & Zet

effects.name: Korg
effects.text: Korg & Zet may play no more than two cards each turn and may not play Relics.

effects.name: Zet
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, once per attack, one of your other Creatures may join in the attack. The defending Creature's player chooses one of your attacking Creatures to lose energy in the attack.

text: Korg & Zet count as two Magi for deck construction.
flavor:
"ZET!!! I have a plan so cunning, you could brush your teeth with it!"
"YOU?! Cunning?"

name: Morag

powers.name: Theft
powers.text: (X) Choose any one opposing Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic for X turns, beginning with the current turn. At the end of X turns, or if Morag is defeated, return the chosen Relic to its owner's hand.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic for your next X turns. At the end of X turns, or if Morag is defeated, return that Relic to its owner's hand.
errata.change: Theft only works on opposing Relics. Clarification as too the Relic's theft duration.

flavor: "What power! It just gets stronger every time I use it!"

name: Nagsis

effects.name: Possession
effects.text: If Nagsis is defeated and your next Magi is non-Core, that Magi becomes a Shadow Magi of its original region. All rules for Shadow Magi apply to the new Magi.

flavor: Don't worry, I'll be back.

name: Harror

effects.name: Spellfire
effects.text: Whenever any player plays a Spell, you may choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.

flavor: "I'm a blade with which my master strikes fear."

name: Lanyx

powers.name: Harvest
powers.text: Choose any one non-Core Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"I used to take a torch to the fields of grain.
Now, I take a scythe."

name: Warrada

effects.name: Dark Blooming
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if Warrada has no creatures in play, add five energy to Warrada.

flavor: "The Shadow sees all."

name: Qwade

powers.name: Leech
powers.text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Discard X energy from one of the chosen Creatures. Add X energy to the other chosen Creature.

flavor: "You think this is the real Qwade? ...It is!"

name: Korremar

powers.name: Mind Shock
powers.text: Choose any one player. Skip your Draw Step this turn. During the chosen player's next turn, he or she may only draw one card.

flavor: As cold, dark, and barren as a desert at night.

name: Ogar

effects.name: Feral Instinct
effects.text:
Whenever a Creature is played, roll a die:
1, 2, 3 = Choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the
chosen Creature;
4, 5, 6 = Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the
chosen Creature.

flavor: "Ook, no, Ogar doesssn't let her petsss' dinner get away."

name: Agram's Armor

effects.name: Shield
effects.text: At the beginning of each player's turn, choose any one of your Creatures in play. The chosen Creature loses two less energy from each attack this turn.

flavor: "You rang?"

name: Chaos Sphere

effects.name: Impending
effects.text: Whenever your Magi energizes, roll a die. Add Chaos Counters equal to the die roll to Chaos Sphere.

powers.name: Doom
powers.text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard 15 Chaos Counters from Chaos Sphere, and discard Chaos Sphere from play. Discard from play all Creatures controlled by the chosen Magi.

flavor: "Your time is running out."

name: Collar of Despair

effects.name: Strangle
effects.text: Reduce all energize rates in play by one.

flavor:
"Anyone can choke under this pressure."
— Warrada, the Shadow

name: Grim Goblet

effects.name: Backlash
effects.text: If your opponent removes Grim Goblet from play, discard your hand.

powers.name: Reap
powers.text: Discard Grim Goblet from play. Draw three cards. You may not use Reap if you played Grim Goblet this turn.

text: Cald Magi may play Grim Goblet.
flavor:
"Dark sustenance for dark hearts. Foul knowledge wrapped in shadows.
It breeds nightmares."
— Gia, Weave Seer

name: Shadow Bones

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature in play. Discard Shadow Bones from play. Add energy to the chosen Creature equal to that Creature's starting energy.

flavor:
"Works better than dream balm on them nightmares.
But ye probably couldn't stand the taste of it."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Shadow Cloak

powers.name: Protection
powers.text: (2) Each of your Core Creatures currently in play cannot be affected by non-Core Spells and Powers until the end of your next turn. You may not use Protection during your next turn.

errata.previous_text: Each of your Core Creatures in play is not affected by non-Core Spells and Powers until the end of your next turn. You may not use Shadow Cloak on your next turn.
errata.change: The Power Protection, and not the card Shadow Cloak, can not be used on the following turn.

flavor: A night's gown.

name: Anarchy
text: Each player chooses one Creature controlled by the player to his or her right. All chosen Creatures are shuffled together face down and one is dealt to each player. Each Creature is restored to its starting energy. Anarchy may only be played if each player is able to choose a creature.
flavor: The Core is run with ruthless, efficient order — but ruthless, efficient chaos suits them just as well.

name: Blight
text: Discard two energy from each non-Core, non-Bograth Creature and Magi in play. Add one energy to each Core and Bograth Creature and Magi in play. Bograth Magi may play Blight.
flavor:
Spreading suffering, heartless, sickening,
Blackened offering, darkness thickening.

name: Corrupt
text: Choose any one Magi in play. Attack Corrupt to the chosen Magi. If the chosen Magi is discarded from play, discard Corrupt from play. When a Creature is played by any Magi, discard Corrupt from play. The Creature played becomes a Core Creature instead of its original region, and your Magi gains control of that Creature.
flavor: Give yourself to the darkness.

name: Dream Rift
text: Take all Creature cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your decK. Draw three cards. Arderial Magi may play Dream Rift.
flavor: The dam broke and the dreams flooded through.

name: Entomb
text: Choose any one Spell. For the rest of this game, all Spells of that name are considered Core instead of their normal region.
flavor:
"Even your spells no longer belong to you."
— Morag, the Executor

name: Gloom
text: Choose any one player. Discard each of the chosen player's Creatures from play. For each Creature, the chosen player may discard one cards from his or her hand or discard one energy from his or her Magi to prevent the Creature from being discarded.
flavor: The night has an appetite.

name: Maelstrom
text:
Discard X energy from each opposing Magi in play.
Orothe Magi may play Maelstrom.
flavor: For hitting the dreamers instead of their dreams.

name: Mind Blank
text:
All players reveal their hands and discard all Spell cards shown.
Sands of d'Resh Magi may play Mind Blank.
flavor: You... know... not!

name: Paranoia
text: Choose any one Creature in play. The chosen Creature can only attack if opposing Magi control no Creatures with six or more energy. Attach Paranoia to the chosen Creature. Discard Paranoia if the chosen Creature is discarded from play.
flavor:
"We need no walls other than their fears."
— Morag, the Executor

name: Shadow Rain
text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Transfer all of the energy on your Magi to the chosen Creature. At the end of your Attack Step, transfer all energy from the chosen Creature your Magi, and draw one card. Naroom Magi may play Shadow Rain.
flavor:
"This spell looks interesting..."
— Evu, Naroom Loremaster

name: Terrorize
text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks, it loses no energy in the attack. Underneath Magi may play Terrorize.
flavor:
"If we are too afraid to fight back, then we have already lost."
— Jaela, Arderial Regis

name: Turn
text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. X is the chosen Creature's starting energy. The chosen Creature becomes Core and you gain control of it. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.
flavor: "Agram will show you the true nature of power. He is your master now."

name: Bikneets

powers.name: Shield
powers.text: Choose any one Naroom Creature in play. Discard Bikneets from play. The chosen Creature loses no energy from opponents' attacks, Spells or Powers until the beginning of your next turn.

flavor: "Eidon's like... far out man."

name: Forest Hyren

effects.name: Underbrush
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to Forest Hyren, add an additional energy to Forest Hyren.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose any one other Creature in play. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Forest Hyren.
flavor: From life comes life.

name: Forest Jile

powers.name: Reinforce
powers.text: Add two energy to each of your Creatures that attacked this turn.

flavor: "The jile roars! That means the battle is won!"

name: Furok Guardian

effects.name: Terra Rebirth
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is discarded from play, you may discard five energy from Furok Guardian. If you do, return the discarded Creature to play with its starting energy at the end of the current player's turn.

flavor: Power overwhelming.

name: Tillant

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Tillant.

effects.name: Cleansing Strike
effects.text: Whenever Tillant attacks a Core Creature, add five energy to Tillant before energy is removed.

flavor: A seed to coax life from decay.

name: Tree Hinko

powers.name: Invigorate
powers.text: The next time your Magi energizes, he or she energizes for two additional energy.

flavor:
"Gotta get me one of these!"
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Wasperine

effects.name: Rush
effects.text: If your Magi is a Naroom or Naroom Shadow Magi, you may play Wasperine at the beginning of your Attack Step, paying all costs.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Wasperine.
flavor:
Green. White and orange. Red. Lots of red. Then black.
— Description of a Wasperine attack

name: Ohk

powers.name: Mind's Gift
powers.text: Discard any one Creature card from your hand. Choose any one Creature in play. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: "Dreams have energy, whether they're waiting in your head or fighting on the field."

name: Sperri

effects.name: Infuse
effects.text: Whenever Sperri plays a Furok, add two additional energy to the Furok.

powers.name: Preserve
powers.text: Return any one Furok from your discard pile to your hand.

flavor: "Happiness is a furry friend and a flock of blue birds."

name: Tiller

powers.name: Exchange
powers.text: Discard any one Creature card from your hand. Draw one card.

powers.name: Scrounge
powers.text: Discard any one Relic card from your hand. Draw two cards.

flavor: "Baloo Root? Does anyone want a chunk of fault-ridden Baloo Root skin? I'm only going to... throw it away!"

name: Essence of Naroom

powers.name: Call of the Wild
powers.text: Choose any one Naroom, Weave, or Paradwyn Creature in play. Discard Essence of Naroom from play. Gain control of the chosen Creature. That Creature may not attack this turn.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Essence of Naroom.
flavor: Distilled, fermented life force. Aged over 600 years. Drink moderately. Serve chilled.

name: Fird Stone

effects.name: Fird Favor
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power would affect one or more of your Furoks in play, you may discard two energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell or Power does not affect any of your Furoks in play.

flavor:
"Just holding it makes you feel large and furry, and if you don't have
antlers, the firds will come sit on your shoulders!"
— Sperri, Friend of Furoks

name: Weeblit

powers.name: Season
powers.text: Choose any one Weebo and any one other Creature in play. Discard Weeblit and the chosen Weebo from play. Add five energy to the other chosen Creature.

flavor:
Weeblit (TM) One-Use Magical Mushroom Cooker
Manufactured by The Weeblit Co.
Moonlands patent pending.

name: Deadfall
text: Until the beginning of your next turn, the next two Creatures played lose half of their starting energy, rounded up. Naroom Shadow Magi may play Deadfall.
flavor: "It's a trap!"

name: Forest Blessing
text: Restore each Naroom Creature in play with less than its starting energy to its starting energy.
flavor:
"You got any Sap of Life?"
"NO! WE'RE ALL OUT OF SAP OF LIFE!"
"Well, in that case... in that case, what DO you have?"

name: Gilded Cage
text: Choose any one non-Naroom Creature in play. The chosen Creature may not used any of its Powers or Effects until the beginning of your next turn. If an opponent's Spell, Power, or Effect discards Gilded Cage from your hand, draw cards equal to the number of cards in that opponent's hand.
flavor: A bountiful gift for those with the key.

name: Allio

effects.name: Douse
effects.text: Whenever Allio is attacked by a Cald Creature, add four energy to Allio before energy is removed.

flavor:
"Allio mints! The best way to remove that spicy food taste from your
mouth."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Hunter Jile

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Hunter Jile.

powers.name: Drench
powers.text: Choose any one player. Discard Hunter Jile from play. The chosen player reveals his or her hand and discards all Core Creature shown.

flavor:
A great wave to wash out corruption;
A hunter to stalk shadow prey.

name: Husp

powers.name: Ensnare
powers.text: Discard Husp from play. Search through any player's deck and select up to three different cards. That player may place one of the chosen cards back into the deck. The other chosen cards are discarded. Shuffle the deck afterward.

errata.previous_text: Discard Husp from play. Search through any player's deck. You may remove up to three different cards from the deck and place them in their owner's discard pile. Shuffle the deck afterward.
errata.change: Two of the Three cards chosen by Ensnare are discarded, instead of all three.

flavor:
You say there are three things you can do to utterly wreck me? You mean
this, and this, and this?

name: Phrup

effects.name: Time Lapse
effects.text: As an opponent plays a card, you may discard Phrup from play. If you do so, return the card being played to its owner's hand. No energy costs for the card are paid (all other costs still apply). Cards with the same name as the card affected by Time Lapse cannot be played again this turn.

errata.previous_text: Whenever an opponent plays a card you may discard Phrup from play. If you do, return the card to its owner's hand. Any energy that was used is returned to that player's Magi. Cards with that name may not be played again this turn. Orothe Shadow Magi may play Phrup.
errata.change: > Phrup has been clarified with the 'As' wording. Costs expended for the card that was affected by Time Lapse are clarified.

flavor: "Thanks for the info. Maybe later..."

name: Reef Hyren

effects.name: Rebuke
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Creature, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, discard two energy from the Creature played.

flavor: Cast blindly in shallow waters and you will hook yourself a reef.

name: Sarazen Guard

effects.name: Protect
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is attacked, you may choose to have the attacking Creature attack the Sarazen Guard instead. If you do, the attacking player chooses and discards one card from his or her hand after energy is removed.

flavor: It's hard to be more watchful than a guard with five heads.

name: Weethan

effects.name: Impede
effects.text: Whenever an opponent draws a card, you may discard one energy from Weethan to force that player to choose and discard any one card from their hand. Impede cannot be used more than once each turn and only one Weethan can use Impede each turn. Orothe Shadow Magi may play Weethan.

flavor: "Hey! Stop that!"

name: Borse

powers.name: Tinker
powers.text: Choose any one of your Relics in play. Discard the chosen Relic from play. Reveal the top five cards of your deck to all players. Play one of the revealed Relics, regardless of Region. Place all other revealed cards into your discard pile.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one of your Relics in play. Discard the chosen Relic from play. Reveal the top five cards of your deck to all players. Put one of each Relic revealed into play, regardless of region. Place all other revealed cards into your discard pile.
errata.change: You may only play one Relic revealed with Tinker.

flavor: "I can make an energy band out of a baloo root. But sometimes I get a rod of coals."

name: Quilla
flavor: "Call me a fool if you want. You know I'm more powerful than the likes of you."

name: Voda

effects.name: Deluge
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add four energy to the Creature in play with the most energy. If two or more Creatures are tied for the most energy, an opponent of your choice chooses which Creature gets the energy.

flavor: "It's out of control!"

name: Hubdra's Cube

powers.name: Relic Subversion
powers.text: Choose any one other Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic, and place it on Hubdra's Cube. You may not use this Power if there is already a Relic on Hubdra's Cube. If Hubdra's Cube leaves play, discard all Relics on it.

flavor:
"He drew his sword and said 'Take this!'
So I did."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Karak Band

effects.name: Acquisition
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever you gain control of an opposing player's card, add two energy to your Magi.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you gain control of an opposing player's card, add two energy to your Magi.
errata.change: Acquisition triggers once a turn.

flavor: Your loss becomes my gain.

name: Orothean Horn

powers.name: Call of the Sea
powers.text: Use this Power only after your Play Creatures Step, and only if you have no Creatures in play. Place the top card of your deck into your discard pile. If the card is a Creature, discard Orothean Horn from play. Play the Creature with its starting energy, ignoring all costs. While it remains in play, the Creature cannot attack.

errata.previous_text: Use this Power only after your Play Creatures Step, and only if you have no Creatures in play. Put the top card of your deck into your discard pile. If the card is a Creture, discard Orothean Horn from play. Play the Creature with its starting energy, without paying any costs.
errata.change: A Creature played through Call of the Sea can not attack.

flavor: "Who is it?"

name: Boil
text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard one energy from each of the chosen Magi's Creatures in play. Discard two additional energy from each of the chosen Magi's Orothe and Bograth Creatures in play. Cald Magi may play still Spell without a regional penalty.
flavor: Some Orothe Creatures are more than 98% water.

name: Pillar of Brine
text: Choose any one player. During the chosen player's next turn, each of his or her Creatures removes two less energy from opposing Creatures when they attack.
flavor:
"You will learn to respect the power of..." (goosh)
"Arrg ptoo! Respect the power..." (goosh)
"Ack burble blecch! Respect..." (goosh)
— Korg, Core Warrior

name: Storm of Fishes
text: Choose Spells or Relics. All players reveal their hands and discard all cards of the chosen type shown. Orothe Shadow Magi may play Storm of Fishes.
flavor:
"How bad can a rain of fish be?"
"Depends on the kind and number of fish."

name: Athik

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Athik.

powers.name: Smite
powers.text: Choose any one Core Magi in play. Discard all energy from the chosen Magi.

flavor: A rock to stand firm against evil.

name: Crystal Jile

powers.name: Earthbound
powers.text: Choose any Magi in play. Add six energy to the chosen Magi.

text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Crystal Jile.
flavor:
"The bee's knees! The jile's style! I am all of these times twenty!"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero of the Underneath

name: Ghost Bwisp

effects.name: Glow
effects.text: All of your Creatures can attack while burrowed.

flavor:
Strag watched the Core forces fan out through the cavern the bwisps had
conveniently prepared. "My lord," he said to Motash, "the weebos are in
the pot."
The Underlord smiled grimly. "Cook 'em."

name: Jore

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Add one energy to each of your other burrowed Creatures.

flavor: It gives to the soil, and the soil gives back tenfold.

name: Pylofuf

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Pylofuf is burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponents' Spells and Powers.

text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Pylofuf.
flavor: The pylofuf is also known as 'porkuslime' for obvious reasons. It doesn't dig through soil. It just oozes through the gaps.

name: Tunnel Hyren

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Your other Underneath Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and each lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponent's Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"Its kingdom is under this world."
— Orwin, Naroom Elder

name: Weebat

effects.name: Grounded
effects.text: Whenever Weebat is attacked, add one energy to Weebat before energy is removed. If the attacking Creature is Naroom, add three additional energy to Weebat before energy is removed.

flavor: Agile as a bird in flight, solid as a rock at rest.

name: Bronk

effects.name: Conceal
effects.text: Underneath Creatures you control that have only one energy can only be attacked by Underneath Creatures.

flavor: "A legion of your best troops? My 'pitiful little band' is quite safe from them."

name: Radget

powers.name: Refresh
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. Add two additional energy if the chosen Creature is a Parmalag.

flavor: I'm as thick-skinned as any of my pets.

name: Trygar

effects.name: Avenger
effects.text: If Trygar is defeated, at the end of the current turn you may play any Creature from your hand. Play three energy on the Creature instead of its normal starting energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, the Creature played is unaffected by your opponents' cards.

flavor: And to Korremar, who helped me write this will, I leave . . . not a boot to the head, but a rabid bisiwog, to be placed in his trousers . . .

name: Gremm's Hammer

powers.name: Build
powers.text: Add two Pound Counters to Gremm's Hammer.

powers.name: Break
powers.text: Choose any one non-Underneath Creature in play. Discard energy from the chosen Creature equal to the number of Pound counters on Gremm's Hammer. Discard Gremm's Hammer from play.

flavor: "I am the groundbreaker, down-pounding ground shaker. I am the thunder-maker, underworldly undertaker." — Hammer inscription

name: Tunneler's Boots

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the end of each of your turns, add one energy to each burrowed Creature in play.

flavor:
"Even without magic, they provide great traction
to anchor your feet while digging."
— Gruk, Underfarmer

name: Underlord's Shield

effects.name: Force of Will
effects.text: Whenever an opponent's Power, Spell, or Effects forces you to discard a card from your hand, draw two cards for each card you were forced to discard. If an opponent's Spell, Power, or Effect causes Underlord's Shield to be discarded from your hand, instead put Underlord's Shield into play.

flavor:
"Everybody's out to get me but I feel all right...
Everybody's thinking 'bout me!"

name: Gorgle's Curse
text: Choose any one non-Underneath Creature in play. Discard all but one energy from the chosen Creature. That Creature cannot attack until your current Magi is defeated.
flavor:
"I didn't even know you had a spell named after him!"
— Grega, to Fossik

name: Impact
text: Choose any one of your Creatures and any one Magi in play. Discard twice as much energy as the chosen Creature has from the chosen Magi. Discard the chosen Creature from play.
flavor:
K.O.
2 Hit Special Move Finish
25000 Points

name: Resonate
text: Choose any or all of the following: Choose any one Relic in play. Discard the chosen Relic from play. OR Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. OR Choose any one Magi in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Magi. For each action chosen, Resonate's cost is increased by one.
flavor: For hitting anything.

name: Forgotten Dancer

powers.name: Excise
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature in play. Discard Forgotten Dancer from play. Take control of the chosen Creature. That Creature loses energy equal to the amount of energy on your Magi and may not attack this turn.

flavor: Without its glass cover, the blossom withers in the faintest light, unless it can find a dark heart in which to take root.

name: Mantle of Shadows

effects.name: Taint
effects.text: You may play Core Spells, with a regional penalty of one.

flavor:
"Does this taste bitter to you?"
— Evu, to Pruitt

name: Rayje's Band

effects.name: Thought Filter
effects.text: Non-Universal Magi may not play non-Universal Spells that are not of their region.

flavor:
"With this on your hand, you can punch your rival without moving a
finger."
— 'Rayje's Journal'

name: Rayje's Belt

powers.name: Lockdown
powers.text: Name any one Power or Effect on a card in play. Until the end of your next turn, no player may use named Power or Effect while Rayje's Belt is in play.

errata.previous_text: Name any one Power or Effect. Until the end of your next turn, no player may use the named Power or Effect.
errata.change: Lockdown can only work on a named Power or Effect in play and if Rayje's Belt is discarded, the affected Power or Effect is useable again. This errata supersedes the Rayje's Belt Promotional card.

flavor:
"And when all else fails, you can take off the belt and whip 'em with it."
— 'Rayje's Journal'

name: Rayje's Boots

effects.name: Dream Filter
effects.text: Non-Universal Magi may not play non-Universal Creatures that are not of their region.

flavor:
"They simply make the creatures think, 'What am I doing taking orders from
this guy?'"
— 'Rayje's Journal'

name: "Ummm...NO!"
text: Play "Ummm...NO!" only when an opponent plays a Spell that specifically discards one of your Creatures in play. Your Creature is not discarded from play. You may play "Ummm...NO!" during your opponents' turns.
flavor: "I'm sure."

name: Dream Channel
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Attach Dream Channel to the chosen Creature. Increase your Magi's energize rate by two while Dream Channel is in play. If the chosen Creature leaves play, discard Dream Channel from play.
flavor: Target painted.

name: Intensify
text: The next Spell or Power that discards energy from one or more Magi instead discards twice as much energy from each of those Magi.
flavor: Can you stand twice the pain?

name: Nightmare Channel
text: Choose any one Creature and any one Magi in play. Attach Nightmare Channel to the chosen Creature. Decrease the chosen Magi's energize rate by two while Nightmare Channel is in play. If the chosen Creature leaves play, discard Nightmare Channel from play.
flavor: Orlon had never harmed a Wellisk. Until now.

name: Spectral Shield
text: Until the beginning of your next turn, whenever an opponent's card forces you to discard a card from your hand, draw one card afterwards. At the beginning of your next turn, draw one card.
flavor:
"Sure, it'll keep you safe now," said Tryn, "but what about later?"
"If we can't be safe now," replied Wence, "there won't be a 'later.'"

name: Alaban Kit

effects.name: Undream
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Arderial Creatures in play is attacked, you may discard Alaban Kit from play. If you do, at the end of the current turn, return the attacking Creature from play to its owner's hand, discarding that Creature's energy.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Alaban Kit.
flavor: Some disassembly required.

name: Elder Vellup

effects.name: Allies
effects.text: When you play Elder Vellup, you may search your deck for any one non-Vellup Arderial Creature. Reveal the Creature to all players and place it in your hand. Shuffle your deck.

flavor: Vellup flocks often attract other, larger, hungrier creatures.

name: Grand Epik

effects.text: Reduce your Magi's Energize by two.

effects.name: Dream Binge
effects.text: Whenever an Arderial Magi energizes, add an equal amount of energy to Grand Epik.

flavor:
"Of such epiks are great tales made."
— Jaela, Arderial Regis

name: Rayalon

effects.name: Study
effects.text: Whenever Rayalon defeats a non-Arderial Creature in an attack, you may place any one Arderial or Core Spell from your discard pile into your hand.

text: Arderial Shadow Magi may play Rayalon.
flavor:
"Not again..."
— Lanyx, Crucible

name: Shock Vashp

powers.name: Shock
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard an Arderial Creature from your hand to discard two energy from the chosen Creature. If you discard a Vashp, discard an additional energy from the chosen Creature. Opposing cards do not affect Shock when it is used and may not alter the amount of energy discarded by Shock.

flavor: When the vashps race, everyone stays away.

name: Elios

effects.name: Dream Hard
effects.text: At the beginning of your Energize Step, if Elios is able to energize, choose a number less than his energize rate. Reduce Elios' energy rate by the chosen number until the start of your next turn. During your Draw Step, draw cards equal to the chosen number instead of your normal two.
If Elios is defeated, discard all but five cards from your hand.

flavor: "I'll be fine. No, really. I have it under control."

name: Delia

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever you play a Vellup, add one energy to it.

powers.name: Recurring Dreams
powers.text: Choose any one Vellup in your discard pile. Put the chosen Vellup into your hand.

flavor:
"You can always tell when her mind starts to 
wander: the vellups start appearing again."
— Stradus, Arderial Warrior

name: Eyes of Arderial

effects.text: At the end of each of your turns, each player starting with you and going to the left, names one Spell. Until the end of your next turn, the named Spells may not be played.
All opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects that reveal your hand to other players have no effect. If Eyes of Arderial is discarded from your hand by an opposing card, you may play it instead.

flavor: For all his foresight, Arderial did not see Agram's betrayal.

name: Storm Shield

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: If your Magi has no energy at the end of your turn, all of your Arderial Creatures in play gain one energy. If your Magi is Shimmer, all of your Arderial Creatures in play gain an additional energy.
All opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects that reveal your hand to other players have no effect. If Storm Shield is discarded from your hand by an opposing card, you may play it instead.

flavor: Vashps and alabans, xyxes and narths, all of the Arderial creatures circle around the bearer like a cyclone.

name: Cataclysm
text: Discard all non-Magi cards from play. Show your hand to all players and discard all non-Arderial, non-Core cards revealed. Opposing cards do not affect Cataclysm as it is played. Arderial Shadow Magi may play Cataclysm.
flavor: Sometimes it's not enough that they lose.

name: Sorreah's Dream
text: Choose any one Power on a card that does not name the card it is printed on. X is the energy cost of the chosen Power. Sorreah's Dream copies the Power and all of its actions. All cards that affect the chosen Power also affect Sorreah's Dream.
flavor:
"Sorreah often dreams he's someone else. What's disturbing
is when the other people dream they're Sorreah."
— Shimmer, Arderial Adept

name: Swamp Hyren

effects.name: Nightmare Gate
effects.text: All of your other Core and Bograth cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

text: Core Magi may play Swamp Hyren.
flavor:
"Do you smell something?"
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Diomant

powers.name: Flame Hunt
powers.text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard Diomant from play to discard four energy from the chosen Magi.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard Diomant from play. Discard four energy from the chosen Magi.
errata.change: A maximum move limit of six energy from Diomant has been added to Energy Transfer.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Move up to six energy from Diomant to your Magi.

errata.previous_text: Add X energy to your Magi.
errata.change: A maximum move limit of six energy from Diomant has been added to Energy Transfer.
errata.cost_note: cost field changed from X to 0 by hand (2026-07-09): the errata-corrected text ("Move up to six energy... to your Magi") no longer references a player-chosen X at all -- the X-cost/add-X-effect mechanic was replaced with a flat capped move, so the separate energy cost to USE the power no longer applies. See PROGRESS_LOG.md.

flavor:
"I call my diomants 'the fire fighters'."
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Giant Arboll

effects.name: Tinder
effects.text: When one of your Spells or Powers discards energy from one or more opposing Creatures, add one energy to Giant Arboll.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you play a Spell or use a Power that discards energy from one or more opposing Creatures, add one energy to Giant Arboll.
errata.change: A maximum move limit of six energy from Giant Arboll has been added to Healing Flame.

powers.name: Healing Flame
powers.text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Move up to six energy from Giant Arboll to the chosen Creature or Magi.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Move all energy from Giant Arboll to the chosen Creature or Magi.
errata.change: A maximum move limit of six energy from Giant Arboll has been added to Healing Flame.

flavor:
"Your pain, my gain."
— Grega, Pyromancer

name: Krawg

effects.name: Devour
effects.text: Whenever Krawg attacks, draw a card. If Ashgar is your Magi, draw an additional card.

effects.name: Immunity
effects.text: Opposing Effects do not affect Krawg.

flavor:
"Seems like a committee on one, to me. It's a
wonder it accomplishes anything."
— Sinder

name: Silth Giant

effects.name: Swallow Whole
effects.text: Once per turn, instead of attacking, whenever one of your other Creatures attacks a Creature with less energy than Silth Giant, you may discard the defending Creature from play before energy is removed. Your attacking Creature is still considered to have attacked this turn.

text: Cald Shadow Magi may play Silth Giant.
flavor: "It came out of nowhere — I just hope it went back there."

name: Smoke Xyx

powers.name: Suffocate
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the start of your next turn, the chosen Creature removes no energy from attacking Creatures while it is defending.

flavor:
"You really need to give those things up. They'll ruin your lungs."
— Ahdar, Scout

name: Amanax

effects.name: Pyromaniac
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Cald Spells or Powers discards energy from one or more opposing Creatures, you may add one energy to Amanax for each energy discarded.

flavor: "I feel your pain."

name: Vorga

powers.name: Shatter
powers.text: Choose any one Creature with three or less energy, or any one Relic in play. Discard the chosen Creature or Relic from play.

flavor:
"Note to self: do not ask Vorga about her scar."
— Tony Jones' journal

name: Abraxin's Crown

effects.name: Dreamburn
effects.text: All of your Powers and Spells that discard energy from a single Creature or Magi may instead discard energy from either a single Magi or Creature.

text: If an opponent's Power, Spell, or Effects discards one or more cards from your hand, you may discard Abraxin's Crown from play or from your hand instead. If you do, that opponent discards his or her hand and all energy from his or her Magi.
flavor: It is said that Abraxin could grab your dreams and twist them behind your back.

name: Grega's Ring

powers.name: Thermal Blast
powers.text: Roll a die. Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard energy equal to the die roll from the chosen Creature or Magi. If the die roll is two or less, discard Grega's Ring from play.

flavor: Rumor has it she used the ring on the suitor who gave it to her.

name: Lava Flow
text: Choose any one non-Cald Creature in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature. Opposing cards do not affect Lava Flow when it is played and may not alter the amount of energy discarded by Lava Flow. Cald Shadow Magi may play Lava Flow.
flavor: Some things you just can't help.

name: Searing Touch
text: Until the end of the turn, all of your Cald Creatures in play gain: "Effect - Furnace: Whenever you play a Cald Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature."
flavor:
"Never take a gift directly from a Calder's hands."
— Moonlands maxim

name: Chaos Plith

effects.name: Guile
effects.text: Whenever Chaos Plith defeats a Creature in an attack, draw a card. If Evu is your Magi, draw an additional card.

text: Naroom Magi may play Chaos Plith.
flavor:
"C'mon, you can trust me," hissed the plith.
"Evu will vouch for my character."

name: Dark Furok

effects.name: Revile
effects.text: As Dark Furok attacks and loses energy, discard half that amount of energy, rounded down, from any one Creature in play. Naroom Magi may play Dark Furok.

errata.previous_text: Whenever Dark Furok attacks and loses energy, discard half that amount of energy, rounded down, from any one Creature in play.
errata.change: Revile has been reworded to the "As" trigger.
errata.affects: Naroom/Core GenCon 2001 Preview Deck, Dream's End

text: Naroom Magi may play Dark Furok.
flavor:
"I don't even WANT to know what's perched up there..."
— Tony Jones

name: Drush

effects.name: Vengeance
effects.text: If Drush is attacked and defeated, choose any one of the attacking player's Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

text: Weave Magi may play Drush.
flavor:
"Vengeance is bitter, but the taste grows on you."
— Lanyx, Crucible

name: Garadan

effects.name: Spawn
effects.text: Whenever Garadan attacks a Magi, after energy is removed, you may immediately play any one Core or Naroom Creature from your hand with one energy instead of its starting energy and without paying any costs.

text: Naroom Magi may play Garadan.
flavor: It manifests your nightmares.

name: Harban

powers.name: Browbeat
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play with only one energy. Gain control of the chosen Creature.

text: Arderial Magi may play Harban.
flavor:
"Today I steal your dreams, tomorrow I steal the sky."
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Chur

effects.name: Smash
effects.text: Whenever a player plays a Relic from his or her hand, discard it from play.

flavor: "I've got more rocks than you have toys."

name: Evil Evu

effects.name: Devour
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Creature is discarded from play or reduced to zero energy by one of your cards, draw a card.

text: You may play Naroom cards, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties.
flavor: "I'll show you jellybeans!"

name: Hrada

powers.name: Tainted Touch
powers.text: Choose one non-Core Magi in play. Until the start of your next turn, the chosen Magi is a Core Shadow Magi of his or her original region. That Magi may still play Creatures and Spell of his or her original region with a regional penalty of one. Naroom Magi must pay an additional penalty of one.

flavor: "They don't understand. Power doesn't corrupt... corruption is power!"

name: Ashio

effects.name: Weave Twist
effects.text: All cards that specifically reference Core instead reference their own region. If a card is of multiple regions, you choose which of those regions to reference.

flavor: "Everything is part of the whole..."

name: Agram's Plaything

powers.name: Puppet Strings
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, Agram's Plaything changes to a Creature. Add one energy to Agram's Plaything whenever it becomes a Creature. If your Magi is Agram, add two additional energy to it. Whenever Agram's Plaything becomes a Relic, discard all energy from it.

flavor:
"I think about Une whenever I play with it."
— Agram

name: Agram's Staff

effects.name: Mastery
effects.text: Your Shadow Magi may play cards from their original region, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Control
effects.text: If your Magi is Agram, you may play any cards that specifically say that they can be played by a Shadow Magi. Agram does not pay a regional penalty for non-Core cards.

flavor:
"It's sooooo good! .. what's it do again?"
— Korg

name: Secrets of the Book

powers.name: Secrets
powers.text: (3) Choose any one opposing player. The chosen player reveals his or her hand to all players. Draw one card for each Creature revealed, and one card for each non-Creature Naroom card revealed, to a maximum of four.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one opposing player. The chosen player reveals his or her hand to all players. Draw one card for each Creature revealed, and one card for each non-Creature Naroom card revealed.
errata.change: A maximum limit of four cards can be drawn through Secrets.
errata.affects: Dream's End, Naroom/Core GenCon 2001 Preview Deck

flavor: Within the book, Evu keeps the secrets to the heart and soul of Naroom. Now the very forest may wither and die.

name: Arderial Shadow Geyser
text: The energy cost for this Geyser is zero if played by an Arderial Shadow Magi. To play this Geyser, you must discard three Core Spells from your hand. Place this Geyser on the table. Arderial Spells cost two additional energy to play. Your Core Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one. You may not play another Arderial Shadow Geyser while this one is in play. If your Magi leaves play, you may keep all but one of your Shadow Geysers in play. Agram does not discard any Shadow Geysers from play when he leaves play.
flavor:
"Say it, Korg, and I'll have to hurt you."
— Zet

name: Cald Shadow Geyser
text: The energy cost for this Geyser is zero if played by an Cald Shadow Magi. To play this Geyser, discard energy from each of your Creatures in play equal to the cost of their most expensive Power. If you discarded at least five energy, place this Geyser on the table. All Powers on Cald cards in play cost two additional energy to use. All Powers on your Core cards cost one less energy to use, to a minimum of one. You may not play another Cald Shadow Geyser while this one is in play. If your Magi leaves play, you may keep all but one of your Shadow Geysers in play. Agram does not discard any Shadow Geysers from play when he leaves play.
flavor:
"Three! Three shadow geysers—"
"Okay! Stop it!"
— Korg and Zet

name: Naroom Shadow Geyser
text: The energy cost for this Geyser is zero if played by a Naroom Shadow Magi. In order to play this Geyser, you must discard three of your Core Creatures from play. Place this Geyser on the table. Naroom Creatures lose two energy when they are played. Whenever you play a Core Creature, add one energy to it. You may not play another Naroom Shadow Geyser while this one is in play. If your Magi leaves play, you may keep all but one of your Shadow Geysers in play. Agram does not discard any Shadow Geysers from play when he leaves play.
flavor:
"One! One shadow geyser! Bwah hah hah hah!"
— Korg

name: Orothe Shadow Geyser
text: The energy cost for this Geyser is zero if played by an Orothe Shadow Magi. In order to play this Geyser, you must discard three of your Core Relics from play. Place this Geyser on the table. Opponents must pay two additional energy to play or use Powers on Orothe and Universal relics. Whenever you play a Core Relic, each of your opponents discards one card from their hands. You may not play another Orothe Shadow Geyser while this one is in play. If your Magi leaves play, you may keep all but one of your Shadow Geysers in play. Agram does not discard any Shadow Geysers from play when he leaves play.
flavor:
"Four! Four shadow—"
"SHUT UP!"
— Korg and Zet

name: Stealth
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Whenever the chosen Creature attacks this turn, it removes energy immediately, before Creatures normally remove energy. Weave Magi may play Stealth.
flavor:
