"I knoww the wayyy passssst..."
— Ogar

name: Underneath Shadow Geyser
text: The energy cost for this Geyser is zero if played by an Underneath Shadow Magi. In order to play this Geyser, you must discard six Core cards from your hand. Place this Geyser on the table. All non-Core Magi with an Underneath card in play draw one less card during their Draw Step. Draw one additional card during your Draw Step. You may not play another Underneath Shadow Geyser while this one is in play. If your Magi leaves play, you may keep all but one of your Shadow Geysers in play. Agram does not discard any Shadow Geysers from play when he leaves play.
flavor:
"Two! Two shadow geysers! Bwah hah—"
"Yeah, I heard you the first time."
— Korg and Zet

name: Vaporize
text: Choose any one Magi in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Magi for each Relic he or she has in play. Discard all of that Magi's Relics from play.
flavor:
"I held on to 'em as long as I could, lad. Breaks
me heart. I canna take much more o' this!"
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Agrilla

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Agrilla loses one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Choose any one of your other Creatures in play that can attack. The chosen Creature may attack twice this turn.

text: Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Agrilla.
flavor:
"An Agrilla's deal."
— Kybarite phrase meaning "no choice."

name: Baldar

effects.name: Smash
effects.text: Whenever Baldar attacks a Creature that starts the attack with less energy than Baldar, Baldar loses no energy in the attack.

flavor:
"They seem to like their work as much as I do."
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Chogus

effects.name: Exuberance
effects.text: All of your cards that check for the largest opposing Creature in play instead check for the smallest opposing Creature in play, and all of your cards that check for the smallest opposing Creature in play instead check for the largest opposing Creature in play.

flavor:
"You'd think twice the heads would mean twice the smarts."
— Wessig

name: Cliff Hyren

effects.name: Shield
effects.text: All opposing Spells and Powers that affect one or more of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures in play instead affect only Cliff Hyren, if Cliff Hyren can be affected by the Spell or Power.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Cliff Hyren loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor: Prowling the peaks and scouting for prey, they are the creatures most commonly seen by outsiders... briefly.

name: Crag Quor

effects.name: Rebound
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if Crag Quor is smaller than the smallest opposing Creature in play, add four energy to Crag Quor.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Crag Quor loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"Wow, that makes my heart go boom-boom! I'm
all excited to start the fight!"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero of the Underneath

name: Cragnoc

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Cragnoc loses one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Lend a Hand
powers.text: Roll two dice. Add that amount of energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"In a Cragnoc's grip."
— Kybarite phrase meaning "safe"

name: Darge

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Darge.

effects.name: Pummel
effects.text: Whenever Darge attacks a Core Creature, Darge loses no energy in the attack.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Darge loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor: A mountain to bury the darkness.

name: Gargagnor

effects.name: Perpetual Motion
effects.text: When you play Gargagnor, choose any one other player. All of your Effects that ordinarily happen at the beginning of your turn happen at the beginning of the chosen player's turn instead.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Gargarnor loses one less energy in attacks.

text: Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Gargarnor.
flavor: Its roar has an echo built in.

name: Giant Baldar

effects.name: Momentum
effects.text: If Giant Baldar attacks and defeats a Magi's last Creature in play, discard all but one energy from the defeated Creature's Magi.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Giant Baldar loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"They're very easy to find; just follow the
wreckage. The hard part comes when you actually
catch up to one."
— Kazm, Scout

name: Giant Chogus

effects.name: Big Chill
effects.text: Creatures in play cannot gain energy above their starting energy.

text: Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Giant Chogus.
flavor: Those Choguses that survive their wild youth are truly creatures to be feared.

name: Granite Parmalag

effects.name: Rock Solid
effects.text: All of your Parmalags in play lose one less energy in attacks.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Granite Parmalag loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"Going parmalag."
— Kybarite expression meaning 'untouchable'

name: Gratch

effects.name: Hunting Howl
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your smallest Creature in play is larger than the largest opposing Creature in play, add one energy to each of your other Kybar's Teeth Creature in play.

flavor:
"Nah, it's nothing. Just a gratch."
— Zet

name: Moga

powers.name: Roar
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks a Creature, it removes twice as much energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"When a moga takes a deep breath, stand aside."
— Kazm, Scout

name: Moga Pup

powers.name: Roar
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks a Creature, it removes four additional energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"Awwww, look, a—"
"HRRAAAAWWNK!"
"Aaiiieeee!"
— Gogor and a moga pup

name: Mosp

effects.name: Thick
effects.text: Mosp cannot attack.

effects.name: Tall
effects.text: Mosp loses three less energy whenever it is attacked.

effects.name: Wide
effects.text: None of your none-Mosp Kybar's Teeth Creatures in play can be attacked.

flavor: A mosp gathers no rolling stones.

name: Rock Hyren

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Rock Hyren loses two less energy in attacks and from opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects. Your Spells, Powers, and other Effects may not prevent Rock Hyren from losing energy.

flavor:
"Wood, coral, fire... pfft! Whatever. Gimme a big ol' rock any day."
— Koll

name: Sagawal

effects.name: Watchful
effects.text: When an opposing Spell is discarding only one of your other Kybar's Teeth Creatures from play, you may discard Sagawal from play instead.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Sagawal loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"I hear a sagawal and an orpus got into a staring
contest. It still hasn't ended."
— Targ'n, Kybar's Teeth Elder

name: Stone Quor

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Stone Quor loses one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Squeeze
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature. Move hald of the chosen Creature's energy (rounded up) to your Magi.

text: Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Stone Quor.
flavor:
"A stone quor's kiss."
— Kybarite phrase meaning "dangerous."

name: Vogo

effects.name: Interrupt
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever an opposing Spell or Power chooses only one of your other Creatures in play, you may choose any one of your other Creatures in play instead, if that Creature can be chosen for the Spell or Power.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Vogo loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor: Circling vogos are a sure sign that the cliff hyren have found an intruder.

name: Xamf

effects.name: Windchill
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your smallest Creature in play is larger than the largest opposing Creature in play, add for energy to your Magi.

flavor: Legendary heralds of the winter storms, xamfs bring welcome challenges for all Kybarites.

name: Yark

effects.name: Diving Attack
effects.text: Whenever Yark attacks a Creature with more than its starting energy, reduce that Creature to its starting energy before energy is removed.

flavor:
"A harsh critter for a harsh place."
— Wence, Naroom adventurer

name: Yebed

effects.name: Rolling Stones
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your largest Creature in play is smaller than the smallest opposing Creature in play, all opposing Creatures in play lose one energy.

flavor:
"How can such a clumsy creature survive in such
an unforgiving environment?"
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Emec

effects.name: Tinker
effects.text: Once per turn, when you use a Power or Effect printed on one of your Kybar's Teeth Relic in play that involves a die roll, you may reroll one of those dice. If you do, you may choose which result to use.

flavor: "I'm of the belief that when a wheel squeaks, you oughta hit it with a hammer until it stops."

name: Grej

effects.name: Kinship
effects.text: Grej may play Underneath cards, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

powers.name: Toughen
powers.text: Choose any one of your Underneath Creatures in play. Until the start of your next turn, the chosen Creature gains "Effect - Invulnerability: This Creature loses one less energy in attacks."

flavor: An orphan found at the entrance to the Underneath, she has found her people among the peaks, but not forgotten her home at the mountain's roots.

name: Hok

effects.name: Resilience
effects.text: While any opponent has more Creatures in play than you, your Kybar's Teeth Creatures may not be discarded by opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play.

flavor: He can chase down a gargagnor. And he does so, regularly.

name: Jagt

effects.name: Perpetual Motion
effects.text: When you reveal Jagt, choose any one other player. All of your Effects that ordinarily happen at the beginning of your turn, instead happen at the beginning of the chosen player's turn.

flavor: Fighting Jagt is like having a dream that never ends. Except the dream is hers, not yours.

name: Kazm

effects.name: Hunter
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Magi plays a Creature with starting energy less than the current energy of your smallest Kybar's Teeth Creature in play, add three energy to Kazm.

flavor: "You think that little guy will save you? Think again!"

name: Koll

powers.name: Dream Twist
powers.text: Discard your largest Creature from play (in the case of a tie, you choose which one to discard).  Search your deck for any one Kybar's Teeth Creature with starting energy less than the discarded Creature's starting energy. Play the chosen Creature with its starting energy. That Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor: "Oh yeah? You and whose dream army?"

name: Targ'n

effects.name: Enhanced Invulnerability
effects.text: All of your Creatures in play with Invulnerability lose one less energy in attacks.

flavor: Getting into an argument with Targ'n is like yelling at a brick wall.

name: Ullig

effects.name: Fearless
effects.text: When Ullig's last Creature is discarded from play by an opposing card, add four energy to Ullig.

errata.previous_text: Whenever your last Creature in play is discarded, add four energy to Ullig.
errata.change: Only an opponent's card will trigger Fearless.

flavor: "A coward fears a fight. A hero fights his fear."

name: Wessig

effects.name: Landslide
effects.text: If Wessig is discarded from play, discard all non-Kybar's Teeth Creatures and Relics from play.

flavor:
"I think her innocence helps protect her."
— Targ'n, Kybar's Teeth Elder

name: Groll

effects.name: Recover
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is attacked and defeated, add half of the energy lost from your Creature in that attack (rounded down) to Groll.

flavor: Where trouble comes, Groll goes.

name: Chogulith

powers.name: Strengthen
powers.text: Choose any one Chogus in play. Roll one die. Add that much energy to the chosen Chogus.

flavor: It was the first Chogus created by Kybar, and it turned to stone so it could watch over its resting place forever.

name: Climbing Staff

effects.name: Higher Ground
effects.text: Whenever you play a Kybar's Teeth Creature, add one energy to your Magi.
You may discard Climbing Staff from your hand or from play when an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect would affect only your Magi or only your hand. The Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

errata.previous_text: You may discard Climbing Staff from your hand or from play whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect is affecting only your Magi or only your hand. The Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.
errata.change: Clarification as to when you can use the nameless Effect on Climbing Staff.

flavor:
"Come on up and get me!"
— Kazm

name: Hogra Stones

powers.name: Divination
powers.text:
Roll one die and discard the top card of your deck:
1-2: Add four energy to your Magi if the discarded card is a Creature.
3-4: Add two energy to your Magi if the discarded card is a Spell.
5-6: Discard three energy from your Magi if the discarded card is a
     Relic.

flavor: Just be sure you want the answer before you ask the question.

name: Jasker's Mask

effects.name: Double or Nothing
effects.text: Increase the energize rate of all Magi in play by five. All Spells cost one additional energy to play.

flavor:
"Wait — what's that?"
"It ain't no Magi, that's fer sure."
— Zet and Korg

name: Kybar's Hammer

powers.name: Whump
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand. Roll one die. Choose any one Creature in play with less energy than the die roll. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"Swing it? I can barely lift it!"
— Kazm

name: Kybar's Scroll

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: Roll one die. Look at that number of cards from the top of your deck. Put one of those cards into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck.

flavor: Funny how so much of Kybar's wisdom revolves around fighting...

name: Moga Fang Necklace

effects.name: Roar
effects.text: At the beginning of your Attack Step, roll a die. Until the end of your turn, whenever one of your Creatures attacks, it gains energy equal to the die roll, before energy is removed.
At the end of your Attack Step, if you attacked with any Creatures this turn, discard all of your Creatures and Relics from play.

flavor: Making one of these is like pulling teeth.

name: Ullig's Slingshot

effects.name: Fire Away!
effects.text:
Once per turn, when one of your Creatures is attacked and before
energy is removed, you may roll one die:
1-2: Discard three energy from the defending Creature.
3-4: Discard one energy from the attacking Creature.
5-6: Discard three energy from the attacking Creature.
     Always use this result if your Magi is Ullig.

flavor:
"You know, there's really no such thing as 'friendly fire'."
— Tony Jones

name: Yark Gloves

effects.name: Deplete
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures is attacked by a non-Kybar's Teeth Creature that has more than its starting energy, before energy is removed, you may reduce the attacking Creature to its starting energy.

flavor: They may be gloves, but they don't just warm your hands.

name: Ascend
text: Play Ascend only before your Attack Step. Your Kybar's Teeth Creatures cannot attack this turn. Until the beginning of your next turn, all of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures lose three less energy in attacks.
flavor:
"Don't hunt the mogas on the mountaintops."
— Kybarite maxim

name: Feet of Stone
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen Creature may not attack or use any Powers or Effects. Kybar's Teeth Shadow Magi may play Feet of Stone.
flavor:
"I'll be there in a minute!"
— Korg

name: Jagged Rocks
text: Add two energy to the smallest Kybar's Teeth Creature in play. Discard three energy from the largest non-Kybar's Teeth Creature in play.
flavor: Everyone gets a chance to climb the Teeth... but only one.

name: Kybar's Echo
text: Until the end of your next turn, whenever one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures is discarded from play, return it to your hand instead.
flavor:
"Here, we don't need pliths to run our messages."
— Hok

name: Ominous Presence
text: Until the end of your next turn, you may play Core Creatures as if they were Kybar's Teeth Creatures.
flavor: The weebo looked up into the sky. "Hmm," it thought, "circling vogos. Something's about to get eaten."

name: Roar
text: Choose one of your Creatures in play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks, remove twice as much energy from the defending Creature.
flavor:
"Well, at least we know it's coming."
— Korg

name: Rock Slide
text: Discard the Creature with the most energy from play. In the case of a tie, you choose which Creature to discard.
flavor:
"Woah. Usually I run over the hills, not vice versa."
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Stone Storm
text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Discard X energy from each of the chosen Creatures.
flavor:
"What goes up must come down, but how do they get up in the first place?"
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Vertigo
text: Choose any one Magi in play. During that Magi's next turn, he or she must spend one additional energy to play each card.
flavor: I get dizzy just thinking about it.

name: Bungaloo

effects.name: Flee
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo is defeated in an attack, choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature or Magi.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Bungaloo and one of your other Weave or Naroom Creatures in play.

flavor:
The bungaloo's a friendly thing.
They'll swarm around you if you sing.
But if an angry thought you think,
They'll disappear within a blink.

name: Elder Weebo

powers.name: Vitaminize
powers.text: Discard Elder Weebo from play. Until the end of your next turn, each of your Naroom Creatures in play with an energize rate has its energize rate increased by two. Each of your other Naroom Creatures in play gains an energize rate of two until the end of your next turn.

flavor:
"Very rare, but very, very tasty."
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Garan

effects.name: Rake
effects.text: Energy removed by your Creatures in attacks is unaffected by opposing cards. All of your Creatures must attack each turn, if able.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Garann.
flavor: A garan hits so hard, it'll knock you clean out of your dream.

name: Jip

effects.name: Tap Strength
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever one or more opposing Creatures gains any amount of energy, you may add energy to Jip equal to the total energy gained by the opposing Creatures.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Jip.
flavor: It's happy when you're happy... which may then make you unhappy.

name: Nodj

effects.name: Restore
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if Nodj has less than its starting energy, restore it to its starting energy.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Nodj.
flavor:
"Nodj nodj, wink wink, say no more, say—...
never mind, I guess you had to be there."
— Tony Jones

name: Zajan

effects.name: Work All Night
effects.text: Zajan does not energize as normal during the energize step. Zajan energizes during the draw step.

effects.name: Sleep All Day
effects.text: Zajan draws two cards during the energize step. Zajan does not draw cards as normal during the draw step.

flavor:
"He goes around whistling this inane little tune all the time. It drives
me crazy."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Zannah

effects.name: Charm
effects.text: On each opposing turn, the first opposing card that removes energy from either only Zannah or only one of your Creatures removes no energy.

errata.previous_text: Each turn, the first opposing card that removes energy from Zannah or one of your Creatures removes no energy.
errata.change: Only on opposing turns does Charm trigger.

flavor:
"Wow, she's purty!"
— Korg

name: Evu's Jellybeans

effects.name: Red Ones
effects.text: At the end of your turn, discard one Jellybean Counter from Evu's Jellybeans and draw a card.

powers.name: Black Ones
powers.text: Discard one Jellybean Counter from Evu's Jellybeans. Choose any one player. That player chooses and discards one card from his or her hand. If your Magi is Core, the discard is random. If your Magi is Evu, you do not need to discard a Jellybean Counter to use this Power.

text: When you play Evu's Jellybeans, add X Jellybean Counters to it. If Evu's Jellybeans has no Jellybean Counters on it, discard it from play. Naroom Shadow Magi may play Evu's Jellybeans.
flavor:
"I hear they're all black, now..."
— Eidon

name: Pruitt's Robe

effects.name: Glimmer
effects.text: Whenever you energize, you may choose any one of your Creatures in play. Add the energy to the chosen Creature instead of your Magi. If your Magi is Pruitt, you may also add two energy to her.

flavor:
"Lookin' good, feelin' good."
— Pruitt, Naroom Ringsmith

name: Nocturne
text: Search through your deck for any one Naroom Creature. Play that Creature with one energy, without paying any costs. That Creature may not attack this turn. Shuffle your deck afterward.
flavor: "Yeah, that's a puzzle. I'll see if I can dream something up." — Pruitt, Naroom Ringsmith

name: Vim and Vigor
text: Choose an opposing Creature in play. Move all energy above the chosen Creature's starting energy to your Magi. Naroom Shadow Magi may play Vim and Vigor.
flavor:
"Dinner time!"
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Deep Barl

powers.name: Consume
powers.text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Draw two cards.

text: Orothe Shadow Magi may play Deep Barl.
flavor:
"I guess they found a way to use that knowledge after all."
— Orthea

name: Deep Wellisk

effects.name: Sunken Treasure
effects.text: Whenever another player plays a Relic from his or her hand, you may discard two energy from Deep Wellisk. If you do, discard the Relic from play. Orothe Shadow Magi can play Deep Wellisk.

errata.previous_text: Whenever another player plays a Relic from his or her hand, you may discard two energy from Deep Wellisk. If you do, discard the Relic from play.
errata.change: > Deep Wellisk cannot gain energy from your cards. The Errata to the unnamed Effect has been clarified so that any kind of Rearrange action cannot add energy to Deep Wellisk.

effects.text: Deep Wellisk may not be discarded from play by opposing cards while it has energy. Your cards cannot increase Deep Wellisk's energy total.

errata.previous_text: Deep Wellisk may not be discarded from play by opposing Spells, Powers, or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play.
errata.change: > Deep Wellisk cannot gain energy from your cards. The Errata to the unnamed Effect has been clarified so that any kind of Rearrange action cannot add energy to Deep Wellisk.

text: Orothe Shadow Magi may play Deep Wellisk.
flavor:
"Old wellisks never leave, they just keep sinking deeper."
— Orothean graffito

name: Iximin

effects.name: Spite
effects.text: If Iximin is defeated in an attack, discard three energy from the Creature that defeated it.

flavor: An Iximin doesn't need to hold it breath. It just holds yours.

name: Nalo

powers.name: Tsunami
powers.text: Discard Nalo from play. Discard two energy from each Creature and Magi in play. Opposing cards do  not affect Tsunami when it is used and may not alter the amount of energy discarded by Tsunami.

flavor:
"Look out — they're doing the wave!"
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Parathin

powers.name: Dream Twist
powers.text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Reveal and discard cards from the top of your deck one at a time, until you reveal a Creature. Play that Creature with half of its starting energy (rounded up) without paying any costs.

flavor:
"Oh, yes, it'll take you for a ride..."
— O'Qua, Summoner

name: Bria
starting: [Two non-Universal Relics from any one region]

effects.name: Obsession
effects.text: When you reveal Bria, name one Region. Bria may play Relics from that Region regardless of regional restrictions.

flavor: "I gotta get 'em! I gotta get 'em! I gotta get 'em all!"

name: M'Rika

effects.name: Interchange
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if M'Rika has no energy and is not your last Magi, place her on the bottom of your Magi pile, face down and undefeated. Bring in your next Magi with his or her starting energy. You do not get the new Magi's starting cards. You may keep your current Relics, Creatures, and Spells in play.

flavor: "Hang on a sec, I'll be right back (wink)."

name: Barqua's Bubble

effects.name: Cover
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell or Power affects one of your Creatures in play, as it does so you may shuffle Barqua's Bubble into your deck and discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell or Power does not affect that Creature.

flavor:
"It's a bubble, silly. Beautiful magical energy on the outside, nothing at
all one the inside."
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Karak Necklace

effects.name: Two for Me
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever you take control of another player's card, draw two cards.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you take control of another player's card, draw two cards.
errata.change: Two for Me triggers once per turn.

powers.name: None for You
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play that you own. Gain control of the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"I don't like it when you do that. Reminds me of our government."
— Tony Jones

name: Riptide
text: All players discard all but four cards from their hand. Until the end of your next turn, all other Spells, Powers, or Effects that cause opponents to discard cards from their hand may not be played or used. Opposing cards may not discard Riptide from your hand. Orothe Shadow Magi may play Riptide.
flavor: The sea barls swam away, laughing to themselves, as the Magi sought the wisdom they one held...

name: Shell
text: Until the end of your next turn, your Orothe Creatures in play are not affected by opposing Spells and Powers. If an opponent's Power, Spell, or Effect discards one or more cards from your hand, you may discard Shell from your hand instead. If you do, discard all of that opponent's Relics in play. All ongoing Powers and Effects of those Relics are canceled.
flavor: There's safety in numbers... and behind big thick pieces of armor.

name: Jungle Hyren

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: Once per turn, as any player plays a Creature, you may choose to increase or decrease its starting energy by up to two until the end of the turn, to a minimum of one. Dreamwarp may not raise a Creature's starting energy above the amount of energy on that player's Magi.

flavor:
"Paradwyn is a wild, untamed place. You just never know what's going to
happen in there."
— Gia, Weave Seer

name: Crystal Parmalag

effects.name: Anti-Magic
effects.text: Crystal Parmalag is not affected by opposing Spells, Powers or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play. Your Spells, Powers, and Effects may not prevent Crystal Parmalag from losing energy.

flavor: It's like a colossus, but with less maintenance.

name: Hubram

effects.name: Dreamfetch
effects.text: Whenever you play an Underneath Spell that does not remain in play, you may discard Hubram from play to put the Spell into your hand instead of your discard pile.

flavor: Echoes travel for miles and miles in the Underneath.

name: Spore Vashp

powers.name: True Form
powers.text: Discard Spore Vashp from play. Choose any two different Underneath Creatures in your discard pile. Your opponent chooses one of the two chosen Creatures. Play that Creature with half of its starting energy (rounded up) without paying any costs. That Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor:
"It'sss a dreammm with a sssurprisssse endinggg... like mmminnnne..."
— Ogar

name: Syre

powers.name: Undream Tap
powers.text: Choose any one of your burrowed Creatures in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature to draw one card.

flavor:
"Sometimes you don't have to choose between knowledge and power right
away... you can get an option."
— Fossik, Underkeeper

name: Urhail

effects.name: Tainted Dreams
effects.text: Your Magi may play Core Spells, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Urhail, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.
flavor:
"I had the strangest dream last night..."
— Ogar

name: Prek

effects.name: Kinship
effects.text: Prek may play Kybar's Teeth cards, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Tech Savvy
effects.text: All of your Relics cost one less to play. Your Relics' powers cost one less to use.

flavor: She helped Kazm build his wings, and made a friend for life.

name: Sorrowing Ogar

effects.name: Vile Memories
effects.text: Sorrowing Ogar can play all Core cards ignoring regional penalties and restrictions. Core cards that Sorrowing Ogar plays are considered Underneath instead of Core.

effects.name: Regret
effects.text: All Core cards cost opposing Magi one additional energy to play.

text: Sorrowing Ogar may not be played in a deck with any Core Magi.
flavor: "I— I thought it was all a dream! What have I done?"

name: Gremm's Helmet

powers.name: Mimic
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Magi in play. Your Magi gains all Powers and Effects on the chosen Magi until the beginning of your next turn.

flavor: Gremm's Helmet is best used by those who are good role-players.

name: Tremor Stones

powers.name: Boom Boom Boom
powers.text: Discard all Relics in play. All ongoing Powers and Effects of those Relics are canceled. You may not use Boom Boom Boom the turn you play Tremor Stones.

flavor:
"Do ye hear anythin'? Any little pitter-patter?"
"Nope. Everything's quiet."
"Good."
— Blu and Orlon

name: Aglow
text: Your burrowed Creatures may attack this turn. When attacking this turn, your burrowed Creatures gain one energy before energy is removed.
flavor:
"Hey, it's getting lighter... good, I feel safer now."
— Zet

name: Hidden Door
text: Search your deck for up to two Underneath Relics and place them into your hand.
flavor:
"Not all of your tunnels have to be dug through the dirt..."
— Trug, Engineer

name: Monarch Hyren

powers.name: Command
powers.text: (1) Add one energy to each of your hyren in play.

errata.previous_text: Add one energy to each of your other hyren in play.
errata.change: The word "other" has been removed from Command.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Monarch Hyren.

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: (1) Search your deck for any one Hyren, show it to your opponent, and add the chosen card to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

errata.previous_text: Search your deck for any one hyren, show it to your opponent, and add the chosen card to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
errata.change: The word "other" has been removed from Command.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Monarch Hyren.

flavor: It is a rare beast, indeed, that commands obedience from all hyren, everywhere.

name: Maelstrom Flask

powers.name: Uncork
powers.text: Discard Maelstrom Flask from play. Reveal the top four cards of your deck. You may choose any one revealed Spell. If you do, discard all other revealed cards and play the chosen Spell for half of its energy cost, rounded up. If the chosen Spell has an X in its cost, X must equal zero. If you do not choose a Spell, discard all revealed cards.

errata.previous_text: Discard Maelstrom Flask from play. Reveal the top four cards of your deck. You may choose any one revealed Spell. If you do, play the chosen Spell for half of its energy cost, rounded up. If the chosen Spell has an X in its cost, X must equal zero. Discard all other cards revealed.
errata.change: Clarification that if you do not choose a spell to play with Uncork, all revealed cards are discarded.

flavor:
"Urgh... will somebody please stop the world from spinning before I get
sick?"
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Rayje's Cloak

effects.text: Opposing cards neither prevent your Creatures from attacking nor prevent opposing cards from defending. Opposing cards do not prevent your cards from using their Powers and Effects.

flavor: Many a Magi has spent their last energy running from the wearer.

name: Rayje's Sword

effects.name: Piercing
effects.text: Spells, Powers, and Effects do not reduce energy loss.

flavor: Rayje's legendary sword has been nicknamed "Conscience", because there's no escaping it.

name: Staff of Keepers

effects.name: Finder
effects.text: When you play Staff of Keepers, choose any one region other than your Magi's region. You ignore regional penalties for Creatures of the chosen region. If your Magi is a Keeper, also add one energy to each Creature you play from the chosen region.

flavor:
"I'm welcomed pretty much wherever I go. As long as I don't bring a bunch
of critters with me."
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Tomorrow's Jewel

effects.text: Whenever an opposing card forces you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the opposing card does nothing.

errata.previous_text: Whenever an opposing Power, Spell or Effect forces you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.
errata.change: Tomorrow's Jewel may no longer be discarded from play or stolen.

effects.name: Lore
effects.text: Once during your Draw step, after you draw, you may discard one card from your hand. If you do, draw one card.

errata.previous_text: Once during your Draw Step, after you draw, you may discard one card from your hand. If you do, draw one card.
errata.change: Tomorrow's Jewel may no longer be discarded from play or stolen.

text: If an opposing card causes you to discard Tomorrow's Jewel from your hand or from play, you may play it instead.
flavor: You never know what tomorrow holds.

name: Beam of Light
text: Choose up to two Relics, Spells, and/or Creatures in play with two or less energy. Discard the chosen cards from play. All ongoing Powers and Effects of those cards are canceled.
flavor: For hitting everything.

name: Equilibrate
text: All Creatures in play with more than their starting energy are reduced to their starting energy.
flavor:
"Aaah! Aaah! Giant Eebit! Run! Run—" *POP*
"Hey, look at the cute little fuzzball..."
— Salafy, Woodskeeper

name: Fate's Whimsy
text: Play only after any player rolls one or more dice. Re-roll one of those dice. Choose which result to use. You may play this Spell on any player's turn.
flavor: What is luck, other than skill performing anonymously?

name: Aritex

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Aritex attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Aritex and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Heal
powers.text: Discard any one of your other Weave Creatures from play. Restore your Magi to his or her starting energy at the end of this turn.

flavor: For you to receive, the Weave must give. It's the law of the Weave.

name: Bungaloo

effects.name: Flee
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo is defeated in an attack, choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature or Magi.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Bungaloo and one of your other Weave or Naroom Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Yes, it's cute, but they shed like... like... ACHOO!
Get it out of here! ACHOO!"
— Gia, Weave Seer

name: Drowl

effects.name: Lore
effects.text: When you play Drowl, draw two cards.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Drowl attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Drowl and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Drowl.
flavor:
Hunting drowl, hunting drowl
Moving quiet as the night
Fearsome scowl, hungry growl
May I never see that sight

name: Flugg

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core Spells and Powers do not affect Flugg.

effects.name: Support
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is attacked by a Core Creature, before energy is removed, add four energy to the defending Creature.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Flugg attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Flugg and one of your other Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Flugg.
flavor: To boldly grow where nothing has grown before.

name: Frusk

effects.name: Magic Scent
effects.text: Whenever an opposing player plays a Spell or Relic, draw a card.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Frusk attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Frusk and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Go! Go away! Shoo! I mean it!"
"Anybody want a peanut?"
— Zet & Korg

name: Grass Hyren

effects.name: Evade
effects.text: Whenever Grass Hyren is attacked, roll a die. Grass Hyren looses that much less energy in the attack.

errata.previous_text: Whenever Grass Hyren is attacked, roll a die. Grass Hyren loses that much less energy in the attack.
errata.change: The first Effect was changed from Wily to Evade.
errata.source: The Dream's End version is the MRP of Grass Hyren.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Grass Hyren attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Grass Hyren and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"If at first you don't succeed, you're probably fighting a grass hyren."
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Heppeswip

effects.name: Unravel
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Creature or Relic uses a Power that affects one or more of your other Weave Creatures in play, you may discard one energy from Heppeswip to discard the opposing Creature or Relic from play.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Heppeswip attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Heppeswip and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
Ven aimed the heat lens at the clumsy-looking creature.
"Prepare to... HEY! That's expensive!"

name: Jumbor

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Jumbor attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Jumbor and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Taunt
powers.text: Choose any one player. Each of the chosen player's Creatures must attack during that player's next Attack Step, if able.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Jumbor.
flavor:
"That thing called me stupid!"
"Yeah... and your point?"
— Korg and Zet

name: Junjertrug

effects.name: Rage
effects.text: Whenever Junjertrug attacks, add two energy to it before energy is removed.

effects.name: Hunger
effects.text: Junjertrug must attack each turn if able.

flavor:
"Bad dream! Bad! No treat!"
— Marella

name: Lascinth

effects.name: Reflexes
effects.text: Whenever Lascinth is attacked, it removes energy immediately, before Creatures normally remove energy.

effects.name: Hunger
effects.text: Lascinth must attack each turn, if able. Your cards may not prevent Lascinth from attacking.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Lascinth attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Lascinth and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor: A Lascinth can snap fast-moving insects out of the air, so don't be poking it with your slow-moving fingers.

name: Osatch

effects.name: Sentry
effects.text: Your Relics and other Creatures may not be discarded from play or returned to your hand by opposing cards that specifically affect Creatures in this way. Opposing cards may not gain control of your Relics and other Creatures.
At the beginning of your turn, discard Osatch from play.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Osatch attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Osatch and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"See? We closed our eyes and it went away. Now we have a new stragedy."
— Korg, to Zet

name: Pagajack

effects.name: Familiarity
effects.text: When you play Pagajack, add two energy to it for each other Pagajack in play.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Pagajack attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Pagajack and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"You know what they say? They say 'Don't weave me awone!' Ha ha ha OW!!
Don't hit me!"
— Marella

name: Pody

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Pody attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Pody and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Backhand
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked on its controller's last turn. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor: It's always willing to lend a hand, because that's about all it has.

name: Quallon

effects.name: Rapid Change
effects.text: Whenever you use an Effect that moves energy between two Creatures in play, you may move one additional energy.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Quallon attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Quallon and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Their version of bug zappers is all backwards."
— Tony Jones

name: Speag

effects.name: Work
effects.text: Speag cannot attack.

effects.name: Watch
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is attacked, add two energy to Speag before energy is removed.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Speag is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move up to one energy between Speag and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"After seeing these, just walking in the Weave gives me the creeps."
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Tweave

effects.name: Surprise
effects.text: If you draw Tweave during your Draw Step, you may reveal it to your opponent and immediately play it with three energy, without paying any costs.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Tweave attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Tweave and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Tweave.
flavor:
"Okay, I think we're safe. Just don't touch anything."
— Zet, to Korg

name: Uwamar

effects.name: Wait
effects.text: Uwamar cannot attack.

effects.name: Watch
effects.text: Whenever you play any other Weave Creature, add two energy to Uwamar.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Uwamar is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Uwamar and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor: Insatiably curious, they're usually the first to look, first to find, and first to run away.

name: Vuryip

effects.name: Random Change
effects.text: Whenever Vuryip attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, draw a card.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Vuryip attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Vuryip and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Vuryip.
flavor: If a tree falls in a forest and no one's around to hear it, a vuryip will probably knock another one down.

name: Weave Hyren

effects.name: Wild Growth
effects.text: Once per turn, when an Effect adds energy to Weave Hyren, you may add one energy to each of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Rub its belly! Rub its belly!"
— Korg, to Zet

name: Weggit

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Weggit attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Weggit and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Whispering Winds
powers.text: Discard Weggit from play. Draw a card for each Weave Relic you have in play.

errata.previous_text: Discard Weggit from play. Draw one card for each Relic you have in play.
errata.change: Wispering Winds works with only Weave Relics.

flavor: It dreams a lot of relic lore, and it'll share its knowledge for the chance to dream some more.

name: Yajo

effects.name: Timid
effects.text: Yajo cannot attack.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Yajo is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Yajo and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked this turn. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Mmmm... crunchy!"
— Korg

name: Zassyfer

effects.name: Warning
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Weave Creatures is attacked, add one energy to that Creature before energy is removed.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Zassyfer attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Zassyfer and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"It was terrible! Hundreds of 'em, zassyfers everywhere! They ate all my
flutter yups!"
— Ora, Shieldmaiden

name: Ahdar

effects.name: Spy
effects.text: Whenever an opponent uses a Spell or Power to draw cards, you may draw an equal number of cards.

flavor: "One for you, one for me."

name: Artyva

effects.name: Healer's Aura
effects.text: At the end of your turn, choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. Add two energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: "Stop squealing. We can fix that little boo-boo."

name: Bo'Ahsa

effects.name: Weave Tactics
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, you may switch it with any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Her terms. Always her terms. I hate fighting on her terms."
— Barak, Cald Warlord

name: Iyori

powers.name: Lost Wisdom
powers.text: Discard one card from your hand. Choose any one player. The chosen player discards one card at random from his or her hand.

flavor:
"Wow. Your knowledge, her power. This gal's got it togeher."
— Fossik, Underkeeper

name: Kesia

effects.name: Native Strength
effects.text: Kesia may not play non-Weave Spells. Weave Spells cost Kesia two less energy, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Wild Growth
effects.text: Whenever any of your Creatures in play use an Effect that specifically moves energy, add one energy to that Creature.

flavor:
"She's good. Arrogant, naive, and narrow-minded, but very good."
— Yerthe

name: Kolte

effects.name: Parting Shot
effects.text: Each time one of your Creatures is defeated in an attack, discard two energy from the Creature that defeated it.

effects.name: Fight Back
effects.text: Whenever Kolte is attacked, discard two energy from the attacking Creature before energy is removed.

flavor: "Enough of this lame-o pacifism. HIYAH!"

name: Marella

effects.name: Vapid
effects.text: Marella may only draw one card total each turn.

flavor:
"Gosh... I dunno! (giggle)"
— Marella's answer to just about everything

name: Quirle

effects.name: Gift of Life
effects.text: At the start of each player's turn, you may choose any one Weave Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: He always wakes up happy. Not so, those who fight him.

name: Yerthe

effects.name: Empower Dream
effects.text: All of your hyren in play gain ENERGIZE: 1.

effects.name: Hyren Affinity
effects.text: You ignore regional penalties and restrictions when playing hyren.

flavor:
"You know, there are other creatures."
"None that matter."
— Kesia and Yerthe

name: Zaya

effects.name: Payback
effects.text: Whenever an opponent's card causes you to discard cards from your hand, you may choose to have that opponent discard an equal number of cards at random from his or her hand.

powers.name: Pressure
powers.text: Choose any one player. If the chosen player has more cards in his or her hand than you do, draw a card.

flavor: For a pacifist, she's awfully unforgiving.

name: Gia's Tome

effects.name: Research
effects.text: Once per turn, you may play a Creature from under Gia's Tome as if it were in your hand. If your Magi is Gia, Creatures played from Gia's Tome cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Record
effects.text: Each time a Creature that you own is defeated in an attack, you may place it under Gia's Tome instead of in the discard pile. If Gia's tome is discarded from play, discard all cards undder it

flavor:
"Get me that BOOOOK!"
— Evu, Loremaster

name: Junjertrug Horn

powers.name: Summon
powers.text: Search you deck and/or discard pile for any one Junjertug. Place the chosen Creature into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

errata.previous_text: Search your deck and/or discard pile for any one Junjertrug. Place the chosen Creature into your hand. Shuffle your deck.
errata.change: Summon was completely reworked from the Weave 2001 Preview Deck to Dream's End.
errata.source: The Dream's End version is the MRP of Junjertug Horn.

flavor: It's more effective than a dinner bell.

name: Kesia's Flute

powers.name: Bend
powers.text: Discard one energy from any number of your Weave Creatures in play, if Kesia is your Magi, you may move move all energy to Kesia instead of discarding it. Add two energy to an equal number of other Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Dang! Tune that thing, will ya?"
— Tony Jones

name: Tuk Berries

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Use this Power only before your Attack Step. Choose any one Weave Creature in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. That Creature cannot attack this turn.

flavor:
"Weave has ways to make you tuk."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Uwamar Beads

effects.name: Juju
effects.text: Each turn, the first opposing Spell, Power, or attack that discards energy from your Magi discards no energy.

effects.name: Karma
effects.text: Whenever an opposing card causes you to discard any number of cards from your hand, you may search your deck for any one Weave Creature and play it with its starting energy, without paying any costs.

flavor:
"How can a bunch of grass look so uninviting?"
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Weave Hut

effects.name: Shelter
effects.text: Your Creatures lose one less energy from opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects that discard energy. Your Magi loses no energy from opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects.

effects.name: Sproing!
effects.text: Whenever your Magi is attacked, discard Weave Hut from play.

flavor:
"I'll fling! And I'll flame! And I'll burn your hut down!"
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Weave Mat

effects.name: Easy Come
effects.text: Once per turn, when a Creature is played, draw a card.

effects.name: Easy Go
effects.text: At the end of each turn, if no Creatures were played that turn, discard two of your non-Magi cards from your hand or from play.

flavor:
"It's more comfortable than it looks."
"It would have to be."
— Gia and Eidon

name: Weave Powder

powers.name: Sculpt
powers.text: Discard Weave Powder from play. Search your deck for any one Weave Relic, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck. You may not sure Sculpt the turn you play Weave Powder.

flavor: Instant magic. Just add water.

name: Zaya's Bow

powers.name: Long Shot
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. That Creature must attack on its controller's next turn, if able. If your Magi is Zaya, all other Creatures controlled by that player must also attack on his or her next turn, if able.

flavor:
"I see him..."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Binding
text: Choose any one of your Creatures and any one opposing Creature. Neither of the chosen Creatures can attack or use its Powers or Effects while the other is in play. Weave Shadow Magi may play Binding.
flavor: Blackmail, pacifist style.

name: Drought
text: All cards in play gain no energy the text time they energize.
flavor:
"This is going to ruin my complexion."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Harmony
text: All Creatures in play with more than three energy are reduced to three energy. All Creatures in play with less than three energy are raised to three energy. Non-Weave Magi may not play Harmony.
flavor: Funny how leveling the playing field is so unfair...

name: Lifeweave
text: Discard your hand. If you discarded two or more cards, add two energy to each of your Weave Creatures in play.
flavor: Your life, their weave.

name: Sawgrass
text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked on its controller's last turn. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Sawgrass costs two less energy if the chosen Creature is Core.
flavor: Are you ready to find out what you're made of?

name: Sheath
text: Choose any one Weave Creature in play. Add eight energy to the chosen Creature. While that Creature remains in play, it may not attack or use Powers or Effects. When the chosen Creature is discarded from play, discard two cards of your choice from your hand.
flavor:
"Thankfully, it's not moving. That'll give us plenty of time to run!"
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: The Hunt
text: All of your Weave Creatures that can attack may attack twice this turn.
flavor:
"Hey! I thought you were supposed to be peaceful or something!"
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Weave Mind
text: Defeat your current Magi. You may keep your current Relics and Creatures in play. Reveal your next Magi with his or her starting energy. You may get the new Magi's starting cards as normal. Non-Weave Magi may not play this Spell.
flavor: When Weave Magi change their minds, they really change their minds.

name: Weave Winds
text: Until the start of your next turn, if any player has a Creature in play, he or she may not play non-Weave Creatures.
flavor: There's no running away when the tidal wave comes from the sky.

name: Aerial Flist

effects.name: Charge
effects.text: Whenever Aerial Flist attacks, add one energy to it before energy is removed.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Aerial Flist, increase or decrease its starting energy o one, until the end of the turn.

flavor:
"They fly like a feather and land like a rock."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Ballistic Baldar

effects.name: Fly Like a Rock
effects.text: At the end of your turn, discard five energy from Ballistic Baldar. If Ballistic Baldar is still in play, roll a die. Choose a number of Creatures in play equal to the die roll. You cannot choose a Creature more than once. Discard three energy from each of the chosen Creatures.

flavor:
"It'll never fly."
"That's... not the point."
— Whall and Kazm

name: Bubble Xyx

powers.name: Burst
powers.text: (2) Discard two energy from your Magi to draw three cards. Burst may not be used the turn Bubble Xyx is played. STARTING: Stradus

errata.previous_text: Discard two energy from your Magi to draw three cards.
errata.change: A delay of one turn to use Burst, as well as making Burst unavailable to Sorreah's Dream.

flavor: "Pop!"

name: Elder Yark

effects.name: Regal Presence
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Creature attacks, it removes energy from the defending Creature equal to either its starting energy or current energy, whichever is less.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Elder Yark loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"It's tough to put up a good fight when you have an uncontrollable urge to
kneel in respect."
— Targ'n, Elder

name: Firestorm Orish

powers.name: Firestorm
powers.text: Choose one of your Cald or Arderial Creatures in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature to add three energy to any one of your other Creatures in play. Spells, Powers, and Effects cannot prevent or modify this energy loss or gain.

flavor:
"You are a diamond in the rough. You just need a little more heat and
pressure."

name: Flying Hinko

effects.name: Empower
effects.text: Whenever an Arderial or Naroom Spell or Power adds energy to one or more Creatures in play, add one energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"I saw this little guy rescue a family of tree hinkos from the middle of a
lava flow, and I just had to keep him."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Galiant

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Galiant loses one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Riding Tail
powers.text: Your largest Creature in play gains energy equal to the current energy on the smallest opposing Creature in play.

flavor: It always has the best seat in the house.

name: Hurricane Orish

effects.name: Spell Drain
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opponent plays a Relic or Spell, add three energy to your Magi. Only one Spell Drain may be used for each Spell or Relic played.

errata.previous_text: Once per turn, when an opponent plays a Relic or a Spell, add three energy to your Magi.
errata.change: An addition of only one Spell Drain can trigger per Spell or Relic played.

flavor:
"I was doing fine, having fun. Then the eye of the storm winked at me."
— Kazm, Scout

name: Spray Narth

effects.name: Congregrate
effects.text: As you play Spray Narth, if you have at least two Creatures in play, one of which is Arderial and another one of which is Orothe, ignore Spray Narth's cost. You can only play one Spray Narth in this way per turn.

errata.previous_text: As you play Spray Narth, if you have at least one other Arderial and at least one other Orothe Creature in play, ignore Spray Narth's cost.
errata.change: Congregate now requires 2 separate Creatures (one Arderial, one Orothe) to be in play, as well as only being able to use Congregate once per turn. A maximum move limit of three energy from Spray Narth has been made for Healing Storm. A maximum of the chosen Pharan's printed starting energy has been added for Healing Storm. Discard both the chosen Pharan and Spray Narth from play.

powers.name: Healing Storm
powers.text: Choose any one Creature or Magi and one of your Pharans in play. Move the chosen Pharan's printed starting energy to the chosen Creature or Magi. Move up to three energy from Spray Narth to the chosen Creature or Magi. Add three energy to the chosen Creature or Magi. Discard both the chosen Pharan and Spray Narth from play.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Creature or Magi and one of your Pharans in play. Move the chosen Pharan's energy to the chosen Creature or Magi. Move Spray Narth's energy to the chosen Creature or Magi. Add three energy to the chosen Creature or Magi.
errata.change: Congregate now requires 2 separate Creatures (one Arderial, one Orothe) to be in play, as well as only being able to use Congregate once per turn. A maximum move limit of three energy from Spray Narth has been made for Healing Storm. A maximum of the chosen Pharan's printed starting energy has been added for Healing Storm. Discard both the chosen Pharan and Spray Narth from play.

flavor: Children of the narthsong, they play in the surf before they return to their home in the sky.

name: Defender of the Sky

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever you play a Xyx, add two additional energy to it.

flavor: She was among the first to fight against the shadow geysers, and the experience taught her well.

name: Lady of the Sky

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When Lady of the Sky is defeated, permanently increase the Energize rate of all of your other Arderial Magi by one for the rest of the game.

flavor:
"With the right leader, even a vellup can take down a colossus. But I'd
still bet on the colossus."

name: Voice of the Storm

effects.name: Diplomacy
effects.text: When you play a Creature, if it is Arderial and you have an Orothe Creature in play, reduce the played Creature's cost by one. Or, if the Creature played is Orothe and you have an Arderial Creature in play, reduce the played Creature's cost by one. Diplomacy may not reduce a Creature's cost to less than one, and may not reduce its cost by more than one.

errata.previous_text: If you have an Arderial Creature in play, all of your Orothe Creatures cost one less energy, to a minimum of one. If you have an Orothe Creature in play, all of your Arderial Creatures cost one less energy, to a minimum of one.
errata.change: Diplomacy has been clarified to allow only a cost reduction of one energy when a Creature is played and fulfills the requirements for Diplomacy.

flavor:
"Saladarits burn our oceans. You must be our voice, and bring the storms
to Cald."
— Mobis, to Orthea

name: Hand of the Sky

powers.name: Dream Steal
powers.text: Choose any one other player. Look at the chosen player's hand. You may discard Hand of the Sky from play to play a Spell from that player's hand, paying all costs, but ignoring regional penalties and restrictions. Shuffle the chosen Spell into its owner's deck.

flavor:
"Mine."
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Heart of the Sky

powers.name: Dream Steal
powers.text: Choose any one other player. Look through the chosen player's deck. You may discard Heart of the Sky from play to choose any one Spell from that player's deck and play it, paying all costs, but ignoring regional penalties and restrictions. Shuffle that player's deck and discard the chosen Spell afterward.

flavor:
"Which each breeze that blows through our fair cities, the heart beats
again. So long as the winds soar, Arderial will survive."
— Jaela, Regis

name: Crushing Winds
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the chosen Creature from play, draw two cards. Only Arderial Magi and Arderial Shadow Magi can play Crushing Winds.
flavor:
"Wow, this wind could blow away a furok... hey, where's my furok?"
— Sperri, Friend of Furoks

name: Sandswirl
text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. For the next X turns, the chosen Creature or Magi cannot use any Power or Effects and loses one additional energy in attacks.
flavor: The Curse of d'Resh: You will never leave the desert... without sand in your shoes!

name: Ainjer

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ainjer loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grr
powers.text: Discard Ainjer from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature for each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Opposing cards do not affect Grr when it is used and cannot alter the amount of energy discarded by Grr. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.

flavor:
"It's comin' down, and we're all going with it!"
— Golthub, Royal Toady

name: Bog Wellisk

effects.name: Dream Draft
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Relic, if your Magi is Bograth or Orothe, you may immediately play Bog Wellisk from your hand, ignoring all costs. You may play one Bog Wellisk in this way per turn.

flavor:
"What you talk'n 'bout, wellisk?"
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Bolobog

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Bolobog loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Strengthen
powers.text: Discard Bolobog from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature for each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.

flavor:
"Say hello to my little friends."
— Emlob, Obsessive Detailer

name: Flame Trulb

effects.name: Familiarity
effects.text: When you play Flame Trulb, add one energy to it for each Bograth or Cald Creature in play, whichever is less.

powers.name: Fireball
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Fire, like wood, is a tool, Tryn. It can help, it can hurt. Let me teach
you how to use fire, and more importantly, when."
— Barak, Warlord

name: Fog Hyren

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Fog Hyren, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to two, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Obscure Knowledge
powers.text: Draw two cards, then discard a card if your Magi is not Bograth.

flavor:
"I hate this! The only thing worse than the fog of war is a war of fog."
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Glablit

effects.name: Dream Blur
effects.text: All of your Bograth Creatures in play are also Core. All of your Core Creatures in play are also Bograth.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Glablit loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"I'm #2. I try harder."
— Golthub, Royal Toady

name: Green Stuff

effects.name: Ooze
effects.text: When you play Green Stuff, add one energy to it.

flavor:
"Yum! JUst like mom used to make!"
— Gorran, High Exalted Trainer

name: Gremble

powers.name: Parasitic Growth
powers.text: Discard Gremble from play. Discard your hand and draw three cards.

flavor:
"Why? I'll tell you why! We're attacking to cause dis...ray! And to break
things!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Warlike Emperor of Great
   and Mighty Bograth

name: Gwaeg

effects.name: Vile Herald
effects.text: Bograth Magi and Core Magi can play both Core Creatures and Bograth Creatures, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: If Gwaeg is defeated while defending, place it into your hand instead of your discard pile.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Gwaeg.
flavor:
"Korg, you have much more in common with these people than you think."
— Zet

name: Jile

effects.name: Vitalize
effects.text: All of your Jiles and Bograth Creatures in play gain ENERGIZE: 1.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Jile loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor: Jiles led Bograth's invasion of Paradwyn, scouting the opposition for their masters.

name: Makoor

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Makoor loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Onslaught
powers.text: Discard all of your Bograth Creatures from play. For each Creature discarded, choose an opposing Creature in play. Discard three energy from each chosen Creature. You can choose the same Creature more than once with this Power.

flavor: They exist only to bring down the noble and besmirch the beautiful.

name: Mirago

effects.name: Extra focus
effects.text: Whenever you play a Creature from your hand, you may discard a Bograth or d'Resh card from your hand to add two additional energy to that Creature.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Mirago loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"With this guy, knowledge is power."
— Fossik, Ringsmith

name: Mist Hyren

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Mist Hyren's cost is reduced by one for each of your Creatures in play.
Mist Hyren can only be played during your Play Creatures Step.

flavor: It's attracted to power. And, apparently, its tastes are not all that discriminating.

name: Moob

powers.name: Retrieve
powers.text: (3) Discard Moob from play. Add one energy to your Magi for Each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Use this Power before your Attack Step.

errata.previous_text: Discard Moob from play. Add one energy to your Magi for each of your Bograth Creatures in play.
errata.change: Retrieve's Cost has been increased to 3 and can only be used in the first P/R/S Step. Also the copy of Moob found in the Bograth Starter deck (ND) is printed on a Relic template with the art for Statement of Core Values.
errata.cost_note: cost field was missing entirely (treated as free) before this hand fix (2026-07-09) -- errata: "Retrieve's Cost has been increased to 3." See PROGRESS_LOG.md.

flavor:
"Wild thing! You moooob me!"
— Eryss, The Insane

name: Moss Quido

powers.name: Dark Secrets
powers.text: Discard Moss Quido from play. Draw cards equal the number of your Bograth or Core Creatures in play, whichever is greater, to a maximum of four. Use this Power only before the Attack Step.

errata.previous_text: Discard Moss Quido from play. Draw one card for each of your Bograth or Core Creatures in play, whichever is greater. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.
errata.change: A maximum limit of four cards can be drawn through Dark Secrets.

flavor:
"Before I go, Korg, let me give you a few pointers..."
"Ooh, goody, I like presents!"
— Zet and Korg

name: Muck Vinoc

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Muck Vinoc loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grapple
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with seven or more energy. Discard Muck Vinoc and the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"The bigger they are, the deeper they sink."
— Blygt, Magnificent Remembering Guy

name: Muggum

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: Discard Muggum from play. Choose any two Bograth and/or Underneath Creatures in play. Until the end of your next turn, both chosen Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"Cover me!"
— Strag, Underwatcher

name: Mydra

effects.name: Watchful
effects.text: Mydra loses only one energy whenever it is attacked.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Mydra, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

flavor:
"We snuck into their camp last night and called up a flood. But now they
have mydra guarding them."
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: N'kala

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play N'kala, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Support
powers.text: Add one energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"It's so soft and cuddly. And it hardly drools at all."
— Eryss, The Insane

name: Ooze Arboll

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ooze Arboll loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Amplify
powers.text: Discard Ooze Arboll from play. Add one energy to each of your Bograth Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Hey, now you've hurt its feelings. Give it a hug so it'll know you still
care."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Poison Baloo Root

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Poison Baloo Root, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Wither
powers.text: Discard one energy from all opposing Creatures.

flavor:
"Yes, it's bad for them, but THAT'S GOOD FOR YOU!"
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Pyder

effects.name: Leadership
effects.text: When you play Pyder, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder. Whenever you energize, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder.

effects.name: Summoning
effects.text: Whenever you play a Creature, discard energy from Pyder to play the Creature. All of your Bograth Creatures cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"I'm tired. Why don't you do all the work?"
— Korg, to his first pyder

name: Quido Swarm

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Quido Swarm's starting energy is equal to the number of your other Paradwyn and Bograth Creatures in play.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, restore Quido Swarm to its starting energy.

flavor:
"Them's good eatin'! You just open your mouth and run around!"
— Grahnna, to Korg

name: Ruid

effects.name: Mutate
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, you may choose to have it be a Core Creature instead.

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Your Magi's energize rate is increased by one.

flavor:
"I will RUID you!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Core-rupted Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Sarazen Outcast

effects.name: Favored Enemy
effects.text: When you play Sarazen Outcast, choose any one Creature type.

effects.name: Bane
effects.text: Whenever Sarazen Outcast attacks or is attacked by a Creature of the chosen type, add four energy to Sarazen Outcast before energy is removed.

flavor:
"It has a whole team of issues."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Slarnath

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: If you have four or more Bograth Creatures in play, draw a card.

flavor:
"It bosses a whole mob."
— Baa, Grand High Summoner

name: Swamp Hyren

effects.name: Nightmare Gate
effects.text: All of your other Core and Bograth cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

text: Core Magi can play Swamp Hyren.
flavor:
"An elegant creature for a more civilized age. For countless generations
the Swamp Hyren were the guardians of peace and justice in the great
Bograth empire."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Swamp Weebo

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Swamp Weebo loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Devitalize
powers.text: Discard Swamp Weebo from play. Choose X Creatures in play. Discard X energy from each chosen Creature. X is the number of your Bograth Creatures in play.

flavor:
"So that's what happens when you tick one of those off!"
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Taglat

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Taglat, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Dream Cross
powers.text: Choose any one Power or Effect on an opposing card in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Power or Effect is considered to be printed on Taglat. Taglat cannot copy a Power or Effect that it already has. All copied Powers that reference the card that they are printed on now reference Taglat.

flavor:
"It's more than a dream thief; it's an idea thief."
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Tar Hyren

effects.name: Cling
effects.text: When Tar Hyren is defeated in an attack, attach it to the Creature that defeated it. That Creature cannot attack and both that Creature and that Creature's Magi lose one energy at the beginning of each turn. When attached, Tar Hyren is not affected by any cards.

text: Only Bograth or Core Magi can play Tar Hyren.
flavor:
"That's what I love about the Tar Hyren, sticktoitiveness."
— Zet

name: Treepsh

effects.name: Watchful
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, you may discard Treepsh from play. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

powers.name: Supply
powers.text: Discard Treepsh from play. Draw a card. If you have more Creatures in play than any one opponent of your choice, draw an additional card.

flavor: They're very common along the border between the two regions, hence they always get caught in the middle.

name: Trulb

powers.name: Dream Hatch
powers.text: Discard Trulb from play. Look at a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of your Bograth Creatures in play. Choose any one Bograth Creature from those cards and play it with one energy, ignoring all costs. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

flavor:
"Nobody touch it!" yelled Olabra, as the new dream creature hissed and
scooted away.

name: Zungg

powers.name: Gnaw
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Zungg.

text: Only Bograth or Core Magi can play Zungg.
flavor:
"To sleep, perchance to dream up something THAT WILL EAT THESE THINGS!"
— Emlob, Obsessive Detailer

name: All-High King Korg

effects.name: Super Clever
effects.text: Korg cannot play Relics.

effects.name: Super Brave
effects.text: Whenever Korg has no energy, he is defeated, even if he has Creatures in play.

text: Korg can only play Core, Bograth, and Universal cards.
flavor: "Um... yeah! I had a good idea of Zet's: I'm king!"
subtype: Celebrated Emperor of Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Baa

effects.name: Hordes
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, you may discard one energy from Baa to draw an additional card at the end of the turn.

flavor: "I look for things. Things to make us grow."

name: Blygt

powers.name: Waking Dreams
powers.text: (3) Choose up to three different Bograth Creatures in your discard pile. An opposing player of your choice chooses one of the three Creatures. Shuffle the chosen Creature into your deck. Play each of the other two Creatures with one energy instead of their normal starting energy. Those Creatures cannot attack this turn.

errata.previous_text: Choose up to three different Bograth Creatures in your discard pile and play each of them with one energy instead of its normal starting energy. An opposing player immediately discards any one of those Creatures from play. Those Creatures cannot attack this turn.
errata.change: The Creature chosen by the opposing player is shuffled into the deck instead of placed back in the discard pile.

flavor: "Of course I'm depressed. People keep crushing my dreams."

name: Brog

effects.name: Fertilize
effects.text: Whenever a Creature is discarded from play in an attack, add one energy to Brog.

flavor: "I am Brog. Resistance is fertile."

name: Emlob

effects.name: Imaginary Friends
effects.text: Whenever one of your Spells, Powers, or Effects counts the number of Creatures or Bograth Creatures you have in play, increase the total by three.

errata.previous_text: You are considered to have three additional Bograth Creatures in play for all of your Spells, Powers and Effects.
errata.change: Imaginary Friends has been clarified for intent.

flavor: "Don't worry about me. I'll manage."

name: Eryss

effects.name: Discordia
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opposing Magi plays a non-Universal Creature not of their Magi's region, you may choose and discard one of that Magi's Creatures from play.

flavor: "Korg, Korg, he's our man, if he can't do it, GREAT!"

name: Golthub

powers.name: Mire
powers.text: Choose any one region. Defeat Golthub. Discard all non-Magi cards of the chosen region from play.

text: Golthub can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.
flavor: "It looks good to be the king."

name: Gorran

effects.name: Jile-treats
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your Jiles in play.

effects.name: Affinity
effects.text: Ignore regional penalties and restrictions when playing Jiles from your hand.

flavor: "They'll do anything for my jile-treats!"

name: Grahnna

effects.name: Share
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, choose any one Bograth Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Transform
effects.text: When you reveal Grahnna, if your previous Magi was Wiep, place any one Bograth card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavor:
"Did you bring enough for everybody?"
— Phlouk, Grand Supreme Ringsmith

name: Keggerop

effects.name: Momentum
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play a Bograth Creature, you may add energy to it equal to the number of your other Bograth Creatures in play. Discard one of your Bograth Creatures from play.

flavor:
"It can always get worse."
— attributed to Grath

name: Obgren

effects.name: Delusions
effects.text: Once per turn, as you play a Spell or uses a Power that specifies Bograth or Core, before any choices are made, you may change one of the references to Bograth or Core to a region of your choice.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you use a Spell or Power that specifies Bograth or Core, you may have it specify any other region instead.
errata.change: Delusions can only be used once a turn.

flavor:
"Everyone has their weak point. Except us. We are great and mighty. Just
ask Korg."

name: Olabra

effects.name: Resilience
effects.text: Your Creatures cannot be reduced below one energy by opposing Spells and Powers.

flavor: "You can't bury the mud."

name: Phlouk

powers.name: Ring Testing
powers.text: Play a Bograth Creature from your hand, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot attack this turn. At the end of your turn, discard energy from Phlouk equal to the Creature's starting energy. If you don't have enough energy on Phlouk, discard the Creature from play.

flavor:
"Not only is he supreme, he even makes the rings really round!"
— Blygt, Magnificent Remembering Guy

name: Wiep

effects.name: Transform
