errata.previous_text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard the chosen Creature. Play a Creature from your hand without paying its energy cost. Put energy onto the played Creature equal to its starting energy. That Creature may not attack this turn.
errata.change: You may not attack with the Creature played that turn with Dream Twist.
errata.source: The Unlimited version is the MRP of Whall.

flavor: "Have you ever had a dream with an ending you never dreamed possible? I can put one in your little head tonight."

name: Corf Pearl

powers.name: Weathercall
powers.text:
Roll one die.
1, 2, or 3 = Remove three energy from your Magi.
4 or 5 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.
6 = Choose any one Creature in play. Add
three energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: Unpredictable as the weather.

name: Hubdra's Spear

powers.name: Stab
powers.text: Choose any one Magi with no Creatures in play. Discard Hubdra's Spear from play. Discard all but one energy from the chosen Magi.

flavor:
"Tharik-shell points bounce off dream auras, but they 
go through Magi just fine."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Orothean Belt

effects.name: Hydromancy
effects.text: Whenever you play a Spell that adds energy to a Creature in play, add one additional energy to that Creature.

flavor:
"A drop, a drizzle, a torrent."
— Belt inscription

name: Orothean Gloves

effects.name: Empower
effects.text: Each of the Powers on your Creatures in play costs one less energy to use, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"Boulders, pebbles, sand."
— Inscription on left-hand glove

name: Orothean Goggles

powers.name: Foresight
powers.text: Look at the top two cards of your deck. You may discard either or both of these cards, or put them back on top of your deck in any order.

flavor:
"What ye see doesn't have to be what ye get."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Entangle
text: Choose any one Magi in play. The chosen Magi cannot play any spells during his or her next turn.
flavor: "Abracadableeeerrrgh!"

name: Implosion
text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard X Orothe cards from your hand. Discard X energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.
flavor: What is the sound of one mind emptying?

name: Submerge
text: Choose any one Orothe Creature in play. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.
flavor:
"Ask any Orathan who's been stranded on a beach by the tide. Water feels
good."
— O'Qua, Summoner

name: Tidal Wave
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. For an additional four energy you may choose and discard a second Creature from play.
flavor:
"Oh, better that her shattered hulk
Should sink beneath the wave;
Her thunder shook the mighty deep,
And there should be her grave."
— Oliver Wendell Holmes, "Old ironsides"

name: Typhoon
text: Roll one die. Discard energy equal to the die roll from each non-Orothe Creature in play.
flavor: The wind and the sea rise. Everything else goes down.

name: Undertow
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play. The chosen Creature's owner then shuffles that Creature back into his or her deck.
flavor:
"Controlling the current is the easy part of the spell. The hard part is
forcing the critter into the water in the first place."
— Orlon, Friend of Wellisks

name: Will of Orothe
text: Choose any one opponent. During his or her next turn, the chosen opponent's Creatures may not use Powers.
flavor:
"Out here you are at the mercy of the tides."
— Mobis, to Zet

name: Agovo

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: Draw one card.

flavor: "To protect its spores, the Great Mushroom of Knowledge gives them wings."

name: Bisiwog

effects.name: Tunneling Attack
effects.text: While burrowed, Bisiwog may still attack as normal.

flavor: "Shh. Listen. Do you hear that scratching?"

name: Brub

powers.name: Scrub
powers.text: Choose any one Korrit in play. If you control the chosen Korrit, move all its energy to Brub. If not, discard the chosen Korrit.

flavor:
"When I find out who put that Brub in my Korrit pen, I'll..."
— Ulk, Underwarden

name: Cave Hyren

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Add X energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: Blu drew up some plans for making Hyren-plate armor. Then he remembered that, like all dream creatures, they disappeared when they were defeated.

name: Cave Rudwot

effects.name: Defense
effects.text: If Cave Rudwot is attacked, add two energy to it before energy is removed.

flavor: Don't take on a Rudwot in its home, unless you like getting hurt.

name: Crystal Arboll

powers.name: Healing Light
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Crystal Arboll from play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. If the chosen Creature is Underneath, add two additional energy.

flavor: The Cave Rudwot turned to face him, and Wence took a step back. The lizard's eye were taking on the glow of the fallen Arboll.

name: Giant Korrit

effects.name: Pack Hunt
effects.text: Instead of its normal attack, Giant Korrit can attack with one of your other Creatures. Both Giant Korrit and the attacking Creature remove energy from the defending Creature, but Giant Korrit loses no energy in the attack.

flavor: "That's a big mushroom, all right."

name: Giant Parmalag

powers.name: Withdraw
powers.text: Giant Parmalag cannot be attacked until after your next turn.

flavor:
"Going Parmalag"
— Underneath expression meaning "on the defensive"

name: Giant Vulbor

powers.name: Mind Shock
powers.text: Remove four energy from any one Creature. That Creature's Magi may discard up to two cards. For each card discarded, remove two less energy.

flavor:
"Tough choice, I know."
— Fossik, Underkeeper

name: Gum-Gum

effects.name: Slide
effects.text: If Gum-Gum is attacked, you may switch it with any other Creature you control before energy is removed.

flavor:
"When hunting Gum-Gums, make sure you're ready for whatever they choose to
hide behind."
— Fossik, Underkeeper

name: Korrit

effects.name: Pack Hunt
effects.text: Instead of its normal attack, Korrit can attack with one of your other Creatures. Both Korrit and the attacking Creature remove energy from the defending Creature, but Korrit loses no energy in the attack.

flavor: "Oh look, they want to play too."

name: Mushroom Hyren

powers.name: Sanctuary
powers.text: (1) Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Return the chosen Creature its owner's hand. Add energy to your Magi equal to the Creature's printed starting energy or current energy, whichever is less.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Place the chosen Creature's energy on your Magi and return the Creature to your hand.
errata.change: Sanctuary's text has been adjusted to proper text templating rules.

flavor:
"It can undream its allies, giving its master extra power in a pinch."
— Strag, Underwatcher

name: Ormagon

powers.name: Devastate
powers.text: Discards all non-Underneath Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Now THAT is a BIG mushroom."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Pack Korrit

powers.name: Morale
powers.text: Add one energy to each other Korrit in play.

flavor:
"Arbolits sacrifice themselves,
Throughout our land of flame.
Down in the darkened Underneath,
The Korrits do the same."
— "The Arbolit", verse 12

name: Parmalag

powers.name: Shield
powers.text: Parmalag is prevented from losing any energy from attacks until the end of your turn.

flavor: Protected in their rock-hard shells, they attack by rolling at high speed toward their targets.

name: Vulbor

powers.name: Mind Shock
powers.text: (3) Choose any one player. The chosen player must discard two cards of his or her choice from his or her hand.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one player. The chosen player must discard two cards of his or her choice from his or her hand.
errata.change: Mind Shock's cost has been increased to 3 energy.
errata.source: The Unlimited version is the MRP of Vulbor.

flavor:
"The ground stopped shaking already, but it still feels
like my brain's jiggling around in my skull... don't laugh at me!"
— Zet, to Korg

name: Fossik

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: During your Draw Step, you may choose to add three energy to any one Creature, instead of drawing one of your two cards. Use this Effects only one per turn.

flavor: "Knowledge or power. Your choice."

name: Gogor

powers.name: Gravel Storm
powers.text: Roll one die. Discard energy equal to the die roll from each Creature in play. Gravel Storm does not affect burrowed Creatures.

flavor: "The walls tremble at my mighty... aww, look, a baby Bisiwog."

name: Gruk

powers.name: Undream
powers.text: (1) Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand. Add energy to Gruk equal to the Creature's printed starting energy or current energy, whichever is less.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Return the chosen Creature to its owner's hand and place its energy on Gruk.
errata.change: Undream's text has been adjusted to proper text templating rules.

flavor:
"Sure, she's an incredible Mushroom Farmer, but I
can only stand them for dinner so often."
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Motash

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: Whenever a Creature you control in play is attacked and defeated, return that Creature to your hand instead of discarding it.

flavor: "That's not the last you'll see of him."

name: Strag

effects.name: Defense
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is attacked, add one energy to that Creature before energy is removed.

flavor: "My eyes are everywhere. Hey, you almost sat on one!"

powers.name: Cataclysm
powers.text: Discard ALL cards in play. Each Magi is defeated and go to his or her owner's Magi pile.

name: Ulk

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the start of your turn add one energy to each of your Korrits in play.

flavor: "Is this the first time mushrooms have had YOU for lunch?"

name: Amulet of Ombor

powers.name: Energy Boost
powers.text: Roll one die. 1, 2, or 3 = Your opponents add one energy to each of their Creatures in play. 4 or 5 - Choose any one Creature in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. 6 = Chose any one Creature in play. Add four energy to the chosen Creature.

errata.previous_text:
Roll one die.
1, 2, or 3 = Your opponents add one energy
to each of their Creatures in play.
4 or 5 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add two energy to the chosen Creature.
6 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add four energy to the chosen Creature.
errata.change: Adding reminder text on Amulet of Ombor to allow you to play one Gate to Ombor from your hand or deck (Gate to Ombor's Effect - Talisman).

flavor: Motash watched as the Grag bore down on her crippled hyren. She clasped the amulet with a silent prayer...

name: Digging Goggles

effects.name: Tunneling Attack
effects.text: Your burrowed Creatures may attack as normal.

flavor:
Zed snorted. "You and what army?"
That's when he noticed the rumbling under his feet.

name: Gloves of Crystal

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever you play an Underneath Creature, you may move one additional energy from your Magi to that Creature. If the Creature is a Bisiwog, you may move one additional energy to it.

flavor:
"Dreaming can hurt a bit when using these. But the
results are worth the discomfort."
— Motash, Underlord

name: Motash's Staff

effects.name: Dreamcatch
effects.text: As one of your Creatures is being returned its owner's hand from play by an opposing card, instead add energy to your Magi equal to the Creature's printed starting energy or current energy, whichever is less.

errata.previous_text: If a Creature you control is being returned to your hand and the energy on that Creature is being discarded, instead place the Creature's energy on your Magi.
errata.change: Dreamcatch's text has been adjusted to proper text templating rules.

flavor:
"Undreaming is a sloppy process, but I think I've managed to clean it up a
bit."
— Motash, Underlord

name: Staff of Korrits

effects.name: Korrit Charge
effects.text: Whenever a Korrit you control Pack Hunts with another Creature, add one energy to that Korrit before energy is removed.

flavor:
"The spotted pink mushrooms answer to the one that holds me."
— Staff inscription

name: Bottomless Pit
text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than five energy. Discard the chosen Creature.
flavor: "Aieeeeeee!"

name: Burrow
text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. For X turns, the chosen Creatures cannot attack or lose more than two energy per turn from attacks or your opponents' Spells or Powers. The chosen creature is considered "burrowed." X includes your own turns.
flavor: There isn't much they can do to hurt you if they have to get through three meters of rock and soil first.

name: Carnivorous Cave
text: Discard one energy from each Creature and Magi in play. Carnivorous Cave does not affect burrowed Creatures.
flavor:
"Looks like a good place to have lunch."
— Korg, to Zet

name: Cave In
text: Discard one energy from each non-Underneath Creature and Magi in play. Discard one additional energy from each Arderial Creature and Magi.
flavor:
"Stop rocking the cave... hey, come back here!"
— Korg, to Zet

name: Enrich
text: Choose any one burrowed Creature in play. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.
flavor: "It's packed with nine essential nutrients and a full day's supply of energy! Got Soil?"

name: Ground Breaker
text: Roll one die. Choose any one Magi in play. Discard energy equal to the die roll from the chosen Magi.
flavor:
"If I can't make them shake with fear, I can at least make them shake."
— Strag, Underwatcher

name: Thunderquake
text: Choose any number of Creatures in play. Discard a total of X energy in any combination from the chosen Creatures. X cannot be more than 10.
flavor:
"Oh no it wasn't! It was shaking worse under MY feet!"
— Zet, to Korg

name: Colossus

effects.name: Anti-Magic
effects.text: Colossus may not be affected by opposing Spells, Powers or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play. Your Spells, Powers, and Effects may not alter the amount of energy on Colossus, or prevent Colossus from losing energy.

errata.previous_text: Colossus may not be affected by Spells, Powers or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play. Your Spells, Powers and Effects may not alter the amount of energy on Colossus, or prevent Colossus from losing energy.
errata.change: Only opposing Effects, Powers, or Spells do not discard Colossus from play. Your cards can not add or remove energy to Colossus or allow a Rearrange to include Colossus.
errata.source: The version included in the Warrada/Ogar/Quade Core Starter deck (AW) is the MRP of Colossus. That version was printed as if it was a Base Set, Unlimited card.

flavor:
"You can fight a war with cloaks and daggers.
But you don't have to."
— Jaela, Arderial Regis

name: Ancestral Flute

powers.name: Song of the Family
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Ancestral Flute from play. Search your deck for up to two copies of the chosen Creature. Show the cards to your opponents, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

flavor:
"Play something else. That makes me homesick."
— Tony, to Tryn

name: Baloo Root

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Baloo Root from play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: "IT'S GOOD FOR YOU!!!"

name: Book of Ages

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: (2) Draw 1 card.

errata.previous_text: Draw one card.
errata.change: The drawing of a card with Lore now occurs in either P/R/S Step rather than at the end of turn.
errata.source: The Unlimited Version is the MRP of Book of Ages.

flavor:
"The more knowledge you gain, the better prepared you are."
— Evu, Naroom Loremaster

name: Channeler's Gloves

powers.name: Channeling
powers.text: Discard two cards from your hand. Add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"To the Core with knowledge. I need power NOW!"
— Fossik, Underkeeper

name: Dream Balm

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: (2) Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. Discard Dream Balm from play. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. Discard Dream Balm from play. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.
errata.change: Vitalize's cost has been reduced to two energy.
errata.source: The Unlimited version is the MRP of Dream Balm.

flavor:
"Ye know what it's made of? Artificially sweetened
dreams. Ye can put it in yer mouth now, but ye won't
taste it until ye go to sleep."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Mirror Pendant

powers.name: Auraflection
powers.text: Choose any one Power on your Magi. You may discard energy from your Magi equal to the chosen Power's cost, and discard an additional two energy. If you do, play all actions of the chosen Power.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Power on your Magi. Discard energy from your Magi equal to the chosen Power's cost, and discard an additional two energy. Play all actions of the chosen Power.
errata.change: A clarification allowing you not to trigger Aurareflection.

flavor:
"I don't care too much for jewelry, but wow..."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Relic Mirror

effects.name: Trick Image
effects.text: As an opposing Spell or Power that discards Relics from play would affect one of your other Relics in play, choose one of those Relics and discard Relic Mirror from play. The Spell or Power does not affect the chosen Relic.

errata.previous_text: If your opponent discards one of your Relics from play, you may have Relic Mirror discarded from play in its place.
errata.change: Trick Image has been clarified to act as intended.

flavor:
"Only fools attack a reflection. But fools are everywhere."
— Blue, Vault Guardian

name: Relic Stalker

powers.name: Pound Pound Pound
powers.text: Choose any one Relic in play. Discard Relic Stalker from player. Discard the chosen Relic from play.

flavor: Pitter-patter-pitter-patter WHAM WHAM WHAM!

name: Ring of Secrets

effects.name: Tinker
effects.text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. You cannot choose a Creature more than once per turn with Tinker.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.
errata.change: Each Creature is affected by Tinker once a turn.

flavor:
"Me mates and I guard the Vault of Science, and
the Vault returns the favor."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Robes of the Ages

effects.name: Ancestral Favor
effects.text: Your Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"Ye can hear the voices of all the wizards who've worn
it before. Ye get to draw on their leftover power, but I tell
ye, matey, it gets creepy."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Staff of Hyren

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever you play a Hyren, add one additional energy to it.

flavor:
"The Hyren rule the land. But I rule the Hyren."
— Staff inscription

name: Syphon Stone

powers.name: Syphon
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Syphon from play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"If there were some way to make use of the energy it drains
away, then it would be powerful indeed."
— Nimbulo, Arderial Sage

name: Warrior's Boots

powers.name: Warpath
powers.text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from you hand. You must still pay all costs for the Creature.

errata.previous_text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from your hand. You still must transfer the Creature's starting energy from your Magi to the Creature as normal.
errata.change: Better clarification on paying all costs associated with the Creature played through Warpath.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Warrior's Boots.

flavor:
"You can tell a true fighter by the way he walks."
— Barak, Cald Warlord

name: Water of Life

effects.name: Invigorate
effects.text: Your Magi's energize rate is increased by one.

flavor:
"The power is ancient, but the water doesn't taste that way."
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Jaim

effects.name: Guardian
effects.text: After an opposing card discards one or more of your Orothe Relics from play, you may remove one energy from Jaim. If you do, return the Relics to their owner's hand.

text: You may not play more than two Relics per turn.
flavor: "I'm never caught unprepared when my relics are near."

name: Rock Hyren

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Rock Hyren loses two less energy in attacks and opposing Spells, Powers, and Effects that discard energy. Your Spells, Powers, and other Effects may not prevent Rock Hyren from losing energy.

flavor: I've heard rock is strong. Nothin' beats rock.

name: Weave Hyren

effects.name: Wild Growth
effects.text: Once per turn, when an Effect adds energy to Weave Hyren, you may choose to add one energy to each of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor: A major pain in the grass.

effects.name: Purity
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if all Spells in your discard pile are Bograth, discard all of your non-Bograth cards from play and choose an opposing Creature. If that Creature has more energy than your Magi's energize, move three energy from that Creature to your Magi.

name: Canopy Hyren

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Remove two energy from each Stalked Creature.

flavor: Becoming one with the treetops, the canopy hyren is unparalleled in the art of sneak attacks.

name: Sludge Hyren

effects.name: Creeping Growth
effects.text: After Sludge Hyren attacks, add one energy to it for each Bograth Creature you control.

flavor: "It leaches the strength from its companions to act as their battering ram."

name: Snag Hyren

powers.name: Stumble
powers.text: Until the beginning of your next turn, opposing Creatures remove two less energy in attacks.

flavor: It seemed to the Shadow Magi as if the clinging barbs of the snag hyren were suddenly everywhere.

name: Sorreah, Warrior

effects.name: Dream Block
effects.text: Players may not use Powers on Creatures.

flavor:
"His time among the Kybarites has given him a greater appreciation of brute
strength."
— Adis

name: Traitor's Reach
text: Choose a Creature and a Magi controlled by the same player. If the chosen Creature does not share a region with the chosen Magi, discard that Creature from play and remove two energy from that Magi.
flavor:
Enviouis of Targ'n's position as Elder, T'lok betrayed the secret
entrances to Yark Eyre to the Dark Twins. Enamoured with Warrada,
T'lok also taught her how to control Kybar's Fang.

name: Tundra Hyren

powers.name: Freeze
powers.text: Choose an opposing Magi. That Magi's Creatures are Frozen until the beginning of your next turn. Powers of Frozen cards cost one extra energy to use.

flavor: Focused freezing power in an easy to use package.

name: Twilight Mowat

effects.name: Dream Inhibitor
effects.text: Powers on opposing Core Creatures cost two extra energy.

powers.name: Dark Sands
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. That Creature is Core until the beginning of your next turn.

text: Only Core and d'Resh Magi may play Twilight Mowat.
flavor: After being released from their prison in d'Resh, Lanyx and Chur used their powers of corruption to taint the beauty of the desert.

name: Twilight Mowat

effects.name: Dream Inhibitor
effects.text: Powers on opposing Core Creatures cost two extra energy.

powers.name: Dark Sands
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. That Creature is Core until the beginning of your next turn.

text: Only Core and d'Resh Magi may play Twilight Mowat.

name: Granite Hyren

effects.name: Improved Invulnerability
effects.text: Granite Hyren loses three less energy in attacks.

flavor:
Formed from the hardest substance in the Teeth, these hyren can take an
incredible amount of abuse before showing signs of wear.

name: Crushing Roots
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the chosen Creature from play, choose any one of your Creatures in play. Add three energy to that Creature. Only Naroom Magi and Naroom Shadow Magi can play Crushing Roots.
flavor: Tryn and Barak watched in horror as the ash hyren stood aside. The great shadow beast loomed over Barak. "Run!" yelled Tryn, as she brought forth great roots to beat the monster back.

name: Elder Weebo

powers.name: Vitaminize
powers.text: Discard Elder Weebo from play. Until the end of your next turn, each of your Naroom Creatures in play with an energize rate has its energize rate increased by two. Each of your other Naroom Creatures in play gains an energize rate of two until the end of your next turn.

flavor:
"Very rare, but very, very tasty."
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Fird

effects.name: Perch
effects.text: Whenever you play a Furok, you can play one copy of Fird from your hand or discard pile, paying all costs. Fird cannot attack this turn.

flavor:
"F-F-F-Fird, fird, fird, fird is the word."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Fird Stone

effects.name: Fird Favor
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power would affect one or more of your Furoks in play, you may discard two energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell or Power does not affect any of your Furoks in play.

flavor:
"Just holding it makes you feel large and furry, and if you don't have
antlers, the firds will come sit on your shoulders!"
— Sperri, Friend of Furoks

name: Flame Rudwot

powers.name: Healing Flame
powers.text: Choose any one other Cald or Naroom Creature in play. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.

powers.name: Burning Branches
powers.text: Choose any one non-Cald, non-Naroom Creature in play. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"What are you doing? Naroom trees weak, Cald fire strong!"
— Sinder, to Barak

name: Flood of Energy
text: Energize all cards with an energize rate.
flavor:
"Sometimes nature can be a little too generous."
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Forest Blessing
text: Restore each Naroom Creature in play with less than its starting energy to its starting energy.
flavor:
"You got any Sap of Life?"
"NO! WE'RE ALL OUT OF SAP OF LIFE!"
"Well, in that case... in that case, what DO you have?"

name: Forest Hyren

effects.name: Underbrush
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to Forest Hyren, add an additional energy to Forest Hyren.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.text: Choose any one other Creature in play. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Forest Hyren.
flavor: From life comes life.

name: Forest Jile

powers.name: Reinforce
powers.text: Add two energy to each of your Creatures that attacked this turn.

flavor: "The jile roars! That means the battle is won!"

name: Forest Wudge

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Creature, add one energy to Forest Wudge. If the Creature played is Naroom, add an additional energy to Forest Wudge.

effects.name: Home Turf
effects.text: When you play Forest Wudge, if any opposing Magi is Naroom or Naroom Shadow, draw a card.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Forest Wudge, ignoring regional penalties.
flavor:
"Anklebiter."
— Eidon, Elder

name: Furlosk

effects.name: Swamp Lore
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play another Bograth Creature, draw a card.

effects.name: Forest Power
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play another Naroom Creature, add two energy to your Magi.

effects.name: Companionship
effects.text: If you do not have another Bograth or Naroom Creature in play, discard Furlosk from play.

errata.previous_text: If you do not have at least one other Bograth and one other Naroom Creature in play, discard Furlosk from play.
errata.change: Companionship now requires either a Bograth or Naroom Creature to be in play instead of both.

flavor:
"We all need somebody to lean on."
— Wiep, the Sniveler

name: Furok

effects.name: Retrieve
effects.text: As a defending Creature removes energy from Furok place half that energy, rounded up, back on your Magi.

errata.previous_text: When a defending Creature removes energy from Furok, place half of that energy, rounded up, back on your Magi.
errata.change: Retrieve has been reworded to the "As" trigger.

flavor:
"Fine, you can pet it. But don't blame me if it rolls over on you."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Furok Guardian

effects.name: Terra Rebirth
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is discarded from play, you may discard five energy from Furok Guardian. If you do, return the discarded Creature to play with its starting energy at the end of the current player's turn.

flavor: Power overwhelming.

name: Giant Carillion

powers.name: Stomp
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"When a tree falls in the forest, it sometimes falls on
the one that hears it."
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Glade Hyren

effects.name: Serenity
effects.text: As you play Glade Hyren, you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, reduce Glade Hyren's cost by one for each of your other Naroom Creatures in play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"I don't even dream them up; they simply appear in times of need."
— Eidon, Elder

name: Grow
text: Roll one die. Choose any one Creature in play. Add energy equal to the die roll to the chosen Creature.
flavor:
"Let's see how far the ivy spreads this time!"
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Hyren's Call
text: Search your deck for any one hyren. Play the hyren with full energy. The hyren cannot attack this turn. Shuffle your deck.
flavor:
Through the forests, through the deep,
Through the mountains hyren creep.
Caverns echo hyrens' cries.
Streaking shadows split the skies.

name: Jip

effects.name: Tap Strength
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever one or more opposing Creatures gains any amount of energy, you may add energy to Jip equal to the total energy gained by the opposing Creatures.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Jip.
flavor: It's happy when you're happy... which may then make you unhappy.

name: Leaf Chogo

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Leaf Chogo is not affected by opposing Core Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Leaf Storm
effects.text: After Leaf Chogo attacks, you may discard it from play. If you do, add one energy to each of your Creatures. Discard one energy from each opposing Core Creature.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi can play Leaf Chogo.
flavor:
"Hey you, get offa my moon!"
— Yaki, to Warrada

name: Overgrowth
text: Choose a Creature. Attach this Spell to the chosen Creature. While Overgrowth is in play, that Creature gains "ENERGIZE: 3".
flavor:
"I don't like cleaning... so I just don't come back."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Poad, Innkeeper

effects.name: Hearty
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Creaturs is attacked, you may move any amount of energy from Poad to that Creature. Add an additional energy to the Creature if it is Nar or Naroom.

powers.name: Party
powers.text: Choose one of your Creatures. Add energy to the chosen Creature equal to the number of Creatures you have in play. The chosen Creature cannot use Powers this turn. Discard the Creature at the end of the turn.

flavor: "Have you had breakfast today?"

name: Poad's Secret Sauce

effects.name: Flavor
effects.text: Whenever one of your Spells or Powers adds energy to exactly one of your Creatures, add an additional energy to that Creature.

flavor:
Tastes great!
More filling!

name: Pruitt's Robe

effects.name: Glimmer
effects.text: Whenever you energize, you may choose any one of your Creatures in play. Add the energy to the chosen Creature instead of your Magi. If your Magi is Pruitt, you may also add two energy to her.

flavor:
"Lookin' good, feelin' good."
— Pruitt, Naroom Ringsmith

name: Robe of Vines

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever you play a Naroom Creature, add one additional energy to it.

flavor:
"It's more than a fashion statement, of course, but don't I look good in
vines?"
— Tryn, to Tony

name: Salafy

effects.name: Protege
effects.text: Once per turn, when you play a Naroom Creature, you may search your discard pile for a copy of that Creature and place it in your hand.

flavor: "What? Why would I want to be Keeper?!?"

name: Tap Roots
text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Remove up to two energy from one of the chosen Creatures. Add up to two energy to the other chosen Creature.
flavor:
"I'm the gardener. These are my plants. And you, brother, are the
fertilizer. Dig it."
— Yaki, Naroom Tracker

name: Tree Hinko

powers.name: Invigorate
powers.text: The next time your Magi energizes, he or she energizes for two additional energy.

flavor:
"Gotta get me one of these!"
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Vim and Vigor
text: Choose an opposing Creature in play. Move all energy above the chosen Creature's starting energy to your Magi. Naroom Shadow Magi may play Vim and Vigor.
flavor:
"Dinner time!"
— Poad, Naroom Innkeeper

name: Wasperine

effects.name: Rush
effects.text: If your Magi is a Naroom or Naroom Shadow Magi, you may play Wasperine at the beginning of your Attack Step, paying all costs.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Wasperine.
flavor:
Green. White and orange. Red. Lots of red. Then black.
— Description of a Wasperine attack

name: Weebo

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

flavor:
"Don't eat wild foest mushrooms... unless they're wild
orange forest mushrooms with feet."
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Woot!

effects.name: Savagery
effects.text: Energy removed in attacks by your Wasperines cannot be prevented by opposing cards.

effects.name: Weebos Are For Wimps
effects.text: Powers on your Creatures cannot add energy to other Creatures.

flavor:
"Out of weebos? In that case, what DO you have?"
"Just this box of one dozen rabid wasperines!"
"Okay, I'll take that..."

name: Yaki, Core Stalker

effects.name: Absorb Darkness
effects.text: All of your Spells and Powers that affect Core cards you control may instead affect your Naroom cards.

effects.name: Overwhelm
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, you may add two energy to it before energy is removed, or four energy if it is attacking a Core card. If you do, discard your Creature at the end of your Attack step.

text: Yaki can only play Core, Naroom, and Universal cards, but ignores regional penalties and restrictions. Yaki cannot be in a Magi stack with Core Magi.
flavor: "Yes, I use the powers of the Core. It's not like they gave me a choice."

name: Yaki's Gauntlets

powers.name: Double Strike
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand. Until the end of your turn, all of your Naroom Creatures may attack an additional time.

flavor:
"I call this move 'the aritex technique.' Properly done, there's no
defense."
— Yaki, Tracker

name: Zajan

effects.name: Work All Night
effects.text: Zajan does not energize as normal during the energize step. Zajan energizes during the draw step.

effects.name: Sleep All Day
effects.text: Zajan draws two cards during the energize step. Zajan does not draw cards as normal during the draw step.

flavor:
"He goes around whistling this inane little tune all the time. It drives
me crazy."
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Zannah

effects.name: Charm
effects.text: On each opposing turn, the first opposing card that removes energy from either only Zannah or only one of your Creatures removes no energy.

errata.previous_text: Each turn, the first opposing card that removes energy from Zannah or one of your Creatures removes no energy.
errata.change: Only on opposing turns does Charm trigger.

flavor:
"Wow, she's purty!"
— Korg

name: Ambush
text: Choose any one Creature in play. The chosen Creature loses energy equal to its starting energy.
flavor:
"There's so many plants... how can you tell which one is the am-bush?"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Botanical Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Ardonia

effects.name: Relentless Hunt
effects.text: At the end of each of your turns, all opposing stalked Creatures in play lose one energy.

flavor: "I'll delay them as long as I can. But we need to send someone for help."

name: Bagala

effects.name: Pack Charge
effects.text: Whenever Bagala attacks, before energy is removed, add one energy to it for each of your Bagala Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Strength AND numbers!"
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: Bagala Cub

effects.name: Family Ties
effects.text: When Bagala Cub is discarded from play, search your deck for any one Bagala. Place it into your hand. Reshuffle your deck afterwards.

flavor:
"Are you sure you didn't hear its mother?"
— Wiep, the Sniveler

name: Bazha's Pendant

effects.name: Reply
effects.text: Once per turn, immediately after an opposing player plays a Spell or Relic or uses a Power on one of his or her cards in play, you may use a Power on one of your cards in play.

flavor:
"Persistence will win out in the end. They will tire and go home. I hope."
— Bazha, Lifekeeper

name: Bloom
text: You can only play Bloom during an opponent's turn immediately after that opponent plays a Spell or Relic or uses a Power. After playing this Spell, immediately use any one Power on one of your cards in play or play a Spell from your hand.
flavor:
"No no, Ashgar, around here, we pronounce the 'L': bLLLLoom!"
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: Bulabantu

effects.name: Ambush
effects.text: When you play Bulabantu, choose a Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Spotted a Bulabantu."
— Paradwyn maxim meaning "too late"

name: Crushing Vines
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Remove four energy from the chosen Creature. If the chosen Creature is discarded from play, until the end of your turn, all of that player's Creatures are stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed. Only Paradwyn Magi and Paradwyn Shadow Magi can play Crushing Vines.
flavor:
"Mmmm. Crushing vines."
— Culla, Jungle Guard

name: Flourish
text: Until the end of your next turn, all Creatures with starting energy greater than two cost two less energy to play, to a minimum of two.
flavor:
"On the other hand, what if we held a war and everybody came?"
— Olabra, Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Fog Hyren

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Fog Hyren, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to two, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Obscure Knowledge
powers.text: Draw two cards, then discard a card if your Magi is not Bograth.

flavor:
"I hate this! The only thing worse than the fog of war is a war of fog."
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Froxfire
text: Choose any one stalked Creature in play. Discard the chosen Creature from play.
flavor:
Flickering, the froxfire light
Silhouettes the beast at night.
What a nice, inviting sight!
It's much more fun to pounce!
— The Scarlet Song

name: Gwomba

effects.name: Maximum Warp
effects.text: Once per turn as you are playing another Paradwyn Creature, you may change its starting energy to any other number until the end of the turn. You cannot change it to less than one or to more than Gwomba's current energy.

effects.name: Maximum Fury
effects.text: All Bograth Creatures lose one additional energy in attacks.

flavor:
"When it's well fed, we're all well fed!"
— Boria, Elder

name: Janx

effects.name: Bicker
effects.text: Whenever Janx attacks, discard two energy from each of the defending Magi's stalked Creatures after energy is removed.

flavor:
"Good tracker, decent navigator. Lousy conversationalist."
— Liriel

name: Jungle Jile

powers.name: Mass Stalk
powers.text: Choose any one player. Until the beginning of your next turn, all of that player's Creatures are stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed.

flavor:
Searching eyes and twitching nose
As anticipation grows.
The jungle jile surely knows
It's more fun to pounce!
— The Scarlet Song

name: K'ly

effects.name: Stalk
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Magi plays a Creature, you may discard one energy from K'ly. If you do, until the end of your next turn, that Creature and all other Creatures played this turn are stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed.

effects.name: Hunt
effects.text: Whenever K'ly attacks a stalked Creature, add one energy to K'ly before energy is removed.

flavor: They say it can hear you blink.

name: K'teeb

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play K'teeb, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Dream Cross
powers.text: Choose any one of your other Creatures in play. Until the chosen Creature leaves play, all Powers printed on the chosen Creature are also considered to be printed on K'teeb. K'teeb cannot copy a Power that it already has. All of K'teeb's Powers that reference the card that they are printed on now reference K'teeb.

flavor:
"Wow, I wish you were a giant carillion... Oh, wait, you can do it!
WOO-HOO!"
— Yaki, Tracker

name: Kiersta

effects.name: Swoon
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, you may add five energy to Kiersta. If you do, skip your Attack step this turn. You cannot use Swoon on your next turn.

flavor:
"Falling asleep at random is one thing, but falling asleep on a vine
swing?"
— Bazha, to Emlob

name: Kwup

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Choose any one stalked Creature. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Yeah, I really kwupped up on his hide."
— Bazha, Lifekeeper

name: Lahalou

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Lahalou, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Grow
powers.text: Add one energy to Lahalou.

flavor:
"For a little thing, it sure is big."
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Liriel

effects.name: Command
effects.text: Whenever one of your Bagalas attacks, add one energy to it before energy is removed.

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: Search your deck for any one Bagala and place it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

flavor: "What's new, pussycat?"

name: Liriel's Cape

effects.name: Dazzle
effects.text: Each of your Creatures in play with the Effect "Dreamwarp" has an additional three starting energy.

powers.name: Mass Heal
powers.text: Discard Liriel's Cape from play. If there is at least one opposing Creature, restore all Creatures with less than their starting energy to their starting energy.

flavor:
"I'm full of surprises."
— Liriel

name: N'kala

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play N'kala, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Support
powers.text: Add one energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"It's so soft and cuddly. And it hardly drools at all."
— Eryss, The Insane

name: Ookami

effects.name: Heartbeat
effects.text: All Powers that add energy to your Creatures add one additional energy.

flavor: Were it not for the voice of his drums, rolling like a thunderclap and spreading the alarm, Paradwyn might have fallen to Korg's first assault.

name: Oranragan

effects.name: Crush
effects.text: When you play Oranragan, choose and discard an opposing Relic from play.

effects.name: Vengeance
effects.text: When an opposing card discards one of your cards from play or reduces one of your other Creatures to zero energy, add two energy to Oranragan.

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Oranragan loses one less energy in attacks.

flavor:
"What the heck would you do with a banana that big anyway?"
— Jagt, Prankster

name: Poison Baloo Root

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Poison Baloo Root, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Wither
powers.text: Discard one energy from all opposing Creatures.

flavor:
"Yes, it's bad for them, but THAT'S GOOD FOR YOU!"
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Robe of Petals

effects.name: Ease
effects.text: All of your Creatures with the Effect "Dreamwarp" cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"Ooh! Ooh! I want it! Can you get me one?"
— Pruitt, to Bria

name: Spell Pulse
text: Choose either Spells or Relics. Discard all cards of the chosen card type from play.
flavor:
"Open your mind too far, and everything falls out."
— Eidon, Retired Keeper

name: Stalker's Boots

powers.name: Stalk
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, whenever one of your Creatures is attacking, the defending Creature is stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed.

flavor:
Stalker's boots upon my feet
Dance me to the jungle beat.
Soon I'll leap, my hunt complete,
It's much more fun to pounce!
— The Scarlet Song

name: Tropical Hyren

effects.name: Maximum Warp
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures uses the effect "Dreamwarp", you may Dreamwarp for an additional energy.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Tropical Hyren, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

flavor: Perpetual commotion machine.

name: Tropical Jumbor

effects.name: Scout
effects.text: At the end of your turn, if Tropical Jumbor did not attack this turn, add two energy to it.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Tropical Jumbor is in an attack, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Tropical Jumbor and any one of your other Paradwyn or Weave Creatures.

flavor: It pounces as gracefully as a slab of granite.

name: Tropical Plith

effects.name: Confer
effects.text: During your Draw step, if you played a Creature with the Effect "Dreamwarp" this turn, draw an additional card.

flavor:
"Wow! There's a whole plith-ora of 'em! Ow! What was that for?"
— a slightly bruised Marella

name: Tropical Rain
text: Choose any one Creature in play with the Effect "Dreamwarp". Add three energy to the chosen Creature. You can play Tropical Rain on an opponent's turn, immediately after one of your Creatures is attacked, but before energy is removed.
flavor:
"Urgh, it's raining jiles and furoks out there!"
"Really? Lemme see!"
— Zet and Korg

name: Tropical Vinoc

effects.name: Hunt
effects.text: Whenever Tropical Vinoc attacks a stalked Creature, draw one card before energy is removed.

powers.name: Stalk
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand. Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen Creature is stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed. You can use this Power any number of times during your turn.

flavor:
"Beware the vines of Boria!"
— Bograth maxim

name: Weed Hyren

effects.name: Withdraw
effects.text: If Weed Hyren is discarded from play outside of an attack, place it in your hand instead of the discard pile.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Weed Hyren, increase or decrease its starting energy by up o one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Weed Hyren attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Weed Hyren and any one of your other Paradwyn or Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"You! Get out of my garden! Ooohh, it's too late already."
— Kesia, Musician

name: Yricho

effects.name: Athletic
effects.text: Once per turn, immediately after an opposing player uses a Power on one of his or her cards in play, you can use a Power on one of your cards in play.

flavor:
"Don't try to sneak anything past Yricho."
— Bazha, Lifekeeper

name: Yricho's Staff

effects.name: Safe
effects.text: As an opposing card specifically discards one of your Creatures from play, roll a die. If the die roll is less than the energy on your Magi, remove two energy from your Magi and the opposing card does not discard your Creature from play.

flavor: "Run home!" yelled Yricho, brandishing his staff.

name: Ahdar

effects.name: Spy
effects.text: Whenever an opponent uses a Spell or Power to draw cards, you may draw an equal number of cards.

flavor: "One for you, one for me."

name: Baby Furok

effects.name: Cuddly-Wuddly
effects.text: The first opposing Spell, Power, Effect, or attack that removes energy from Baby Furok during each opposing Player's turn removes no energy from it.

flavor:
"They're even more dangerous than adult furoks; at least the adults know
they're not supposed to jump on you."
— Sperri, Friend of Furoks

name: Blade Hyren

effects.name: Great Weave
effects.text: Whenever Blade Hyren attacks, you may move one energy from each of your other Weave Creatures in play to Blade Hyren.

effects.name: Bequest
effects.text: If Blade Hyren is specifically discarded from play by an opposing Spell or Power, move all energy on Blade Hyren to any one of your Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi can play Blade Hyren.
flavor:
"If you strike down the blade hyren, something else will become more
powerful than you can possibly imagine."
— Zaya, Elder

name: Bo'Ahsa

effects.name: Weave Tactics
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, you may switch it with any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Her terms. Always her terms. I hate fighting on her terms."
— Barak, Cald Warlord

name: Bo'Ahsa's Shield

effects.name: Weave Tactics
effects.text: Once per turn, when one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, choose one of your Weave Creatures in play. Replace the defending Creature with the chosen Creature.

flavor: Bo'Ahsa's terms are clearly inscribed on the inside of the shield.

name: Bungaloo

effects.name: Flee
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo is defeated in an attack, choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature or Magi.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Bungaloo attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Bungaloo and one of your other Weave or Naroom Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Yes, it's cute, but they shed like... like... ACHOO!
Get it out of here! ACHOO!"
— Gia, Weave Seer

name: Chasm Jile

effects.name: Dreamform
effects.text: Whenever Chasm Jile is attacked, you may discard it from play. If you do, play any one d'Resh or Weave Creature from your hand with its starting energy, ignoring all costs. The played Creature replaces Chasm Jile as the defender.

flavor:
"Off to catch a chasm jile."
— d'Resh phrase meaning 'having some fun.'

name: Crushing Growth
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the chosen Creature from play, all opposing Creatures must attack on their player's next turn, if able. Only Weave Magi and Weave Shadow Magi can play Crushing Growth.
flavor:
"Nothing's more fun than just sitting around watching the grass grow!"
— Kesia, Musician

name: Empress Gia

effects.name: Act Like Gia
effects.text: If Empress Gia has no Core cards in play, draw an additional card at the end of each of your turns and your Weave Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.

errata.previous_text: If you have no Core cards in play, draw an additional card at the end of each of your turns and your Weave Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.
errata.change: Act like Gia and Fight like Nagsis have been clarified to indicate that Empress Gia is not to be included when checking to see if either Effect triggers.

effects.name: Fight Like Nagsis
effects.text: If Empress Gia has any Core cards in play, all of your Creatures may attack, even those that cannot normally attack.

errata.previous_text: If you have Core cards in play, all of your Creatures may attack, even those that cannot normally attack.
errata.change: Act like Gia and Fight like Nagsis have been clarified to indicate that Empress Gia is not to be included when checking to see if either Effect triggers.

text: Empress Gia can only play Core, Weave, and Universal cards.
flavor: "My voice is raw from speaking in falsetto all the time."

name: Grass Hyren

effects.name: Evade
effects.text: Whenever Grass Hyren is attacked, roll a die. Grass Hyren looses that much less energy in the attack.

errata.previous_text: Whenever Grass Hyren is attacked, roll a die. Grass Hyren loses that much less energy in the attack.
errata.change: The first Effect was changed from Wily to Evade.
errata.source: The Dream's End version is the MRP of Grass Hyren.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Grass Hyren attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Grass Hyren and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"If at first you don't succeed, you're probably fighting a grass hyren."
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Harmony
text: All Creatures in play with more than three energy are reduced to three energy. All Creatures in play with less than three energy are raised to three energy. Non-Weave Magi may not play Harmony.
flavor: Funny how leveling the playing field is so unfair...

name: Kesia's Flute

powers.name: Bend
powers.text: Discard one energy from any number of your Weave Creatures in play, if Kesia is your Magi, you may move move all energy to Kesia instead of discarding it. Add two energy to an equal number of other Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Dang! Tune that thing, will ya?"
— Tony Jones

name: Kesia

effects.name: Native Strength
effects.text: Kesia may not play non-Weave Spells. Weave Spells cost Kesia two less energy, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Wild Growth
effects.text: Whenever any of your Creatures in play use an Effect that specifically moves energy, add one energy to that Creature.

flavor:
"She's good. Arrogant, naive, and narrow-minded, but very good."
— Yerthe

name: Lascinth

effects.name: Reflexes
effects.text: Whenever Lascinth is attacked, it removes energy immediately, before Creatures normally remove energy.

effects.name: Hunger
effects.text: Lascinth must attack each turn, if able. Your cards may not prevent Lascinth from attacking.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Lascinth attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Lascinth and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor: A Lascinth can snap fast-moving insects out of the air, so don't be poking it with your slow-moving fingers.

name: Nyrex

effects.name: Catch
effects.text: Whenever one of your Weave or Paradwyn Creatures is specifically discarded from play by an opposing card or defeated while defending, you may place it below Nyrex.

effects.name: Release
effects.text: When Nyrex is discarded from play, play any one Creature from below Nyrex ignoring all costs and regional restrictions. Discard all other Creatures below Nyrex.

flavor: Where the Nyrex hides is not nearly so important as what the Nyrex hides.

name: Pody

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Pody attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Pody and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Backhand
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked on its controller's last turn. Discard three energy from the chosen Creature.

flavor: It's always willing to lend a hand, because that's about all it has.

name: Quallon

effects.name: Rapid Change
effects.text: Whenever you use an Effect that moves energy between two Creatures in play, you may move one additional energy.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Quallon attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Quallon and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Their version of bug zappers is all backwards."
— Tony Jones

name: Rehlya

effects.name: Counterweave
effects.text: Whenever one of your Weave Creatures is attacked, move one energy from the attacking Creature to the defending Creature before energy is removed.

flavor: "'Buncha pacifists,' they said. 'Can't fight a real war', they said. I'll say this: Cald! BRING IT!"

name: Rock Yajo

effects.name: Invulnerability
effects.text: Rock Yajo loses one less energy in attacks.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Rock Yajo is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move up to one energy between Rock Yajo and any one of your other Kybar's Teeth or Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Dream Cross
powers.text: Discard Rock Yajo from play. Choose one of your Kybar's Teeth Creatures in play and one of your Weave Creatures in play. Until the end of your next turn, each chosen Creature gains all Powers and Effects printed on the other chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Talk about a tough crowd!"
— Kesia, Musician

name: Sawgrass
text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked on its controller's last turn. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Sawgrass costs two less energy if the chosen Creature is Core.
flavor: Are you ready to find out what you're made of?

name: Scyalla
starting: [Two different non-Hyren Creatures of the same type, i.e., two different Xyxes]

powers.name: Pet Project
powers.text: Once per game, choose any non-Hyren Creature type. Until the end of the game, you may play Creatures of that type as if they were Weave, and all Creatures of the chosen type that you play are Weave Creatures instead of their original region.

errata.previous_text: Once per game, choose any one non-Hyren Creature type. Until the end of the game, all Creatures of the chosen type that you play are Weave Creatures instead of their original region.
errata.change: Clarification of Pet Project to allow you to play any Creature, regardless of original region, of the Creature type chosen with Pet Project.

flavor: "Gia's taken a real interest in teaching me how to make creatures part of the Weave."

name: Speag

effects.name: Work
effects.text: Speag cannot attack.

effects.name: Watch
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is attacked, add two energy to Speag before energy is removed.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Speag is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move up to one energy between Speag and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"After seeing these, just walking in the Weave gives me the creeps."
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Taisa

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever one of your Effects moves energy from one of your Creatures to another, you may choose to move the energy between one of the Creatures and Taisa instead.

flavor:
"I'm not certain what was worse; the Shadow Magi, or the Cald fire team
that chased them. Thankfully, Gia got rid of them both."

name: The Hunt
text: All of your Weave Creatures that can attack may attack twice this turn.
flavor:
"Hey! I thought you were supposed to be peaceful or something!"
— Valkan, Pyromancer

name: Three-Leaf Clover

effects.name: Little Lucky
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose one of your Creatures. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Lotta Lucky
effects.text: When an opposing Spell or Power affects your Magi, you may discard Three Leaf Clover from play. If you do, your cards are unaffected by the Spell or Power, and you draw a card.

flavor:
"Don't eat the clover; it's only garnish."
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Tuk Berries

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Use this Power only before your Attack Step. Choose any one Weave Creature in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. That Creature cannot attack this turn.

flavor:
"Weave has ways to make you tuk."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Tweave

effects.name: Surprise
effects.text: If you draw Tweave during your Draw Step, you may reveal it to your opponent and immediately play it with three energy, without paying any costs.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Tweave attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Tweave and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Tweave.
flavor:
"Okay, I think we're safe. Just don't touch anything."
— Zet, to Korg

name: Vuryip

effects.name: Random Change
effects.text: Whenever Vuryip attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, draw a card.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Vuryip attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Vuryip and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

text: Weave Shadow Magi may play Vuryip.
flavor: If a tree falls in a forest and no one's around to hear it, a vuryip will probably knock another one down.

name: Weave Mind
text: Defeat your current Magi. You may keep your current Relics and Creatures in play. Reveal your next Magi with his or her starting energy. You may get the new Magi's starting cards as normal. Non-Weave Magi may not play this Spell.
flavor: When Weave Magi change their minds, they really change their minds.

name: Weave Seed
text: Play Weave Seed only before your Attack step. Choose a Weave Creature. Add seven energy to the chosen Creature. That Creature can attack an additional time this turn and must attack if able.
flavor:
"That's-a one-a spicy weave-a seed!"
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Weggit

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Weggit attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Weggit and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Whispering Winds
powers.text: Discard Weggit from play. Draw a card for each Weave Relic you have in play.

errata.previous_text: Discard Weggit from play. Draw one card for each Relic you have in play.
errata.change: Wispering Winds works with only Weave Relics.

flavor: It dreams a lot of relic lore, and it'll share its knowledge for the chance to dream some more.

name: Wence the Wanderer

powers.name: Wence is Here
powers.text: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is a Naroom Spell or a Creature with the Effect "Weave", reveal it to all players and place it into your hand. Otherwise, discard it or return it to the top of your deck.

flavor:
"If you're a Weave Magi, then I'm Nagsis."
— Gia, to Wence

name: Wence's Travelog

effects.name: Wence Was Here
effects.text: During your Energize step, if you have a Naroom Creature and a different Weave Creature in play, add two energy to your Magi.

flavor:
"I'm not even supposed to be here today!"
— Wence, Adventurer

name: Yajo

effects.name: Timid
effects.text: Yajo cannot attack.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Yajo is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Yajo and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play that attacked this turn. Add three energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Mmmm... crunchy!"
— Korg

name: Zassyfer

effects.name: Warning
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Weave Creatures is attacked, add one energy to that Creature before energy is removed.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Zassyfer attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Zassyfer and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor:
"It was terrible! Hundreds of 'em, zassyfers everywhere! They ate all my
flutter yups!"
— Ora, Shieldmaiden

name: Zaya's Bow

powers.name: Long Shot
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. That Creature must attack on its controller's next turn, if able. If your Magi is Zaya, all other Creatures controlled by that player must also attack on his or her next turn, if able.

flavor:
"I see him..."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Beam of Light
text: Choose up to two Relics, Spells, and/or Creatures in play with two or less energy. Discard the chosen cards from play. All ongoing Powers and Effects of those cards are canceled.
flavor: For hitting everything.

name: Equilibrate
text: All Creatures in play with more than their starting energy are reduced to their starting energy.
flavor:
"Aaah! Aaah! Giant Eebit! Run! Run—" *POP*
"Hey, look at the cute little fuzzball..."
— Salafy, Woodskeeper

name: Gauntlets of Colossal Power

powers.name: Whole Lotta Glove
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Gauntlets of Colossal Power from play. The next time the chosen Creature attacks, it removes twelve energy instead of its current energy.

flavor:
"One size hits all!"
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Inhibitor Band

effects.name: Reprise
effects.text: When you play Inhibitor Band, discard all other Universal Relics in play.

errata.previous_text: When you play Inhibitor Band, return all other Universal Relics to their owners' hands.
errata.change: Reprise discards all Universal cards instead of returning then to hand. Universal Lock has been altered to not allow any Universal Relics from coming into play while Inhibitor Band is in play.

effects.name: Universal Lock
effects.text: Players cannot play Universal Relics.

errata.previous_text: Players cannot play Universal Relics from their hands.
errata.change: Reprise discards all Universal cards instead of returning then to hand. Universal Lock has been altered to not allow any Universal Relics from coming into play while Inhibitor Band is in play.

flavor:
"Secret powers need secrets, and they're not secrets if everyone knows
about them."
— Gia, Seer

name: Rayje's Sword

effects.name: Piercing
effects.text: Spells, Powers, and Effects do not reduce energy loss.

flavor: Rayje's legendary sword has been nicknamed "Conscience", because there's no escaping it.

name: Staff of Keepers

effects.name: Finder
effects.text: When you play Staff of Keepers, choose any one region other than your Magi's region. You ignore regional penalties for Creatures of the chosen region. If your Magi is a Keeper, also add one energy to each Creature you play from the chosen region.

flavor:
"I'm welcomed pretty much wherever I go. As long as I don't bring a bunch
of critters with me."
— Eidon, Keeper

name: Ainjer

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ainjer loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grr
powers.text: Discard Ainjer from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature for each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Opposing cards do not affect Grr when it is used and cannot alter the amount of energy discarded by Grr. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.

flavor:
"It's comin' down, and we're all going with it!"
— Golthub, Royal Toady

name: Ainjer Swarm
text: If you have at least four Bograth Creatures in play, all opposing Creatures in play lose one energy.
flavor:
"The creatures here are as persistent as the stench."
— Boria, Elder

name: Baa

effects.name: Hordes
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, you may discard one energy from Baa to draw an additional card at the end of the turn.

flavor: "I look for things. Things to make us grow."

name: Bleph

effects.name: Bleph Fu
effects.text: Whenever Bleph attacks a Creature, before energy is removed, add one energy to Bleph for each of the defending player's Creatures.

flavor:
"It may only be able to reach to your kneecaps, but believe me, that's
enough."
— Yricho

name: Bog Wellisk

effects.name: Dream Draft
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Relic, if your Magi is Bograth or Orothe, you may immediately play Bog Wellisk from your hand, ignoring all costs. You may play one Bog Wellisk in this way per turn.

flavor:
"What you talk'n 'bout, wellisk?"
— Bria, Vault Curator

name: Crown of Grath

effects.name: Mostly Regal Presence
effects.text: All non-Core, non-Bograth Creatures in play lose one energy, before energy is removed, whenever they attack one of your Bograth Creatures.

flavor:
"It fits me like a glove!"
"Korg, you wear it on your head."
— Korg and Zet

name: Eryss

effects.name: Discordia
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opposing Magi plays a non-Universal Creature not of their Magi's region, you may choose and discard one of that Magi's Creatures from play.

flavor: "Korg, Korg, he's our man, if he can't do it, GREAT!"

name: Glablit

effects.name: Dream Blur
effects.text: All of your Bograth Creatures in play are also Core. All of your Core Creatures in play are also Bograth.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Glablit loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"I'm #2. I try harder."
— Golthub, Royal Toady

name: Golthub

powers.name: Mire
powers.text: Choose any one region. Defeat Golthub. Discard all non-Magi cards of the chosen region from play.

text: Golthub can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.
flavor: "It looks good to be the king."

name: Grahnna

effects.name: Share
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, choose any one Bograth Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Transform
effects.text: When you reveal Grahnna, if your previous Magi was Wiep, place any one Bograth card from your discard pile into your hand.

flavor:
"Did you bring enough for everybody?"
— Phlouk, Grand Supreme Ringsmith

name: Great Throne Mushrooms

effects.name: Enduring Renewal
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is discarded from play, you may discard one energy from your Magi to draw a card.

flavor:
"Great Throne Mushrooms only grow in this one place, and only in this
shape. It almost seems they like being sat on..."
— Ninibom, Universal Greeter

name: Gremble

powers.name: Parasitic Growth
powers.text: Discard Gremble from play. Discard your hand and draw three cards.

flavor:
"Why? I'll tell you why! We're attacking to cause dis...ray! And to break
things!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Warlike Emperor of Great
   and Mighty Bograth

name: Gwaeg

effects.name: Vile Herald
effects.text: Bograth Magi and Core Magi can play both Core Creatures and Bograth Creatures, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: If Gwaeg is defeated while defending, place it into your hand instead of your discard pile.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Gwaeg.
flavor:
"Korg, you have much more in common with these people than you think."
— Zet

name: Jile

effects.name: Vitalize
effects.text: All of your Jiles and Bograth Creatures in play gain ENERGIZE: 1.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Jile loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor: Jiles led Bograth's invasion of Paradwyn, scouting the opposition for their masters.

name: Looph

effects.name: Regroup
effects.text: If Looph attacks and is defeated, you may immediately play a Bograth Creature from your hand, paying all costs.

flavor:
"Eryss went loophie a long time ago."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Mist Hyren

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Mist Hyren's cost is reduced by one for each of your Creatures in play.
Mist Hyren can only be played during your Play Creatures Step.

flavor: It's attracted to power. And, apparently, its tastes are not all that discriminating.

name: Muck Vinoc

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Muck Vinoc loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grapple
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with seven or more energy. Discard Muck Vinoc and the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"The bigger they are, the deeper they sink."
— Blygt, Magnificent Remembering Guy

name: Ninibom
text: If your defeated Magi are Baa, Wiep, and Grahnna, in that order, you can play Ninibom as a fourth Magi. You do not lose the game until Ninibom is defeated. If Ninibom is not your fourth Magi, increase Ninibom's energize to seven. Ninibom can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.
flavor: "A boot to the head is a greeting that everyone understands."

name: Olabra

effects.name: Resilience
effects.text: Your Creatures cannot be reduced below one energy by opposing Spells and Powers.

flavor: "You can't bury the mud."

name: Ooze Arboll

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ooze Arboll loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Amplify
powers.text: Discard Ooze Arboll from play. Add one energy to each of your Bograth Creatures in play.

flavor:
"Hey, now you've hurt its feelings. Give it a hug so it'll know you still
care."
— Olabra, The Really Greatest Elder Ever

name: Phlouk

powers.name: Ring Testing
powers.text: Play a Bograth Creature from your hand, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot attack this turn. At the end of your turn, discard energy from Phlouk equal to the Creature's starting energy. If you don't have enough energy on Phlouk, discard the Creature from play.

flavor:
"Not only is he supreme, he even makes the rings really round!"
— Blygt, Magnificent Remembering Guy

name: Pyder

effects.name: Leadership
effects.text: When you play Pyder, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder. Whenever you energize, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder.

effects.name: Summoning
effects.text: Whenever you play a Creature, discard energy from Pyder to play the Creature. All of your Bograth Creatures cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"I'm tired. Why don't you do all the work?"
— Korg, to his first pyder

name: Quido Swarm

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Quido Swarm's starting energy is equal to the number of your other Paradwyn and Bograth Creatures in play.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, restore Quido Swarm to its starting energy.

flavor:
"Them's good eatin'! You just open your mouth and run around!"
— Grahnna, to Korg

name: Rous

effects.name: Myth
effects.text: Rous cannot be attacked. If all of your Creatures in play are Rous, discard Rous from play.

powers.name: Hit
powers.text: Choose one opposing Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Rous.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Rous.
flavor:
"What about the rous?"
— Zannah, to Wence

name: Slarnath

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: If you have four or more Bograth Creatures in play, draw a card.

flavor:
"It bosses a whole mob."
— Baa, Grand High Summoner

name: Slime Stone

powers.name: Shriveled Dreams
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Creature has a starting energy of one instead of its normal starting energy.

powers.name: Grand Nightmares
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Creature has a starting energy of ten instead of its normal starting energy.

flavor: It changes dreams to delusions, and vice versa.

name: Spirit Drain
text: Choose any one player. Discard energy from the chosen player's Magi equal to the number of cards in that player's hand.
flavor: The more you know, the lower you go.

name: Swamp Hyren

effects.name: Nightmare Gate
effects.text: All of your other Core and Bograth cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

text: Core Magi may play Swamp Hyren.
flavor:
"Do you smell something?"
— Wence, Naroom Adventurer

name: Treepsh

effects.name: Watchful
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, you may discard Treepsh from play. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

powers.name: Supply
powers.text: Discard Treepsh from play. Draw a card. If you have more Creatures in play than any one opponent of your choice, draw an additional card.

flavor: They're very common along the border between the two regions, hence they always get caught in the middle.

name: Umbu

effects.name: Mud Clod
effects.text: When Umbu is discarded from play, choose a Relic in play. Attach Umbu to the chosen Relic; as long as Umbu is attached, it cannot be discarded by having zero energy and is unaffected by cards that affect Creatures. None of the chosen Relic's Powers or Effects can be used. At the beginning of each of your turns, discard one energy from that Relic's Magi. When the Relic is discarded, discard Umbu.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Umbu loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"Dangit! It's all gunked up again!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Hygienic Emperor of Great
   and Mighty Bograth

name: Vard

effects.name: Surge
effects.text: As you play Vard, if your Magi is Bograth and any opponent has more Creatures in play than you (not counting this card), ignore Vard's cost.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Vard loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor: Ever hungry, vards are drawn to concentrations of dream energy.

name: Vard Stampede
text: Choose any one Magi in play. If you have at least four Bograth Creatures in play, discard all of the chosen Magi's Relics and Spells from play.
flavor: Liriel looked at the destruction all around. "Tomorrow..." she said, "will be another day."

name: Wiep

effects.name: Transform
effects.text: When you reveal Wiep, if your previous Magi was Baa, place any one Bograth card from your discard pile into your hand.

powers.name: Power Drain
powers.text: Choose any Power on an opposing Creature. Move energy equal to the cost of the chosen Power from that Creature to Wiep.

flavor: "Can I borrow your sleeve?"

name: Yog's Maul

powers.name: Thump Thump Wham!
powers.text: Discard one of your Bograth Creatures from play. Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Discard energy from the chosen Creature equal to the number of your Bograth Creatures in play.

flavor:
"When you have a big hammer, everything looks like your thumb. Err, a
nail."
— Yog, Toady in Waiting

name: Zungg

powers.name: Gnaw
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Zungg.

text: Only Bograth or Core Magi can play Zungg.
flavor:
"To sleep, perchance to dream up something THAT WILL EAT THESE THINGS!"
— Emlob, Obsessive Detailer

name: Zungg Swarm
text: Choose any one Magi in play. If you have at least seven Bograth Creatures and seven Core Creatures in play, discard energy equal to the number of your Bograth Creatures in play from all of the chosen Magi's Creatures.
flavor:
"They eat too much, and don't leave enough for me."
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Ever-Hungering Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Agram's Plaything

powers.name: Puppet Strings
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, Agram's Plaything changes to a Creature. Add one energy to Agram's Plaything whenever it becomes a Creature. If your Magi is Agram, add two additional energy to it. Whenever Agram's Plaything becomes a Relic, discard all energy from it.

flavor:
"I think about Une whenever I play with it."
— Agram

name: Agram's Staff

effects.name: Mastery
effects.text: Your Shadow Magi may play cards from their original region, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Control
effects.text: If your Magi is Agram, you may play any cards that specifically say that they can be played by a Shadow Magi. Agram does not pay a regional penalty for non-Core cards.

flavor:
"It's sooooo good! .. what's it do again?"
— Korg

name: Ashio

effects.name: Weave Twist
