effects.text: All cards that specifically reference Core instead reference their own region. If a card is of multiple regions, you choose which of those regions to reference.

flavor: "Everything is part of the whole..."

name: Chaos Flugg

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core and Weave Spells and Powers do not affect Chaos Flugg.

powers.name: Dark Demanding
powers.text: Discard Chaos Flugg from play. Discard all Core and all Weave Creatures from play.

text: Weave Magi can play Chaos Flugg.
flavor:
"Curses! How does Gia always know where we are? This place is no longer
safe for us."
— Ashio

name: Corrupt
text: Choose any one Magi in play. Attack Corrupt to the chosen Magi. If the chosen Magi is discarded from play, discard Corrupt from play. When a Creature is played by any Magi, discard Corrupt from play. The Creature played becomes a Core Creature instead of its original region, and your Magi gains control of that Creature.
flavor: Give yourself to the darkness.

name: Crushing Darkness
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the cosen Creature from play, play it as a Core Creature with half of its starting energy, rounded up, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot attack or use any of its Powers this turn. Shadow Magi cannot play this Spell.
flavor:
"Do not worry about Naroom's allies, for I am fear. Uh... here."
— Hrada, Dark Ruler

name: Dagok

effects.name: Dream Inversion
effects.text: Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that discard energy from Dagok instead add an equal amount of energy. Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that add energy to Dagok instead discard an equal amount of energy.

text: Naroom Magi can play Dagok. Naroom Shadow Magi can play Dagok for one less energy.
flavor:
"It hurts so good."
— Warrada, The Shadow Empress

name: Dark Ayebaw

powers.name: Implode
powers.text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard Dark Ayebaw from play, and discard X Core and/or Arderial cards from your hand. Discard X+2 energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Ayebaw.
flavor: O'Qua was surprised to find the Core using a weapon from her own arsenal.

name: Dark Portents
text: Choose a player. Reveal the top five cards of the chosen player's deck. Add one energy to your Magi for each Creature revealed. You may discard one of the revealed cards. Put the remaining cards back on the chosen player's deck in the same order.
flavor:
"I've got a bad feeling about this."
— Hrada, Dark Lord

name: Darkbreed Hyren

powers.name: Subvert
powers.text: Choose any one hyren in play. Gain control of the chosen hyren. That hyren may not attack this turn.

flavor: One hyren to bring them all, and in the darkness bind them.

name: Dream Rift
text: Take all Creature cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your decK. Draw three cards. Arderial Magi may play Dream Rift.
flavor: The dam broke and the dreams flooded through.

name: Dryte Fiend

effects.name: Condemn
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your opponent's turns, you may choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of that opponent's turn, each time the chosen Creature loses energy as a result of Powers, Spells, or attacks, discard three energy from that Creature. Cald Magi may play Dryte Fiend.

errata.previous_text: At the beginning of each of your opponent's turns, you may choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of that opponent's turn, each time the chosen Creature loses energy from Powers, Spells, or attacks, it loses three additional energy.
errata.change: Clarification that energy costs to use Powers does not trigger Condemn.

text: Cald Magi may play Dryte Fiend.
flavor:
"He has been marked. Let him come, if he dares."
— Morag, the Executor

name: Ebony Mirror

effects.name: Grim Reflection
effects.text: At the beginning of each player's Draw step, if that player has more cards in his or her hand than any other player, that player draws one less card this turn. While Ebony Mirror is in play, all players draw at least one card during their Draw step.

flavor:
"I don't like looking in a mirror that stares back."
— Chur

name: Fiend of Furoks

effects.name: Affinity
effects.text: Fiend of Furoks ignores regional penalties and restrictions when playing Furoks.

effects.name: Reconstruct
effects.text: Once per turn, you can play a Furok from your discard pile as if it were in your hand, paying all costs.

flavor: "It's ALIIIIVE! ... Again!"

name: Gia Pet

effects.name: Impede
effects.text: All players draw one less card during their Draw Step. Only one copy of this Effect may prevent players from drawing cards.

errata.previous_text: All players draw one less card during their Draw Step.
errata.change: A limit as to how many copies of Implede can affect all players.

powers.name: Power Siphon
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Spell in play. Gia Pet gains energy equal to the energy cost of the chosen Spell.

text: Weave Magi can play Gia Pet. Non-Core, non-Weave Magi cannot play Gia Pet.
flavor: Gia thought it a fair trade for safe passage through the Weave.

name: Gragling

effects.name: Melancholy
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures loses energy from an opposing Spell or Power, add one energy to Gragling.

effects.name: Lonely
effects.text: If you have another Creature in play, Gragling gains 'ENERGIZE: 1'.

flavor:
"Little grag lost, in a world all alone. Poor thing; all this happiness is
bringing him down."
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Grubble

powers.name: Dreamform
powers.text: Choose any one other Grubble in play. Discard both this Grubble and the chosen Grubble from play. Search your deck for any one Creature and play that Creature with its starting energy.

flavor: The merging is complete!

name: Gumph

effects.name: Night's Shade
effects.text: Once per turn, when a Creature is discarded from play, choose a Creature. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

text: Naroom Magi can play Gumph.
flavor:
"Run through the forest, gumph!"
— Sperri, Fiend of Furoks

name: Harban

powers.name: Browbeat
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play with only one energy. Gain control of the chosen Creature.

text: Arderial Magi may play Harban.
flavor:
"Today I steal your dreams, tomorrow I steal the sky."
— Harror, Nightstalker

name: Harror, Nightstalker

effects.name: Starfire
effects.text: Magi can retrieve, but not play, their starting cards. Your cards cannot force other players to discard cards from their hands.
If any opposing Magi are Core, decrease Harror, Nightstalker's energy by two.

flavor: "You may think you are safe now, but remember: night falls everywhere."

name: Haunt
text: Choose an opposing Creature. Attach Haunt to the chosen Creature. When that Creature is discarded, play it instead, ignoring all costs and regional restrictions. The Creature becomes Core instead of its original region(s). The Creature cannot attack the turn you play it.
flavor:
"Weebolicious!"
— Hrada, Dark Lord

name: Koil

effects.name: Nightmare
effects.text: When you play Koil, choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Re-Koil
effects.text: If Koil is defeated in any attack, after it is discarded from play, choose any one player's discard pile. Shuffle the chosen discard pile into its owner's deck.

flavor:
"Those who survive the nightmares it brings do not survive the nightmares
it brings back."
— Togoth, the Guardian

name: Korg & Zet

effects.name: Korg
effects.text: Korg & Zet may play no more than two cards each turn and may not play Relics.

effects.name: Zet
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, once per attack, one of your other Creatures may join in the attack. The defending Creature's player chooses one of your attacking Creatures to lose energy in the attack.

text: Korg & Zet count as two Magi for deck construction.
flavor:
"ZET!!! I have a plan so cunning, you could brush your teeth with it!"
"YOU?! Cunning?"

name: Maelstrom
text:
Discard X energy from each opposing Magi in play.
Orothe Magi may play Maelstrom.
flavor: For hitting the dreamers instead of their dreams.

name: Morag

powers.name: Theft
powers.text: (X) Choose any one opposing Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic for X turns, beginning with the current turn. At the end of X turns, or if Morag is defeated, return the chosen Relic to its owner's hand.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic for your next X turns. At the end of X turns, or if Morag is defeated, return that Relic to its owner's hand.
errata.change: Theft only works on opposing Relics. Clarification as too the Relic's theft duration.

flavor: What power! It just gets stronger every time I use it!

name: Nightmare Hyren

powers.name: Horrible Dreams
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. The chosen Creature gains 'Effect — Toss and Turn: At the beginning of your turn, discard one energy from your Magi and each of your Creatures in play. This Creature removes two less energy from Core Creatures in attacks.'

flavor:
"Why'd you have to dream up that one? It... it scares me."
— Qwade, to Harror

name: Qwade

powers.name: Leech
powers.text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Discard X energy from one of the chosen Creatures. Add X energy to the other chosen Creature.

flavor: "You think this is the real Qwade? ...It is!"

name: Rabid Wasperine

effects.name: Counterattack
effects.text: Immediately after one of your cards is attacked, you may play Rabid Wasperine, paying all costs. If your Magi is Naroom Shadow, add one energy to Rabid Wasperine when you play it. Rabid Wasperine immediately attacks the opposing Creature that just attacked.

text: Naroom Magi can play Rabid Wasperine.
flavor:
"Oh, brother darling, look. It's drooling on the carpet again...!"
— Warrade, to Hrada

name: Secrets of the Book

powers.name: Secrets
powers.text: (3) Choose any one opposing player. The chosen player reveals his or her hand to all players. Draw one card for each Creature revealed, and one card for each non-Creature Naroom card revealed, to a maximum of four.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one opposing player. The chosen player reveals his or her hand to all players. Draw one card for each Creature revealed, and one card for each non-Creature Naroom card revealed.
errata.change: A maximum limit of four cards can be drawn through Secrets.
errata.affects: Dream's End, Naroom/Core GenCon 2001 Preview Deck

flavor: Within the book, Evu keeps the secrets to the heart and soul of Naroom. Now the very forest may wither and die.

name: Severos

powers.name: Mind Dredge
powers.text: Choose a Creature in an opponent's discard pile. Play the chosen Creature, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties. Pay all costs from Severos instead of your Magi. Use this Power only after the Attack step. When that Creature leaves play, discard Severos from play.

text: Orothe Magi can play Severos
flavor:
"Welcome to the pah-ty!"
— Qwade

name: Shadow Bones

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature in play. Discard Shadow Bones from play. Add energy to the chosen Creature equal to that Creature's starting energy.

flavor:
"Works better than dream balm on them nightmares.
But ye probably couldn't stand the taste of it."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Shadow Cloak

powers.name: Protection
powers.text: (2) Each of your Core Creatures currently in play cannot be affected by non-Core Spells and Powers until the end of your next turn. You may not use Protection during your next turn.

errata.previous_text: Each of your Core Creatures in play is not affected by non-Core Spells and Powers until the end of your next turn. You may not use Shadow Cloak on your next turn.
errata.change: The Power Protection, and not the card Shadow Cloak, can not be used on the following turn.

flavor: A night's gown.

name: The Real Qwade

effects.name: Leech
effects.text: At the beginning of your Play Creatures step, you may discard two energy from The Real Qwade. If you do, until the end of your turn, whenever you play a Creature, choose another Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to the Creature you just played.

text: The Real Qwade can be in a Magi stack with "Qwade". When you reveal The Real Qwade, defeat him if your previous defeated Magi was not "Qwade".
flavor: "I trust no one. Not even myself."

name: Trask

effects.name: Lifetap
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to one or more Creatures in play, add one energy to Trask.

text: Orothe Magi may play Trask.
flavor:
It's like an alligator
with scales and teeth and claws,
It's like a Coral Hyren,
but not afraid of Cawhs.

name: Turn
text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. X is the chosen Creature's starting energy. The chosen Creature becomes Core and you gain control of it. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.
flavor: "Agram will show you the true nature of power. He is your master now."

name: Zet

effects.name: Good Riddance
effects.text: If Korg is in any player's defeated Magi pile, add three energy to Zet's starting energy.

powers.name: Treachery
powers.text: Zet gains control of any one Creature in play. X is the amount of energy on that Creature. If the Creature is a non-Core Creature, it loses one energy. The Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor: "Korg, this is the perfect chance for us to get in there and cause some disarray."

name: Agovo

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: Draw one card.

flavor: "To protect its spores, the Great Mushroom of Knowledge gives them wings."

name: Amulet of Ombor

powers.name: Energy Boost
powers.text: Roll one die. 1, 2, or 3 = Your opponents add one energy to each of their Creatures in play. 4 or 5 - Choose any one Creature in play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. 6 = Chose any one Creature in play. Add four energy to the chosen Creature.

errata.previous_text:
Roll one die.
1, 2, or 3 = Your opponents add one energy
to each of their Creatures in play.
4 or 5 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add two energy to the chosen Creature.
6 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add four energy to the chosen Creature.
errata.change: Adding reminder text on Amulet of Ombor to allow you to play one Gate to Ombor from your hand or deck (Gate to Ombor's Effect - Talisman).

flavor: Motash watched as the Grag bore down on her crippled hyren. She clasped the amulet with a silent prayer...

name: Cave Rudwot

effects.name: Defense
effects.text: If Cave Rudwot is attacked, add two energy to it before energy is removed.

flavor: Don't take on a Rudwot in its home, unless you like getting hurt.

name: Celebrated Hero

powers.name: Pump You Up
powers.text: Choose a Burrowed Creature or a Creature with the Effect "Invulnerability". Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy. Skip your Draw step this turn.

flavor:
"Why do you keep asking me that? Of course I can dig it!"
— Gogor, to Yaki

name: Cleansing
text: Name any one non-Magi Core cards. For the rest of this game, all cards of the name are Kybar's Teeth or Underneath, your choice, instead of Core.
flavor:
"There is good in her, I can sense it."
— Ulk, to Grej

name: Trogovo

effects.name: Inspire
effects.text: Draw two additional cards during your Draw step. Reduce your Magi's Energize by two.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, any Core Magi may discard three energy to discard Trogovo.

flavor:
"Great minds think a ... think a ... errrr..."
— Myka

name: Crystal Arboll

powers.name: Healing Light
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Crystal Arboll from play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. If the chosen Creature is Underneath, add two additional energy.

flavor: The Cave Rudwot turned to face him, and Wence took a step back. The lizard's eye were taking on the glow of the fallen Arboll.

name: Crystal Parmalag

effects.name: Anti-Magic
effects.text: Crystal Parmalag is not affected by opposing Spells, Powers, or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play. Your Spells, Powers, and Effects may not prevent Crystal Parmalag from losing energy.

flavor: It's like a colossus, but with less maintenance.

name: Digging Goggles

effects.name: Tunneling Attack
effects.text: Your burrowed Creatures may attack as normal.

flavor:
Zed snorted. "You and what army?"
That's when he noticed the rumbling under his feet.

name: Fossik, Underkeeper

powers.name: Strengthen
powers.text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard a card from your hand to add two energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor: "No sooner has Naroom fallen, than Core creatures begin invading us from above."

name: Gate to Ombor

effects.name: Talisman
effects.text: If you have an Amulet of Ombor in play, you can play Gate to Ombor from your hand or from your deck, ignoring all costs. Add one to all die rolls you make for Amulet of Ombor (die rolls of 6 remain 6).
Gate to Ombor cannot be discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Relics from play. Discard Gate to Ombor from play if your Magi is not an Underneath Magi.

powers.name: Guard
powers.text: Search your deck for one of your Magi's starting Creatures. Play that Creature, reducing its cost by five energy, to a minimum of zero. That Creature can never attack.

flavor:
"There's no place like home."
— Gruk, Underwarden

name: Ghost Bwisp

effects.name: Glow
effects.text: All of your Creatures can attack while burrowed.

flavor:
Strag watched the Core forces fan out through the cavern the bwisps had
conveniently prepared. "My lord," he said to Motash, "the weebos are in
the pot."
The Underlord smiled grimly. "Cook 'em."

name: Giant Parmalag

powers.name: Withdraw
powers.text: Giant Parmalag cannot be attacked until after your next turn.

flavor:
"Going Parmalag"
— Underneath expression meaning "on the defensive"

name: Gogor's Spade

effects.name: Paydirt
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, draw a card.

flavor:
"I ♥ my ♠."
— motto carved on Gogor's wall.

name: Granas

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: On all opponents' turns, Granas is burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Pummel
effects.text: Whenever Granas attacks a Creature, Granas removes an additional energy from the defending Creature.

flavor:
"They're like magma. They move slowly underground, then way too fast on
the surface."
— Gyrg

name: Gyrg

effects.name: Digging Mastery
effects.text: Each of your Underneath Creatures in play loses no more than two energy each time it is attacked.

flavor:
"What we need is a bigger shovel!"
— All-High King Korg, Magnificent, Illustrious, Excavating Emperor of
   Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Hidden Door
text: Search your deck for up to two Underneath Relics and place them into your hand.
flavor:
"Not all of your tunnels have to be dug through the dirt..."
— Trug, Engineer

name: Impact
text: Choose any one of your Creatures and any one Magi in play. Discard twice as much energy as the chosen Creature has from the chosen Magi. Discard the chosen Creature from play.
flavor:
K.O.
2 Hit Special Move Finish
25000 Points

name: Jore

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Add one energy to each of your other burrowed Creatures.

flavor: It gives to the soil, and the soil gives back tenfold.

name: Muggum

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: Discard Muggum from play. Choose any two Bograth and/or Underneath Creatures in play. Until the end of your next turn, both chosen Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"Cover me!"
— Strag, Underwatcher

name: Myka

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Myka loses no more than two energy from each opposing Spell, Power or attack.

flavor: "You shovel real good, Gogor. But that doesn't make you a superhero."

name: Ormagon

powers.name: Devastate
powers.text: Discard all non-Underneath Creatures from play.

flavor: Big ba-da-boom.

name: Parmalag

powers.name: Shield
powers.text: Parmalag is prevented from losing any energy from attacks until the end of your turn.

flavor: Protected in their rock-hard shells, they attack by rolling at high speed toward their targets.

name: Phosphor Hyren

effects.name: Light Barrier
effects.text: Opposing Creatures with less energy than Phosphor Hyren cannot attack your non-Hyren Underneath Creatures. Phosphor Hyren cannot be burrowed.

flavor:
"The light makes the creche-lings feel safe, and he's great at parties!"
— Ulk, Underwarden

name: Pylofuf

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Pylofuf is burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponents' Spells and Powers.

text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Pylofuf.
flavor: The pylofuf is also known as 'porkuslime' for obvious reasons. It doesn't dig through soil. It just oozes through the gaps.

name: Radget

powers.name: Refresh
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. Add two additional energy if the chosen Creature is a Parmalag.

flavor: I'm as thick-skinned as any of my pets.

name: Resonate
text: Choose any or all of the following: Choose any one Relic in play. Discard the chosen Relic from play. OR Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. OR Choose any one Magi in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Magi. For each action chosen, Resonate's cost is increased by one.
flavor: For hitting anything.

name: Sorrowing Ogar

effects.name: Vile Memories
effects.text: Sorrowing Ogar can play all Core cards ignoring regional penalties and restrictions. Core cards that Sorrowing Ogar plays are considered Underneath instead of Core.

effects.name: Regret
effects.text: All Core cards cost opposing Magi one additional energy to play.

text: Sorrowing Ogar may not be played in a deck with any Core Magi.
flavor: "I— I thought it was all a dream! What have I done?"

name: Striped Korrit

effects.name: Pack Defense
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is attacked, Striped Korrit may defend with that Creature. Striped Korrit loses no energy in the attack, but removes energy from the attacker as normal.

flavor:
"Trouble? No problem; I've got the korrit for it."
— Ulk, Underwarden

name: Thunderquake
text: Choose any number of Creatures in play. Discard a total of X energy in any combination from the chosen Creatures. X cannot be more than 10.
flavor:
"Oh no it wasn't! It was shaking worse under MY feet!"
— Zet, to Korg

name: Trygar

effects.name: Avenger
effects.text: If Trygar is defeated, at the end of the current turn you may play any Creature from your hand. Play three energy on the Creature instead of its normal starting energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, the Creature played is unaffected by your opponents' cards.

flavor: And to Korremar, who helped me write this will, I leave... not a boot to the head, but a rabid bisiwog, to be placed in his trousers...

name: Trygar's Will

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When your Magi is defeated, choose an opponent and two of that player's non-Magi cards in play. The chosen player chooses and discards one of the chosen cards.

text: Korremar can play Trygar's Will.
flavor: "And I leave all of my animite to the people of Vash Naroom, so they can afford to move somewhere decent!"

name: Tunnel Hyren

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Your other Underneath Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and each lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponent's Spells and Powers.

flavor:
"Its kingdom is under this world."
— Orwin, Naroom Elder

name: Tunneler's Boots

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the end of each of your turns, add one energy to each burrowed Creature in play.

flavor:
"Even without magic, they provide great traction
to anchor your feet while digging."
— Gruk, Underfarmer

name: Unmake
text: Choose a Creature with X energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Discard one energy from each Creature in play of the same type as the discarded Creature.
flavor:
"Underneath. Loathe it or level it."
— Morag, Executioner

name: Urhail

effects.name: Tainted Dreams
effects.text: Your Magi may play Core Spells, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Urhail, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.
flavor:
"I had the strangest dream last night..."
— Ogar

name: Ring of Secrets

effects.name: Tinker
effects.text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. You cannot choose a Creature more than once per turn with Tinker.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.
errata.change: Each Creature is affected by Tinker once a turn.

flavor:
"Me mates and I guard the Vault of Science, and
the Vault returns the favor."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Robes of the Ages

effects.name: Ancestral Favor
effects.text: Your Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"Ye can hear the voices of all the wizards who've worn
it before. Ye get to draw on their leftover power, but I tell
ye, matey, it gets creepy."
— Blu, Vault Guardian

name: Book of Ages

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: (2) Draw 1 card.

errata.previous_text: Draw one card.
errata.change: The drawing of a card with Lore now occurs in either P/R/S Step rather than at the end of turn.
errata.source: The Unlimited Version is the MRP of Book of Ages.

flavor:
"The more knowledge you gain, the better prepared you are."
— Evu, Naroom Loremaster

name: Tomorrow's Jewel

effects.text: Whenever an opposing card forces you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the opposing card does nothing.

errata.previous_text: Whenever an opposing Power, Spell or Effect forces you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.
errata.change: Tomorrow's Jewel may no longer be discarded from play or stolen.

effects.name: Lore
effects.text: Once during your Draw step, after you draw, you may discard one card from your hand. If you do, draw one card.

errata.previous_text: Once during your Draw Step, after you draw, you may discard one card from your hand. If you do, draw one card.
errata.change: Tomorrow's Jewel may no longer be discarded from play or stolen.

text: If an opposing card causes you to discard Tomorrow's Jewel from your hand or from play, you my play it instead.
flavor: You never know what tomorrow holds.

name: Cactus Hyren

effects.name: Pierce
effects.text:
As Cactus Hyren attacks a Creature with six or more energy,
remove three energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"Never play a game of tag with one of these guys."
-- Drajan, Elder

name: Colossit

effects.name: Spare Parts
effects.text: Your Collosus and Construct cards cost one less to play, to a minimum of one.

text: Colossit may not be chosen by an Effect, Power or Spell that could cause it to change controllers.
flavor:
"A colossit is more than just a handy mechanic, it does windows too!"
— Tuku

name: Sunbeam's End
text: Choose a Creature and add one energy to it. If you played a copy of Starlight's Genesis this turn, you may remove two energy from your Magi to add two extra energy to that Creature.
flavor: As the last rays of the sun fell upon the Rayalon, it rose from the ground, growing in stature. The Chaos Jile took a step back in fear.

name: Giant Kelthet

powers.name: Flamebath
powers.text: Remove three energy from each non-Cald Creature and Magi. Your Powers, Spells and Effects may not increase the amount of energy removed by Flamebath.

flavor: When Lanyx suggested a hot bath to Grega, he got much more than he bargained for.

name: Crushing Heat
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the chosen Creature from play, its Magi cannot use any of his or her Powers or Effects or any Powers or Effects on his or her Relics until the start of your next turn. Only Cald Magi and Cald Shadow Magi can play Crushing Heat.
flavor:
"No, trust me, it is just you."
— Valkan, Pyromancer and former bridge-builder

name: Jingjack

effects.name: Spring Out
effects.text: When your magi is attacked directly, you may play Jingjack from your hand, paying all costs. Jingjack replaces your magi in the attack.

effects.name: Spring Back
effects.text: If Jingjack is defeated in an attack, it becomes a relic instead of being discarded.

powers.name: Spring Forth
powers.text: Add three energy to Jingjack. If Jingjack is a relic, it becomes a creature. At the end of the turn, discard Jingjack from play.

flavor: All around the tuk berry bush the gorath chased the eebit...

name: Naran Lights
text: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. You may choose one revealed Arctic Creature and play it with five energy, ignoring all costs and place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. If you did not reveal a creature this way, place the cards into your hand instead.
flavor: "Luminous excitation of Dream Barrier precipitate? At this time of year? At this time of day? In this region? Localized entirely right in front of me?" — Togoth, General

name: Anastasia

effects.name: Adorable
effects.text: The first opposing Spell, Power, Effect, or attack that would remove energy from Anastasia each turn removes no energy.

effects.name: Scream
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opponent plays a Spell, you may discard three energy from Anastasia to cancel all effects of that Spell. Return that Spell to its owner's hand at the end of the turn.

text: Anastasia ignores regional penalties on Naroom cards.
flavor: When asked, Tony suggested the name of a princess.

name: Artimillies

effects.name: Research
effects.text: Once per turn when a Spell, Power, or Effect causes an opponent to draw a card outside of their Draw Step, look at the top card of your deck. You may discard this card or put it back on top of your deck. Draw a card. Then, if that opponent has more cards than you do, repeat this process once.

effects.name: Rememberance
effects.text: After Artimillies is defeated, add two energy to each of your Magi after they are revealed. If they are a Keeper add an additional energy.

flavor: WMeet by the big tree... Which tree Wence? — Artimillies

name: Braggle

effects.name: Mirror Shield
effects.text: Braggle loses no energy in attacks involving opposing Creatures of the same region as Braggle.

powers.name: Morph
powers.text: Choose any one region. Until the start of your next turn, Braggle is a Creature of the chosen region, instead of Cald.

flavor:
"You know, if you look at it from this angle it kind of looks like water."
— Calderan citizen

name: Caboodle Kit

effects.name: Celestial Memory
effects.text: When you play Caboodle Kit, you may place a spell with energy cost 1 or less from your discard pile into your hand.

effects.name: Curious
effects.text: Whenever you play a spell with energy cost 1 or less, add one energy to Caboodle Kit.

flavor: It's dangerous to go alone! Take this Kit. — Nimbulo, Elder

name: Cactus Hyren

effects.name: Pierce
effects.text:
As Cactus Hyren attacks a Creature with six or more energy,
remove three energy from that Creature.

flavor:
"Never play a game of tag with one of these guys."
-- Drajan, Elder

name: Canopy Hyren

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Remove two energy from each Stalked Creature.

flavor: Becoming one with the treetops, the canopy hyren is unparalleled in the art of sneak attacks.

name: Chelon

powers.name: Shifting Tides
powers.text: Choose an opponent. Look at the top two cards of that opponent's deck. You may discard one of these cards, or put them back on top of the deck in any order.

powers.name: Wash Ashore
powers.text: Search an oppent's discard pile for any one card that was discarded this turn. Play the chosen card, ignoring regional restrictions. Creatures played this way cannot attack this turn.

flavor: Steady as the tides.

name: Darkwood Furok

effects.name: Summoning
effects.text: You may pay the energy costs for Furoks and Firds from Darkwood Furok.

effects.name: Mantle of Kings
effects.text: When you play a Furok or Fird, add one energy to it.

effects.name: Return
effects.text: When one of your other Furoks loses energy while attacking, place half that much energy, rounded down, onto Darkwood Furok.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Darkwood Furok.
flavor: "Naroom is no longer yours. Take your sister and get out of my forest." — Sperri, to Hrada

name: Geoh

powers.name: Excavate
powers.text: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. You may choose up to one Creature, up to one Relic, and up to one Spell from the revealed cards and place them into your hand. Place any remaining cards into your discard pile.

flavor: "Dig a hole, dig a hole, dig a hole...! I make a great shovel, Radgey!"

name: Granite Hyren

effects.name: Improved Invulnerability
effects.text: Granite Hyren loses three less energy in attacks.

flavor:
Formed from the hardest substance in the Teeth, these hyren can take an
incredible amount of abuse before showing signs of wear.

name: League Elder Arderial Alt

effects.name: Adapt
effects.text: When you reveal League Elder, choose any one region. League Elder is from that region.

effects.name: Prepare
effects.text: During your draw step, instead of drawing two cards, draw until you have five cards in your hand.

flavor:
"With all the troubles, we need some fun to bring us together."
— League Charter

name: League Elder

effects.name: Adapt
effects.text: When you reveal League Elder, choose any one region. League Elder is from that region.

effects.name: Prepare
effects.text: During your draw step, instead of drawing two cards, draw until you have five cards in your hand.

flavor:
"With all the troubles, we need some fun to bring us together."
— League Charter

name: Mobis, Avenger

powers.name: Vengeance
powers.text: Choose a Creature that attacked last turn. Discard that Creature.

flavor: "You live in my ocean, you follow my rules!"

name: Mountain Trulb

effects.name: Rolling Stone
effects.text: If you control another Trulb or another Kybar's Teeth creature, you may play Mountain Trulb at the beginning of your attack step, paying all costs.

effects.name: Gathers No Moss
effects.text: Mountain Trulb removes additional energy when attacking equal to the number of Trulbs or Kybars Teeth creatures in play, whichever is greater.

flavor: "Trulbs are natural sprinters—very dangerous over short distances!" — Targ'n

name: Omni Construct

powers.name: Enhance
powers.text: Choose a Creature type. Add one energy to Omni Construct for each Creature of that type in play.

flavor:
"Did you name it Omn Nom 'cause it's always hungry?"
"...No" — Poad to Rayje

name: O'qua, Tracker

powers.name: Invoke
powers.text: Discard an Orothe Spell from your hand. Play an Orothe Creatyre from your hand, reducing its cost by the cost of the Spell you discarded, to a minimum of one.

flavor: "A mythical being shows up—Rayje!—and you want me to ignore his call to action? I am dissapointed, Mobis"

name: Ora

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Whenever Ora plays an Arderial Creature, add one energy to that Creature.

flavor: "When the shadow geysers started erupting people up here thought it was a surface problem... up until the moment one erupted in our cloud city."

name: Possession
text: Defeat your current Magi. You may keep your current Relics, Creatures, and Spells in play. Reveal your next magi with his or her starting energy. You may get the new Magi’s starting cards as normal. That Magi becomes a Shadow Magi of its original region. All rules for Shadow Magi apply to the new Magi. Only Core magi can play Possession.
flavor:
"In this life there are only two things you can count on: family... and betrayal"
— Agram, to Padram

name: Rayje's Belt

powers.name: Lockdown
powers.text: Name any one Power or Effect on a card in play. Until the end of your next turn, no player may use named Power or Effect while Rayje's Belt is in play.

errata.previous_text: Name any one Power or Effect on a card in play. Until the end of your next turn, no player may use the named Power or Effect while Rayje's Belt is in play.
errata.change: Lockdown can only work on a named Power or Effect in play and if Rayje's Belt is discarded, the affected Power or Effect is useable again. This errata supersedes the Rayje's Belt Promotional card.

flavor:
"And when all else fails, you can take off the belt and whip 'em with it."
— 'Rayje's Journal'

name: Relic Stalker

powers.name: Pound Pound Pound
powers.text: Choose any one Relic in play. Discard Relic Stalker from player. Discard the chosen Relic from play.

flavor: When it absolutely (WHAM) needs to be (WHAM) destroyed right now. (WHAM)

name: Rod of Coals

powers.name: Snuff Out
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with only one energy.Discard the chosen Creature from play.

flavor:
"Feeble fires burn out on their own, including the fire of life."
— Magam, Cald Ringsmith

name: Shadow Empress

effects.name: Treacherous Bargain
effects.text: When you play a Spell, add one energy to Shadow Empress unless any opponent removes one energy from their Magi or one of their Creatures in play.

effects.name: Mastery of Shadows
effects.text: Shadow Empress may play Spells as though she were Agram and your Spells in play treat her as though she were Agram.

text: The first time each turn that you would reveal Shadow Empress, if she is not your last Magi, instead of retrieving her starting cards, place her face down on the bottom of your Magi stack and reveal your next Magi instead. If that Magi is Hrada or Agram, add "Secrets of the Book" or "one Shadow Geyser" to his starting cards.
flavor: "You want to know Naroom's darkest secret? Just look to the books!"

name: Showdown
text: Attach Showdown to an opposing Magi. As a Creature attacks, add one energy to it. At the end of each player's Attack Step, if that player did not attack, discard Showdown and remove six energy from that player's Magi. This energy loss cannot be prevented.
flavor: "One of use is staying. It won't be me." — Rayje

name: Sludge Hyren

effects.name: Creeping Growth
effects.text: After Sludge Hyren attacks, add one energy to it for each Bograth Creature you control.

flavor: "It leaches the strength from its companions to act as their battering ram."

name: Snag Hyren

powers.name: Stumble
powers.text: Until the beginning of your next turn, opposing Creatures remove two less energy in attacks.

flavor: It seemed to the Shadow Magi as if the clinging barbs of the snag hyren were suddenly everywhere.

name: Tony, Returned

effects.name: Animite Affinity
effects.text: Tony may play Creatures as though he were a Magi of any region.

powers.name: Rediscover
powers.text: Play a Relic from any discard pile, paying all costs and ignoring regional restrictions

text: Tony, Returned may be in a Magi stack with Tony Jones. If Tony Jones is among your defeated Magi, when you reveal Tony, Returned, add three energy to Tony, Returned.
flavor: "Even after 20 years, the Moonlands are just how I remember."

name: Top Heavy
text: Choose a Creature in play. Add five energy to that creature and attach Top Heavy to it. When a creature with Top Heavy attached gains or loses energy, discard that creature from play.
flavor:
"Looks like moldy jelly, tastes like cardboard, and makes you sneeze. Blech."
"Hey! We cult—achoo!—cultivated those mushrooms ourselves! And what's cardboard?" — Tony and Gruk

name: Traitor's Reach
text: Choose a Creature and a Magi controlled by the same player. If the chosen Creature does not share a region with the chosen Magi, discard that Creature from play and remove two energy from that Magi.
flavor:
Enviouis of Targ'n's position as Elder, T'lok betrayed the secret
entrances to Yark Eyre to the Dark Twins. Enamoured with Warrada,
T'lok also taught her how to control Kybar's Fang.

name: V'ryle

effects.name: Autumn Leaves
effects.text: Your creatures energize on your draw step instead of your energize step.

flavor: "Now if you don't mind, I'm going to bed." — Zajan

name: Vulbor

powers.name: Mind Shock
powers.text: (3) Choose any one player. The chosen player must discard two cards of his or her choice from his or her hand.

errata.previous_text: Choose any one player. The chosen player must discard two cards of their choice from their hand.
errata.change: Mind Shock's cost has been increased to 3 energy.
errata.source: The Unlimited version is the MRP of Vulbor.

flavor: "Ew, gross! No, thank you!" Grejthumped the floating mushroom creature on the head with her climbing staff, popping it like a piñata full of sparkling animite dust.

name: Wanderlust
text: X is equal to the number of players in this game. Choose a Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature for each region among cards in play..
flavor:
"You learn a lot about life, visiting other regions. It's invigorating."
— Wence, Travel Enthusiast

name: Warrior's Boots

powers.name: Warpath
powers.text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from you hand. You must still pay all costs for the Creature.

errata.previous_text: Discard Warrior's Boots from play. Immediately play a Creature from your hand. You must still pay all costs for the Creature.
errata.change: Better clarification on paying all costs associated with the Creature played through Warpath.
errata.source: The Promotional, Limited version is the MRP of Warrior's Boots.

flavor:
"You can tell a true fighter by the way he walks."
— Barak, Cald Warlord

name: Eidon

effects.name: Familiarity
effects.text: Whenever Eidon plays a Creature, add two energy to Eidon if another Creature with the same name is already in play.

flavor: "I travel all over the Moonlands... that is, when I can get away from Gia."

name: Sperri

effects.name: Infuse
effects.text: Whenever Sperri plays a Furok, add two additional energy to the Furok.

powers.name: Preserve
powers.text: Return any one Furok from your discard pile to your hand.

flavor: "Happiness is a furry friend and a flock of blue birds."

name: Rabbage
flavor:
"My garden! It's been rabbaged!"
— Gruk

name: Nocturne
text: Search through your deck for any one Naroom Creature. Play that Creature with one energy, without paying any costs. That Creature may not attack this turn. Shuffle your deck afterward.
flavor: "Yeah, that's a puzzle. I'll see if I can dream something up." — Pruitt, Naroom Ringsmith

name: Vortex of Knowledge
text: Each player draws two cards.
flavor: In order to tell its stories, the wind uses the leaves as its tongues.

name: Bagala Hunter

effects.name: Hunt
effects.text: Whenever Bagala Hunter attacks a stalked Creature, add one energy to Bagala Hunter before energy is removed.

powers.name: Stalk
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Until the end of your next turn, the chosen Creature is stalked; whenever a stalked Creature is attacked, discard one energy from the stalked Creature before energy is removed.

flavor:
Hunting in the jungle lush,
Creeping through the underbrush
Until upon the prey you rush.
It's much more fun to pounce!
— The Scarlet Song

name: Hardshell Weebo

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Hardshell Weebo, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one other Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

flavor:
"Yeah! Weebos on the halfshell!"
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: Jungle Hyren

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: Once per turn, as any player plays a Creature, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to two until the end of the turn, to a minimum starting energy of one. This Effect cannot raise a Creature's starting energy above the amount of energy on that player's Magi.

flavor: Dream a belittled dream.

name: Vine Hyren

effects.name: Dream Tap
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures uses the Effect "Dreamwarp", add one energy to Vine Hyren.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Vine Hyren, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

flavor:
"Korg's forces are too strong; we need to pull back. This'll buy us some
time."
— Boria, Elder

name: Rala Tail

effects.name: Wild Blooming
effects.text: Once per turn, one of your Paradwyn Creatures in play may use one of its Powers a second time. None of your other card effects may allow the Creature to use the Power again this turn, and Wild Blooming cannot be used on Powers that have been used more than once already this turn.

errata.previous_text: All of your Paradwyn Creatures in play can use each of their Powers one additional time each turn. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard from play all of your Creatures that used any of their Powers an additional time during your turn.
errata.change: Only one of your Paradwyn Creatures can use one of it's Powers only twice a turn with Wild Blooming.

flavor:
"Remember, it wasn't so lucky for the rala."
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: Yerthe

effects.name: Empower Dream
effects.text: All of your hyren in play gain ENERGIZE: 1.

effects.name: Hyren Affinity
effects.text: You ignore regional penalties and restrictions when playing hyren.

flavor:
"You know, there are other creatures."
"None that matter."
— Kesia and Yerthe

name: Grass Etiki

effects.name: Weaver
effects.text: All of your Paradwyn Creatures gain "Effect — Weave: Whenever this Creature attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between this Creature and any one of your other Paradwyn or Weave Creatures in play."

effects.name: Dreamwarper
effects.text: All of your Weave Creatures in play and being played gain "Effect — Dreamwarp: As you play this Creature, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn."

flavor:
"Our strengths could work well together, but Gia is too busy negotiating
with the Dark Twins."
— M'lady Iyori, emissary to Paradwyn

name: Uwamar

effects.name: Wait
effects.text: Uwamar cannot attack.

effects.name: Watch
effects.text: Whenever you play any other Weave Creature, add two energy to Uwamar.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Uwamar is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Uwamar and any one of your other Weave Creatures in play.

flavor: Insatiably curious, they're usually the first to look, first to find, and first to run away.

name: Seaweed Lascinth

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: Whenever Seaweed Lascinth attacks or is attacked, before energy is removed, you may move one energy between Seaweed Lascinth and any one of your other Orothe or Weave Creatures in play.

powers.name: Reflexes
powers.text: Whenever Seaweed Lascinth attacks this turn, it removes energy immediately, before Creatures normally remove energy.

flavor:
"Look out! Surf's up!"
— Valkan, Pyromancer and former bridge-builder

name: Gia's Tome

effects.name: Research
effects.text: Once per turn, you may play a Creature from under Gia's Tome as if it were in your hand. If your Magi is Gia, Creatures played from Gia's Tome cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Record
effects.text: Each time a Creature that you own is defeated in an attack, you may place it under Gia's Tome instead of in the discard pile. If Gia's tome is discarded from play, discard all cards undder it

flavor:
"Get me that BOOOOK!"
— Evu, Loremaster

name: Blygt

powers.name: Waking Dreams
powers.text: (3) Choose up to three different Bograth Creatures in your discard pile. An opposing player of your choice chooses one of the three Creatures. Shuffle the chosen Creature into your deck. Play each of the other two Creatures with one energy instead of their normal starting energy. Those Creatures cannot attack this turn.

errata.previous_text: Choose up to three different Bograth Creatures in your discard pile and play each of them with one energy instead of its normal starting energy. An opposing player immediately discards any one of those Creatures from play. Those Creatures cannot attack this turn.
errata.change: The Creature chosen by the opposing player is shuffled into the deck instead of placed back in the discard pile.

flavor: "Of course I'm depressed. People keep crushing my dreams."

name: Emlob

effects.name: Imaginary Friends
effects.text: Whenever one of your Spells, Powers, or Effects counts the number of Creatures or Bograth Creatures you have in play, increase the total by three.

errata.previous_text: You are considered to have three additional Bograth Creatures in play for all of your Spells, Powers and Effects.
errata.change: Imaginary Friends has been clarified for intent.

flavor: "Don't worry about me. I'll manage."

name: Moob

powers.name: Retrieve
powers.text: (3) Discard Moob from play. Add one energy to your Magi for Each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Use this Power before your Attack Step.

errata.previous_text: Discard Moob from play. Add one energy to your Magi for each of your Bograth Creatures in play.
errata.change: Retrieve's Cost has been increased to 3 and can only be used in the first P/R/S Step. Also the copy of Moob found in the Bograth Starter deck (ND) is printed on a Relic template with the art for Statement of Core Values.
errata.cost_note: cost field was missing entirely (treated as free) before this hand fix (2026-07-09) -- errata: "Retrieve's Cost has been increased to 3." See PROGRESS_LOG.md.

flavor:
"Wild thing! You moooob me!"
— Eryss, The Insane

name: Moss Quido

powers.name: Dark Secrets
powers.text: Discard Moss Quido from play. Draw cards equal the number of your Bograth or Core Creatures in play, whichever is greater, to a maximum of four. Use this Power only before the Attack Step.

errata.previous_text: Discard Moss Quido from play. Draw one card for each of your Bograth or Core Creatures in play, whichever is greater. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.
errata.change: A maximum limit of four cards can be drawn through Dark Secrets.

flavor:
"Before I go, Korg, let me give you a few pointers..."
"Ooh, goody, I like presents!"
— Zet and Korg

name: Taglat

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Taglat, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Dream Cross
powers.text: Choose any one Power or Effect on an opposing card in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Power or Effect is considered to be printed on Taglat. Taglat cannot copy a Power or Effect that it already has. All copied Powers that reference the card that they are printed on now reference Taglat.

flavor:
"It's more than a dream thief; it's an idea thief."
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Moob Ring

effects.name: Martyr
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, you may discard any one of your Bograth Creatures from play. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

text: If an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect causes you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard Moob Ring from your hand or from play instead. If you do, until your current Magi is defeated, no opposing cards can cause you to discard cards from your hand.
flavor:
"It's supposed to change color, but it never does."
— Wiep, the Sniveler

name: Bog Stench
text: Until the end of your next turn, you are considered to have two additional Bograth Creatures in play for all of your Spells, Powers, and Effects.
flavor:
"It's not just the smell that grosses me out, it's the sounds as I walk
through the swamp."
— Yaki, Tracker

name: All-High King Korg

effects.name: Super Clever
effects.text: Korg cannot play Relics.

effects.name: Super Brave
effects.text: Whenever Korg has no energy, he is defeated, even if he has Creatures in play.

text: Korg can only play Core, Bograth, and Universal cards.
flavor: "Um... yeah! I had a good idea of Zet's: I'm king!"
subtype: Celebrated Emperor of Great and Mighty Bograth

name: Evil Evu

effects.name: Devour
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Creature is discarded from play or reduced to zero energy by one of your cards, draw a card.

text: You may play Naroom cards, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties.
flavor: "I'll show you jellybeans!"

name: Chaos Plith

effects.name: Guile
effects.text: Whenever Chaos Plith defeats a Creature in an attack, draw a card. If Evu is your Magi, draw an additional card.

text: Naroom Magi may play Chaos Plith.
flavor:
"C'mon, you can trust me," hissed the plith.
"Evu will vouch for my character."

name: Corathan

effects.name: Betrayal
effects.text: Once per turn, whenever you gain control of an opposing card, choose any one Core or Orothe card in your discard pile and place it into your hand. Only one Betrayal may be used for each card you gain control of. Orothe Magi can play Corathan.

errata.previous_text: Whenever you gain control of an opposing card, choose any one Core or Orothe card in your discard pile and place it into your hand.
errata.change: Only one Betrayal will trigger per card theft.

text: Orothe Magi can play Corathan.
flavor:
"This is the deepest treachery of all!"
— Mobis, Elder

name: Tomes of the Great Library

effects.text: Tomes of the Great Library cannot be discarded from play by opposing cards specifically discard Relics from play. Discard Tomes of the Great Library if you Magi is not a Naroom Magi or Naroom Shadow Magi. STARTING: Warrada

errata.previous_text: Tomes of the Great Library cannot be discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Relics from play. Discard Tomes of the Great Library from play if your Magi is not a Naroom Magi or Naroom Shadow Magi.
errata.change: Research has been clarified to deal with Spells that remain in play.

powers.name: Research
powers.text: (1) Search your deck or any opposing discard pile for any one Spell. Play the chosen Spell, ignoring regional restrictions. When that Spell leaves play, if that Spell came from your deck, discard it. If it came from an opposing discard pile, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

errata.previous_text: Search your deck or any opposing discard pile for any one Spell. Play the chosen Spell, ignoring regional restrictions. If that Spell came from your deck, discard it. If it came from an opposing discard pile, shuffle it into its owner's deck.
errata.change: Research has been clarified to deal with Spells that remain in play.

flavor:
"Oh, thank you, dear brother; it's just what I've always wanted!"
— Warrada, The Shadow

name: d'Jarvish

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your burrowed and illusionary Creatures that attacked this turn.

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: Your burrowed and illusionary Creatures that are discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Creatures from play are instead returned to your hand.

flavor: "I think I thought I saw things you can't even imagine."

name: Emaal

effects.name: Sabotage
effects.text: When Emaal is defeated, discard all energy from all opposing Magi and draw a card.

flavor: "You're not as big as you thought you were."

name: Hubram

effects.name: Dreamfetch
effects.text: Whenever you play an Underneath Spell that does not remain in play, you may discard Hubram from play to put the Spell into your hand instead of your discard pile.

flavor: Echoes travel for miles and miles in the Underneath.

name: Blooming Bracelet
text: Once per opposing turn, as energy is removed from one of your Creatures, add an equal amount of energy to your Magi.
flavor:
"That flower looks just like a blooming unjin."
— Marella, Savant

name: Carillion Titan

effects.name: Rampant Growth
effects.text: After another Creature you control defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, add three energy to Carillion Titan.

flavor: As Yaki's creatures charged the foul minions of the Core, the carillion titan continued to grow, moving slowly but surely toward the Great Library.

name: Countless Blades
text: Move one energy from each opposing Creature to your Magi. Your Powers, Spells and Effects cannot increase the energy moved by Countless Blades.
flavor:
"In the Weave, each and every blade of grass is a 
potential enemy or ally. It all depends on your perspective."
— Zaya, Weave Elder

name: Drum Solo
text: Choose two Paradwyn Creatures. Restore each Creature to its printed starting energy.
flavor:
"Let the beats commence!"
— Ookami, Jungle Drummer

name: Harvest Feast
text: Choose up to three Naroom Creatures. Add two energy to each of them.
flavor: "They may take our land, but they'll never take MY KITCHEN!" yelled Poad. With that, the coalition forces ate what might be their last meal before the assault on the Dark Twins.

name: Iain, Commando

powers.name: Impair
powers.text: Each opposing Creature with more than its starting energy is reduced to its printed starting energy.

flavor: "Remember when I said I'd save you for last? I lied."

name: Jungle Eebit

effects.name: Defender
effects.text: If Jungle Eebit would be defeated in an attack, move up to two energy from your Magi to Jungle Eebit, after energy is removed, instead of discarding it from play.

flavor:
"They're tough little buggers... I'll give 'em that!"
— Yricho

name: Keru

powers.name: Weed
powers.text: Search your deck for up to three cards and discard them. Shuffle your deck and draw a card.

flavor: "The tuk berries taste like tuk berries!"

name: Lurking Minani

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Paradwyn Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature removes no energy in attacks until the beginning of your next turn.

text:
Lurking Minani's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Lurking Minani.
flavor: Lurking low behind the jungle leaves, this Minani practices its ambushing skills on the inhabitants of Paradwyn.

name: Marella, Savant

effects.name: Ignorance
effects.text: Your non-Junjertrug cards cost one extra energy to play.

effects.name: Bliss
effects.text: Each of your Junjertrug cards costs two less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor: "Oh, right. The relic. The relic for Gia, the relic chosen specially to help Gia. Gia's relic. Uhh... that relic?"

name: Mijji

effects.name: Guardian
effects.text: If an opposing Spell or Power would discard one of your Creatures from play, you may discard one energy from Mijji. If you do, remove all but one energy from your Creature instead.

text: Mijji ignores regional penalties on Naroom cards.
flavor: "This is my jungle, I have to defend it!"

name: Nightmare Construct

effects.name: Absorb
effects.text: After a Magi energizes, add one energy to Nightmare Construct. If that Magi is Core, add one extra energy to Nightmare Construct.

text: Nightmare Construct's starting energy is equal to your Magi's printed energize.
flavor:
"I've got something for that meddling Rayje, and his
little apprentice too."
— Warrada

name: Pruitt, Ringsmith

effects.name: Nurture
effects.text: Balamants you control lose one less energy in attacks.

powers.name: Refresh
powers.text: Add two energy to each Balamant you control.

flavor: "Yaki, why won't you look at me? What have they done to you?"

name: Quallon's Quest
text: Discard a Weave Creature from your hand. Reveal a number of cards from the top of your deck equal to the Creature's starting energy. Choose up to two Creatures from the revealed cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the rest of the revealed cards into your deck.
flavor:
"The power of freedom, the freedom of choice,
When Quallon does find, the Weave's one true Voice."
— excerpt from Ancient Epic Poem

name: Remember Ring

powers.name: Good Ol' Days
powers.text: Discard Remember Ring from play. Put a Naroom Creature from your discard pile into play with one energy. That Creature may not attack this turn.

flavor:
"I remember when things were simpler. The Dark Twins
hadn't trashed Vash Naroom, Yaki smiled all the time
and Evu told us stories. Now look at things..."
— Pruitt, Ringsmith

name: Scarletsong Banner

effects.name: Morale Boost
effects.text: Increase your energize by one. Draw an extra card during your Draw step.

text: After an opposing card removes energy from your Magi, discard Scarletsong Banner from play.
flavor:
The Scarletsong Banner brings joy for the taking.
— Ancient Inscription

name: Scarletsong Lahalou

powers.name: Screech
powers.text: Discard Scarletsong Lahalou from play. Add one energy to your Magi for each Scarletsong card you control.

flavor: A simple "chirp" from the scarletsong lahalou can alert large areas of the jungle to incoming foes.

name: Scurrying Weggit

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Weave Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature must attack one of your Creatures immediately, regardless of Spells, Powers or Effects. You choose which Creature is attacked.

text:
Scurrying Weggit's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Scurrying Weggit.
flavor: The scurrying weggit is unparalleled in irritating other Dream Creatures; especially those of its own kind!

name: Scarletsong Lilt
text: Choose an opposing Creature and attach Scarletsong Lilt to it. As the chosen Creature loses energy in an attack, remove two energy from the Creature's Magi. Discard Scarletsong Lilt from play at the beginning of your turn.
flavor: What is a lovely sound to native ears, can prove to be a dangerous distraction to foreigners.

name: Sive

effects.name: Research
effects.text: Relics cost you one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Knowledge
effects.text: As you use a Power on a Naroom Relic, choose a Creature you control and add one energy to it.

flavor: "The more I learn, the more I need to know."

name: Snag Arboll

powers.name: Trip
powers.text: Choose an opponent. Remove one energy from that opponent's Magi for each Creature he or she controls.

text: Naroom Shadow Magi may play Snag Arboll.
flavor: The new tricks that Yaki had learned in his solitude took Hrada by surprise. Dream creatures appeared from the surrounding underbrush, leeching the energy from Hrada's dark furoks.

name: Sneaky Weebo

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Naroom Creature. Remove one energy from it and add four energy to another Creature you control.

text:
Sneaky Weebo's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Sneaky Weebo.
flavor:
"Yes, brother, they do seem to be taking a liking to you."
— Warrada

name: Speag Sprouts

effects.name: Weave Strength
effects.text: After energy is moved to Speag Sprouts on an opponent's turn, add one energy to Speag Sprouts.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

flavor: At a gesture from Iyori, the speag sprouts swarmed as the core hyren dove in for an attack. Weaving energy between themselves, the sprouts began to grow in size.

name: Sqwik

effects.name: Sing the Scarletsong
effects.text: Your Paradwyn Creatures remove one extra energy in attacks.

effects.name: Perfect Pitch
effects.text: Your Scarletsong cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

flavor:
"It's fun to watch her pounce."
— Mijji

name: Stagadan Charger

powers.name: Siphon
powers.text: Choose an opposing Magi and one of your other Creatures. Move X energy from the chosen Magi to the chosen Creature. Use this Power only before your Attack step.

flavor:
"CHAAAAAAARGE!!!"
— Poad, Innkeeper

name: T'Dek

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose a Creature with less than its starting energy and restore it to its printed starting energy.

text: T'Dek may only play Naroom and Universal cards.
flavor:
"He's a little abrasive but once you get to know him,
he's a pretty nice guy."
— Ohk, Explorer

name: Toasted Yajo

effects.name: Brittle
effects.text: As Toasted Yajo is attacked, you may shuffle it into its owner's deck and draw a card.

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

text: Cald Spells and Powers cannot choose Toasted Yajo.
flavor:
"Do you smell something burning?"
— Quirle

name: Tripvine

effects.name: Stumble
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Creature attacks your Magi, move half of the Creature's energy, rounded up, to its Magi and return the Creature to its owner's hand.

flavor:
"Ooops! Did I cause that?"
— Laranel

name: Une's Scale

effects.name: Balance
effects.text: At the end of your turn, each player shuffles all but ten cards from their hand into their deck. If a player has ten cards or less, that player shuffles no cards into his or her deck.

flavor:
Greed is unbecoming a Magi.
— Ancient Proverb

name: Ushi

effects.name: Blunt
effects.text: Creatures may not use the Effect "Weave".

powers.name: Motivate
powers.text: Until the end of your turn, each of your Creatures with the Effect "Weave" gains two energy as it attacks.

flavor:
"Ushi's method of motivation usually involves a rather large hammer."
— Kolte

name: Verdant Shield
text: Attach Verdant Shield to your Magi. While Verdant Shield is attached, Naroom Creatures lose one less energy in attacks. Discard Verdant Shield from play at the beginning of your turn.
flavor:
"If you don't think that leaves make good shields,
you've never dueled a Naroomi."
— Tuku

name: Vine Bhatar

powers.name: Whiplash
powers.text: Choose a Stalked Creature. Move one energy from the Creature to Vine Bhatar.

flavor: With a powerful lash, the vine bhatar ripped energy from the gorath, leaving it dazed and breathless.

name: Wandering Balamant

effects.name: Fetch
effects.text: As Wandering Balamant attacks, choose one of your other Creatures. Add two energy to that Creature.

effects.name: Wander
effects.text: Non-Naroom Magi may play Wandering Balamant without regional penalty.

flavor: A Wandering Balamant makes friends no matter where it goes but it always remembers where it came from.

name: Weave Arboll

effects.name: Weave's Gift
effects.text: After Weave Arboll is defeated in an attack, add one energy to each of your Creatures with the effect "Weave".

effects.name: Weave
effects.text: As this Creature attacks or is attacked, you may move one energy between it and one of your other Weave Creatures.

flavor:
"Ooh-it's all wrinkly! Yuck!"
— Tryn, Daughter of Runes

name: Weave Maul

powers.name: Crush
powers.text: Remove one energy from each Creature without the Effect "Weave".

flavor:
"There is no power, no magic, no force in the whole of
the Moonlands that can defeat me while I carry my hammer."
— Ushi

name: Weave-woven Anklet

effects.name: Tied to the Weave
effects.text: If each Creature you control has the Effect "Weave", increase your Magi's energize by one.

effects.name: Memento
effects.text: If Weave-woven Anklet is discarded from play by an opposing Spell or Power, choose one Weave Spell in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

flavor:
"It's SO pretty! But... I think it gave me this weird rash!"
— Marella, Savant

name: Ancient's Puzzlebox

powers.name: Mind Games
powers.text: Discard Ancient's Puzzlebox from play. Reveal any number of cards in your hand and choose a Creature. Add one energy to it for each Ancient's Puzzlebox you reveal. Draw a card. You may not play another Ancient's Puzzlebox this turn.

text: Your deck may contain up to six copies of Ancient Puzzlebox.
flavor:
"I figured it out once before! Why can't I do it again?!"
— Zajan

name: Black Stuff

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your Magi is Bograth, you may play one copy of Black Stuff from your discard pile, paying all costs.

flavor:
"Man, this black stuff never comes off..."
— Wence the Wanderer

name: Brog, Swamp Thug

powers.name: Intimidation
powers.text: Discard one of your Creatures from play. Choose an opposing Creature and move half of its energy, rounded up, to Brog, Swamp Thug.

flavor: "Olabra's in charge now! You answer to her or you find yourself in exile. Got it?"

name: Bulomp

effects.name: Shiftier
effects.text: Your Creatures lose no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"Can't touch these."
— Bulomp's motto

name: Creeping Ainjer

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Bograth Creature. Remove one energy from it and add three energy to your Magi.

text:
Creeping Ainjer's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi can play Creeping Ainjer.
flavor:
"Who could have dreamed up a creature that hates its own kind so much?"
— Sinder, Apprentice

name: Crushing Will
text: Choose a Creature and remove four energy from it. If this discards the Creature from play, choose up to two non-Universal Relics and discard them from play.  Only Universal and Universal Shadow Magi can play Crushing Will.
flavor:
"It takes a willful man to stand alone in the Moonlands 
with no allegiances but himself."
— Orwin, Elder

name: Crystal Goblet

effects.name: Renew
effects.text: After a Crystal Creature is discarded from play on an opposing turn, draw a card.

flavor:
"All you could wish for in fine crystal..."
— Ulmi

name: Crystal Hyren

effects.name: Ricochet
effects.text: Once per turn, as Crystal Hyren is attacked, remove one energy from each opposing Creature.

powers.name: Illuminate
powers.text: Choose a Spell in play and discard it.

flavor:
"Look out for shrapnel!"
— Ulk, Prodigy

name: Crystal Saris

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Saris was not attacked, add two energy to it.

flavor: The Shadow Magi were far too busy fending off Gogor's assault to notice that the saris had doubled in size.

name: Crystal Shield
text: Choose one of your Creatures and attach Crystal Shield to it. While Crystal Shield is attached, the Creature gains "Effect - Deflect: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses this Creature, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead. Discard Crystal Shield from play."
flavor:
"Oh no you don't!"
— Motash, Elder

name: Crystal Twinklet

effects.name: Dream Charge
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Twinklet was not attacked, draw a card.

effects.name: Deflect
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses Crystal Twinklet, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead.

flavor:
"Ooh-pretty! Can I touch it?"
— Gruk

name: Dark Vellup

powers.name: Purge
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand and draw a card. If a copy of the card you discarded is in play, draw an extra card.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Vellup.
flavor: Harror ambushed Dey in the vast expanses of d'Resh. "Time to pay, fool", she hissed, between clenched teeth.

name: Entrench
text: Choose a Creature and attach Entrench to it. While Entrench is attached, the Creature gains "Effect - Entrenched: As this Creature is attacked, add two energy to it. This Creature may not attack." A Creature may not have more than one Entrench attached.
flavor:
"Sometimes it's best to just hunker down and gather your strength!"
— Strag, Adventurer

name: Gorath Cub

powers.name: Chain Whip
powers.text: Choose a Creature or Magi with more than its printed starting energy. Remove three energy from it.

flavor: Chains wrapped tightly around Xandia, forcing a scream of rage from her lips. T'lok stepped from behind a boulder. "You didn't think I'd be that easy to get rid of, did you?"

name: Gulg

powers.name: Fortify
powers.text: Add two energy to each Creature you control that defeated a Creature in an attack this turn.

flavor: "I wonder how long it'll take Strag to miss these spiffy claws?"

name: Haunting Visions
text: Choose an opposing Creature and attach Haunting Visions to it. The Creature may not be chosen by its controller's Spells and Powers.
flavor:
"You think that's scary? Picture this..."
— Morag, Corrupter

name: Kiesel's Hammer

powers.name: Daze
powers.text: Choose a Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature may not gain energy until the beginning of your next turn.

flavor:
"Finally! A tool worthy of the mighty Gogor!"
— Gogor, Celebrated Hero

name: Lanyx, Reaper

powers.name: Hatred
powers.text: Remove two energy from each opposing Creature. Remove one extra energy from each d'Resh Creature.

flavor: "It's time to repay some people for their treacheries. Korremar, Barak, Harror..."

name: Moss Trulb

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Multiply
powers.text: If you control another Trulb, move one energy from each opposing Magi to Moss Trulb.

flavor: Trulbs seem to multipy after a heavy rain.

name: Muck Shovel

powers.name: Depression
powers.text: Choose two Bograth Creatures. Move up to five energy from one Creature to the other Creature.

flavor:
"Hah! Your Pyder is mine now!" Arosa boasted.
"Not for long", Blygt said, a sneer on his face.

name: Mud Bubble
text: Choose a Bograth Creature in your discard pile. Place that Creature in your hand. If you play one or more copies of that Creature this turn, draw a card at the end of your turn.
flavor:
"Ah, it's just mud. What harm is mud?"
— Targ'n, Elder

name: Pillar Hyren

effects.name: Stabilize
effects.text: As one of your Creatures is attacked, add one energy to it.

text: If your Magi is Underneath, Pillar Hyren may not be discarded from play by opposing Spells, Powers or Effects while it still has energy. Your Powers, Spells and Effects cannot reduce the amount of energy removed from Pillar Hyren in attacks.
flavor: Literally a pillar of strength, the Pillar Hyren lends the endurance of age-old stone to its comrades.

name: Rot Arboll

effects.name: Blight
effects.text: After an opponent plays a Creature with more energy than Rot Arboll, move one energy from that Creature to Rot Arboll.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

flavor:
"These aren't the healing kind. They prefer the misery
of those stronger than themselves."
— Queen Olabra

name: Rumble Stones

powers.name: Mini-Quake
powers.text: Remove one energy from each non-Underneath Creature and Magi.

flavor:
"At first, we thought it was a thunderquake. When we
looked around, all we saw was an Underling holding a
small stone in her hand."
— Valkan

name: Shadow Dryte

effects.name: Descendance
effects.text: After Shadow Dryte defeats a Creature while attacking, add four energy to Shadow Dryte.

flavor: It feeds on the pain of others. This makes it the perfect weapon for Agram's minions.

name: Shadow Fird

effects.name: Feed
effects.text: After a Furok is discarded from play, you may play one copy of Shadow Fird from your discard pile, ignoring all costs.

flavor: Flocks of these foul beasts now follow Sperri wherever she roams.

name: Shroud of the Master

powers.name: Absolute Authority
powers.text: Discard a Core card from your hand. Add one energy to your Magi and one energy to each of your Core Creatures. If your Magi is Agram, add one extra energy to each of your Core Creatures.

flavor:
"You're not worthy to bear such a noble burden, Hrada.
Take it off at once!"
— Morag

name: Slinking Greal

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Core Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature's controller chooses a Creature he or she controls and removes two energy from it.

text:
Slinking Greal's text cannot be altered.
Non-Core Magi may play Slinking Greal.
flavor:
"Who cares where these things came from? All that
matters is that they seem to want to help."
— Yaki, Core Stalker
shadow_play: Arderial, Bograth, Cald, Kybar's Teeth, Nar, Naroom, Orothe, Paradwyn, Underneath, Universal, Weave, d'Resh

name: T'lok, Traitor

effects.name: Betrayed Secrets
effects.text: Effects may not reduce the amount of energy removed from opposing Creatures in attacks.

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Your Core Creatures remove one extra energy when attacking.

flavor: "Of course I'll show you how to use Kybar's Fang."

name: Trulb Bracelet

powers.name: Sweet Sorrow
powers.text: Discard one of your Trulbs from play. Draw a number of cards equal to the Trulb's printed starting energy, plus one.

flavor:
"...and it's pretty too."
—Grahnna, Revered Important Person

name: Trulbble!
text: Discard up to four Trulbs you control from play. Draw two cards for each Trulb you discarded.
flavor: In the swamps of Bograth, even the most meaningless creature serves a greater purpose.

name: Twisted Dreams
text: Choose a Power on an opposing Creature. Remove energy from that Creature equal to the cost of the chosen Power (X equals zero).
flavor: Togoth snapped his fingers. The approaching ormagon let out a bellow of pain, then vanished in a flash of light.

name: Ulk, Prodigy

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Korrits you control may not be chosen by opposing Powers.

effects.name: Fungal Bloom
effects.text: After you play a Korrit, add one energy to it.

flavor: "CUTE!? Is that ALL you think of me?! Watch this!"

name: Ulmi

effects.name: Crystal Affinity
effects.text: Crystal cards cost you one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Resist
effects.text: Your Crystal Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.

flavor: "Crystal is so sparkly, I just can't get enough of it!"

name: Venomous Korrit

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Underneath Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature gains "Effect - Weaken: As this Creature is attacked, remove two energy from it." until the end of your next turn.

text:
Venomous Korrit's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Venomous Korrit.
flavor:
"The only thing worse than its bite is its breath!"
— Strag, Adventurer

name: Whilp

powers.name: Plague
powers.text: Choose a Creature type. All Creatures of the chosen type lose two energy.

flavor: "Hmm... I wonder what this would do to a Bagala?"

name: Wither Twee

effects.name: Sweet Rot
effects.text: If Wither Twee is defeated in an attack, add one energy to each Bograth Creature and draw a card.

flavor: Wither Twees surround the borders of Bograth. Each foes that passes only strengthens the denizens of that foul region.

name: Yayek

effects.name: Seeds of Deceit
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a Spell or Relic in an opposing discard pile and shuffle it into its owner's deck. Increase Yayek's energize by that card's energy cost until the end of your turn (X equals zero).

flavor: With Nagsis missing, Yayek has made his way to Hrada's side.

name: Jungle Riddle
text: Discard a card from your hand and choose an opponent. That opponent removes up to five energy from his or her Magi. Add energy to your Magi equal to five minus the energy your opponent removed from his or her Magi.
flavor:
"Ninx's riddles leave people in such a confused state
that they can't tell whether he's a man or a woman."
— Liriel, Bagala Trainer

name: Amara
